chapters.title: Chapter 551 - 352: Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots
paragraphs: The plants on those Sky Islands harbor opportunities.
However, after pondering for a moment, Han Xing shook his head.
"Let’s not worry about those fruits for now. Our purpose is to find relevant clues in the Sky Island Forest."
"Let’s not complicate things."
Everyone nodded in agreement, understanding that Han Xing made sense.
At that moment.
Han Xing took out a small white sphere from his hand.
He tossed it onto the ground.
A puff of white smoke swiftly emerged.
Then it began to rapidly spread, completely enveloping the entire Sky Island.
From the outside, it actually looked just like a wild Cloud Sky Island.
"What is this thing, Brother Xing?" Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask.
Han Xing replied, "A cloud cover device, a little gadget developed by the Witch Race, capable of completely covering the Sky Island."
"From the outside, it just looks like a regular Cloud Sky Island."
"However, this thing only serves as a diversion."
"If those powerful beings truly draw near, it will still be discovered."
Everyone nodded in realization.
Han Xing continued, "Next, we’ll leave the Sky Island here and explore inside on our own."
Leaving the Sky Island here is also a reluctant move.
The Sky Island is too conspicuous, even if they use their divine power to conceal it, allowing them to evade the sight of the Four-star Lords and Dominators.
But if it’s those of the Legendary and Demigod level, they can practically see through Han Xing and his team’s disguise instantly.
Legendary Powerhouses are very sensitive to the fluctuations of divine power.
Shen Yun seemed to recall something and asked, "Brother Xing, even if we leave the Sky Island here and infiltrate the Sky Island Forest territory ourselves, won’t we still be discovered?"
"The divine power fluctuations on us will also be sensed by those Legends."
Han Xing glanced at him and smiled, "I naturally have other means."
As soon as he finished speaking.
A few black, fluorescent potions appeared in Han Xing’s hand.
"What are these?"
Shen Yun asked curiously.
"Divine Power Shielding Potion."
Han Xing explained, "An auxiliary secret elixir hastily crafted by all the Secret Medicine Grandmasters of the Witch Race.
"Although it’s a rough product, it can shield our divine power fluctuations, and Legendary Powerhouses will almost not detect us!"
Hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up.
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed, "So what you’re saying, Brother Xing, is that as long as we take this potion..."
"We can use divine power to mask our auras, and even sneak up behind those Legendary Powerhouses without being discovered?"
"Damn! Wouldn’t that make us all Legendary Assassins like Coal Ball?"
Han Xing laughed, "What are you thinking?"
"This potion is only a semi-finished product, although it can shield from a Legend’s detection."
"However, for a Demigod level, it’s not certain."
"Furthermore, this potion has a drawback—once we make a move, the shielding effect will disappear."
Hearing this, the joy in Cheng Jianyong’s eyes vanished instantly.
The limitations were too many, dashing his hopes of using it to ambush others.
Han Xing shook his head.
"Take the potion, and let’s move forward."
As soon as he finished speaking.
The five of them simultaneously drank the black potion.
At that moment.
They clearly felt the divine power fluctuations on their bodies disappear.
Beside them, Coal Ball tilted its head, looking at their actions with confusion.
It seemed unable to comprehend why they went to such lengths to hide themselves.
At this time, everyone remembered.
After Coal Ball broke through to Legend, it awakened a Passive Skill called [Escape into the Void]
It could hide its form any time, anywhere, and its invisibility was several levels higher than theirs!
Everyone looked at the little guy with envy.
Then, the silhouettes of the five people and one wolf vanished from the spot.
The surroundings rapidly receded.
As Han Xing and his party journeyed, they had already discovered numerous gigantic aerial forests.
The scenes they discovered were similar to what they had seen before.
The plants of entire forests absorbing energy to sustain some powerful plants.
At the treetops of these plants, most bore several fruits teeming with a rich life force aura.
Especially at the center of the forest, the strongest plant’s fruits emitted an enticing fragrance.
Even with the willpower of Han Xing and the others, they found it hard to resist taking a bite.
However, they had business to attend to.
They quickly pushed these thoughts aside.
They continued forward again for hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
The scenery of one Sky Island Forest after another continued around them.
It’s undeniable.
The domain of the Sky Island Forest was incredibly vast.
The deeper they ventured into the territory of the Sky Island Forest, the larger the area of the Sky Island became.
At that moment.
An extremely enormous Sky Island appeared before them.
It was covered with various towering trees, with gigantic trees as tall as hundreds of thousands of meters visible everywhere.
Stretching as far as the eye could see.
Comparable to the area of the Witch Race Continent, if not even larger!
Han Xing and his companions halted immediately because in this massive primitive forest.
They sensed the presence of Legendary Powerhouses.
And there were many of them!
"Among these presences, there are a few that feel familiar, like those Tree Spirit Legends who came to aid us back then?" Shen Yun suddenly remarked.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, on this land, there are at least more than fifty Legends."
"Counting the number of Legends we’ve encountered on our way."
"The Sky Island Forest houses at least a hundred Legendary Powerhouses."
"In addition, there’s a highly skilled Demigod."
"The strength of the Sky Island Forest is indeed formidable!"
Han Xing, of course, knew this was just the overt power of the Sky Island Forest.
In the shadows, there were definitely other means.
These guys were all very well concealed.

chapters.title: Chapter 552 - 352: Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots
paragraphs: At that moment.
Looking at the entire Holy Spirit Realm, the Witch Race is indeed one of the weakest factions.
Before Han Xing and the others arrived, if not for the demigod Helas holding the scene...
The Witch Race wouldn’t even count as a major race.
However, now Han Xing has no fear of these forces.
Remember, they have even confronted and slain a demigod-level giant dragon along the Path of the Giant Dragon,
Now, the Witch Race—no, Han Xing’s faction.
Is no longer what it used to be.
The next moment.
The five humans and one wolf charged straight into the massive primitive forest.
As expected by everyone.
Their path was unobstructed.
The tree spirits completely ignored their arrival.
With the help of the ’Divine Power Shielding Secret Elixir,’ as long as Han Xing and his group did not intentionally reveal themselves,
they wouldn’t be detected even if they appeared right before the tree spirits.
It was then that Han Xing and his group discovered the defensive power of the Sky Island Forest.
Unlike the Witch Race, which constructs various defense towers for detection and attack,
The so-called defense here relied on these legendary-level tree spirits, with millions of branches on their bodies,
The tips of these branches emitted waves of divine power, seemingly weaving a massive spider web in the air.
Any enemy passing through these webs would be caught.
To avoid exposing themselves and causing more unexpected situations,
Han Xing deliberately led the group in a large detour, gradually approaching the central region of the Sky Island Forest Continent.
Upon reaching here.
The plants became sturdier and more lush.
Towering ancient trees over ten thousand meters tall could be seen everywhere.
Occasionally, they even spotted a few legendary ancient trees over one hundred thousand meters tall.
They continued to remain low-profile and cautiously searched this forest continent.
According to Han Xing and his group’s experience, the closer they got to the continent’s center, the more powerful plants there would be.
And at the very center, it was likely the location of the entity they were searching for.
Just then.
In front of them appeared an ancient tree of immeasurable height, its top invisible.
This ancient tree was like the mythical Buzhou Mountain, supporting the sky and earth!
Stretching from the Forest Continent to the highest point of the firmament.
No doubt, it was the second largest creature they had ever seen.
The first being the corpse of a beast.
Cheng Jianyong murmured in awe, "The World Tree..."
Just then, a voice appeared above them.
"Young friend, you compare this old being to such a sacred entity, you flatter me too much..."
At the instant this voice sounded.
Their scalps tightened, and a sense of crisis suddenly filled their hearts!
Because they hadn’t sensed when this voice appeared.
It was as if it emerged right beside them.
They immediately entered a combat state.
"Dear young friends, is there any need to be so tense?"
"Did you not travel all this way to the Sky Island Forest to find me?"
Han Xing finally realized.
The one speaking to them was the highest leader of the Sky Island Forest.
That demigod-level being!
They exchanged glances, the alertness in their eyes yet to fade.
After a brief contemplation, Han Xing released the bowstring about to unleash an attack and responded, "You are correct; we did come here to find you."
"Last time, you sent legendary plants from your race to aid the Witch Race, and later had someone invite me to the Sky Island Forest."
"Now, I have fulfilled that promise."
The voice sounded again.
"Indeed, there was such a matter. I thought, young friend, you would not hold up your promise to me."
"Did not expect you to come so soon."
"For someone so young, you understand gratitude and repayment."
"I truly admire you."
Hearing these words of praise,
Han Xing seemingly sensed that the other party bore no malice.
The vigilance in his heart slightly eased.
"In that case, why don’t you come out and meet us, Your Excellency?
Upon hearing this, a sound of ancient laughter echoed in their ears.
"Young friend, have I not been before you all this time?"
The colossal tree in front of them, of innumerable height, swayed gently.
Their pupils shrank dramatically.
The next moment.
The attributes of this ancient tree appeared before him.
[Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots: Demigod-level Creature]
[Level]: Unknown
[Attributes]: Unknown
[Skills]: Unknown
[Divine Power Value]: Unknown
Note: An ancient tree with an extremely long lifespan, but for some reason, it carries the aura of a curse.
Upon seeing the system’s note.
Han Xing finally confirmed, this being was the leader of the Sky Island Forest.
An extremely ancient holy tree.
At this time, the entity spoke softly, "Dear young friends, are you here to help me remove the curse?"
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s face turned serious immediately.
He spoke coldly, "Honestly, if I didn’t sense your lack of malice,"
"I’d have reason to suspect that you tricked us here to harm us."
The large ancient tree’s branches swayed gently, seemingly quite surprised.
"Young friend, why would you say such a thing?"
Han Xing raised his head and said, "You should know what the source of this curse is, right?"
"You called me here to resolve this curse. Do you think I have the power to confront a divine being?"
"Or do you think I’m not dying fast enough?"
Han Xing’s tone was not the least bit polite.
At this time, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots seemed to realize what Han Xing had misunderstood.
It sighed softly.
"Dear young friend, it seems you already know the source of this curse."

chapters.title: Chapter 553 - 352: Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots
paragraphs: "Old man asks you to come here, naturally not to trap you."
Han Xing quietly waited for the ancient tree to continue.
"I know clearly that the source of the curse is not something we can resolve."
"Before this, I have tried many times, all ending in failure."
"I asked you here for another matter."
"And this matter also requires your help."
Han Xing looked at the massive trunk that seemed like a mountain, puzzled.
The other party spoke directly.
"That is, to expel the cursed and decayed parts from my body."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing was momentarily dazed.
It seemed the ancient tree knew Han Xing did not understand.
The ancient tree continued to explain: "Young friend should know that this curse is like a maggot on the bone."
"Once afflicted, it will gradually invade every corner of the body."
"Until it completely erodes your body, turning you into a slave of the curse."
With that,
the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots slowly turned its body.
Its immense body could affect the entire Forest Continent with each movement.
The greenery covering the sky above twisted like a green vortex.
And when its body turned roughly 180 degrees, the scene suddenly changed before the eyes of the people.
The branches once covered in greenery disappeared.
In their place was a swath of bloody and decayed blackness.
The trunk of the giant tree transformed into patches of black, stinking flesh!
This flesh seemed to possess its own life, constantly squirming, sprouting eyes.
It was like a mountain of flesh, densely packed with eyeballs.
Chilling to behold!
At this moment,
everyone took a deep breath simultaneously.
If another side of the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots symbolized life and majesty,
then this side represented complete decay and corruption.
Various mosquitoes covered it, reeking horribly!
Green or red mucus, mixed with various organs, dripped down.
Even the ground within tens of kilometers turned deep black.
At this moment, on the trunk covered in flesh.
Han Xing saw a huge human face.
However, that human face appeared extremely pained, its features twisted together.
"Is this... your true form?" Han Xing couldn’t help but ask.
The huge human face seemed to be restraining its pain.
Then it sighed and said: "Yes."
"Ugly, isn’t it?"
Everyone nodded in unison.
It was clearly impossible for them to lie.
The current appearance of the ancient tree was truly nauseating.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots gave a bitter smile.
It wasn’t angry at the frank expression of the few.
"Hundreds of years ago, I wasn’t like this."
"Ever since I was entangled by such a curse, my true form has been eroded every moment."
"They grow like parasites inside me, absorbing my nutrients."
"Not only devouring my Power, but also turning my body into such a terrifying and disgusting appearance!"
"Only with the help of your Power can I peel away these disgusting parts!"
Han Xing frowned, "What do you mean?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots continued: "Yes, I want you to attack my body."
"Remove all the necrotic areas from me."
Han Xing was somewhat surprised, "Can’t you do this yourself?"
"You have so many branches, can’t you just scrape off those infected parts?"
The ancient tree sighed helplessly: "Obviously, that’s not possible."
"At the moment my body was invaded by the curse, that part no longer belonged to me."
"Not only that, young friend, did you see those eyes?"
"These eyes constantly drill into my mind, controlling my consciousness."
"Whenever I want to attack the infected parts of my body, those eyes force me to stop!
At this, it seemed extremely pained.
Han Xing nodded, "I understand, so you want the strength of a demigod to forcibly break through your defenses and destroy these cursed bodies."
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots was instantly excited: "Yes, exactly!"
"Before, I invited Helas over for the same reason."
"But that guy was too weak, couldn’t even withstand my subconscious counterattack, and got hurt."
"But young friend can repel the Dark Shadow, you must have stronger Power than Helas!"
Hearing this, Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
Then he smiled wryly.
So, last time Wu Ling’Er said Helas was injured in the Sky Island Forest, it was because of this.
It seems Helas isn’t all that strong among demigods.
Couldn’t even handle the unconscious counterattack of this ancient tree.
But this also explains that this ancient tree is stronger than imagined.
"Young friend, please make your move now, help me drive away these rotten parts from my body..."
"Old man has endured this torment for too long."
"Once successful, I will forever remember your kindness!"
Han Xing didn’t agree immediately but pondered instead.
Seeing no response for a long time, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots urged: "Young friend, what are you waiting for?"
"I promise, if you help me clear away these curse-corrupted parts, I will give you a tremendous reward!"
"The Demigod-Level Life Tree Heart that can greatly enhance Divine Power, the Withered Wood Staff from my tribe, I can give them to you!"
"If you’re not satisfied, you can even go into my tribe’s treasury and pick for yourself!"
The ancient tree’s tone was extremely earnest.
You could hear that it wasn’t joking.
At this moment.
A system prompt appeared by Han Xing’s ear.
[The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots assigns you a quest, requesting your hand in expelling its decayed parts: 55%]
[Quest Rewards: Demigod-Level Life Tree Heart*1, Withered Wood Staff (Red)*1, Tree Spirit Treasure Vault Access*1...]

Han Xing was somewhat surprised, "Can’t you do this yourself?"
"You have so many branches, can’t you just scrape off those infected parts?"
The ancient tree sighed helplessly: "Obviously, that’s not possible."
"At the moment my body was invaded by the curse, that part no longer belonged to me."
"Not only that, young friend, did you see those eyes?"
"These eyes constantly drill into my mind, controlling my consciousness."
"Whenever I want to attack the infected parts of my body, those eyes force me to stop!
At this, it seemed extremely pained.
Han Xing nodded, "I understand, so you want the strength of a demigod to forcibly break through your defenses and destroy these cursed bodies."
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots was instantly excited: "Yes, exactly!"
"Before, I invited Helas over for the same reason."
"But that guy was too weak, couldn’t even withstand my subconscious counterattack, and got hurt."
"But young friend can repel the Dark Shadow, you must have stronger Power than Helas!"
Hearing this, Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
Then he smiled wryly.
So, last time Wu Ling’Er said Helas was injured in the Sky Island Forest, it was because of this.
It seems Helas isn’t all that strong among demigods.
Couldn’t even handle the unconscious counterattack of this ancient tree.
But this also explains that this ancient tree is stronger than imagined.
"Young friend, please make your move now, help me drive away these rotten parts from my body..."
"Old man has endured this torment for too long."
"Once successful, I will forever remember your kindness!"
Han Xing didn’t agree immediately but pondered instead.
Seeing no response for a long time, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots urged: "Young friend, what are you waiting for?"
"I promise, if you help me clear away these curse-corrupted parts, I will give you a tremendous reward!"
"The Demigod-Level Life Tree Heart that can greatly enhance Divine Power, the Withered Wood Staff from my tribe, I can give them to you!"
"If you’re not satisfied, you can even go into my tribe’s treasury and pick for yourself!"
The ancient tree’s tone was extremely earnest.
You could hear that it wasn’t joking.
At this moment.
A system prompt appeared by Han Xing’s ear.
[The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots assigns you a quest, requesting your hand in expelling its decayed parts: 55%]
[Quest Rewards: Demigod-Level Life Tree Heart*1, Withered Wood Staff (Red)*1, Tree Spirit Treasure Vault Access*1...]

chapters.title: Chapter 554 - 353: True God, Undying and Indestructible!
paragraphs: Seeing the prompt, Han Xing cast a deep look at the ancient tree.
Before this.
They already knew,
a dominator-level Life Fruit could increase the maximum Life Value by 1000 points.
And the so-called ’Life Tree Heart’ was obviously something more advanced than a Life Fruit.
Han Xing remembered, during the last battle with the Shadow Monarch.
After the Shadow Monarch killed one legendary tree spirit, he also dug something out from its body.
Then swallowed it directly.
That thing should have been the ’Life Tree Heart.’
And for someone like the Shadow Monarch, to remember to devour it in the midst of battle.
It was enough to show how precious an item the Life Tree Heart is.
Looking at it this way, the task reward from this ancient tree was truly astonishing.
However.
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing still shook his head and said.
"Sorry, I can’t help you now."
Upon hearing that, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots instantly lost all traces of anticipation.
It was like grabbing a life-saving straw, only to lose it moments later.
In its frenzy, it even exclaimed, "Why?"
"Why aren’t you willing to help me?"
"Clearly, just a slight intervention from you wouldn’t take much of your time!"
"Do you think the reward isn’t enough? I can continue to increase it!!"
It was obvious.
The state of the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots was truly painful, almost losing control.
But Han Xing still shook his head and said, "I’ve said it, I can’t help you now."
The ancient tree seemed to catch the meaning in Han Xing’s words; it asked with difficulty, "Can’t help now?"
"Then... when will you be able?"
"My current state can’t hold on for much longer. At this rate, I might completely become its slave."
Han Xing nodded, "I know. My time is also limited."
"Before that, I want to ask, if the corroded parts on you are removed, can you break free from the curse?"
The face on the tree was taken aback.
Then sighed and said, "Obviously, that’s impossible."
"That kind of curse isn’t something that can be easily escaped."
Han Xing shrugged his shoulders,
"So, removing the infected parts isn’t the solution."
"Only by resolving the source can we permanently end it."
"The source..."
The ancient tree seemed deep in thought,
Moments later, its previously hopeless expression suddenly froze.
It thought it misheard, tentatively asked, "You mean... resolving the curse’s source."
"Are you suggesting looking for the God of Tricks to lift this curse?"
Han Xing heard an unfamiliar name.
God of Tricks.
Totally different from the Plague God or God of Curse he had in mind.
It seemed.
This ancient tree indeed knew a lot about the secrets surrounding that divine spirit.
And at that moment, Han Xing said something that caught the ancient tree off guard.
"You’ve misunderstood."
"I’m not seeking to lift the curse, but to kill it!"
At that moment.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots opened its eyes wide in shock.
The next second, its divine power surged and completely enveloped the Primitive Forest Continent!
"Boom!"
That day, the Sky Island Forest Continent experienced an unprecedented tremor.
Half an hour later...
Upon learning Han Xing and his group’s plan.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots took a long time to calm down.
After a while, it looked at Han Xing with a complicated expression.
Who could have imagined that a group of demigods of the human race was plotting to confront a true god!
And judging by the looks, they were serious.
Seeing the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots didn’t answer.
Han Xing then asked, "What, don’t believe?
"You must know, even before I broke through to legend, I had already taken down the Shadow Monarch."
"Now, breaking through to legend, what’s wrong with aiming to slay a god?"
The Holy Tree with Entwined Roots took a deep look at Han Xing and shook its head.
"No, I do believe you."
"So, this Master of the Human Race..."
"Please tell me, is there anything the old me can do?"
"Or what can the old me do to assist you?"
It had changed its address for Han Xing.
From the old term ’young friend’ to ’Master of the Human Race.’
This also showed the ancient tree had started treating Han Xing as an equal.
Hearing this, Han Xing knew the ancient tree had agreed.
Joy appeared on his face.
"I don’t need you to do anything, I just want to learn more from you about that divine spirit."
"Including the divine spirit’s abilities, their methods, and so on."
Upon hearing this, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots’s expression froze again.
Truly... ignorance is fearless.
They didn’t know what mighty power the divine spirit possessed, yet were daring to act against them.
But perhaps it was this very mindset that enabled such earth-shaking actions.
"Divine spirits are entirely different from legendary beings..."
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots sighed deeply and began to explain.
"You should know, the hallmark of legendary level is mastering divine power."
"In this realm, legendary powerhouses continuously absorb heaven and earth energy, transforming it into their attributes, enhancing divine power strength."
"When divine power reaches a certain limit, it achieves a high-tier legendary realm."
"At this time, we will receive certain perceptions in the midst."
"These perceptions are like a force of nature, one of the laws forming the world’s workings."
"At this point, it indicates you can break through to demigod."
The crowd slowly nodded while listening.
Interestingly, it was their first time hearing someone explain in detail about this world’s cultivation system.

chapters.title: Chapter 555 - 353: True God, Undying and Indestructible!
paragraphs: And they have also learned of the path beyond Legend.
"To break through to a Demigod, besides sensing a basic Law of the world, there is another important requirement."
"That is to possess a corresponding Divine Format."
"Only through the Divine Format can we touch and master this Power of Laws."
Han Xing continued to nod.
He almost understood the difference between Demigod and Legend.
That is to master the Power of Laws.
And the Divine Format is also a crucial tool.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots continued.
"Of course, you can also condense your own Divine Format."
Han Xing asked in confusion, "Condense my own Divine Format?"
"Is there any difference?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots laughed, "Of course, there is a difference."
"You must know, as early as the Age of Ten Thousand Gods, all the operational Laws of the Holy Spirit Realm were already fully controlled."
"It’s equivalent to all the paths of advancement being in the hands of those Divine Spirits."
"Only the occasional fragments of Laws that spill over, condensed into a Divine Format, can allow us to break through the Demigod."
"However, those who use this Divine Format to break through to Demigod will find their lifelong achievements halted here."
"No matter how extraordinarily talented you are, you cannot become a True God."
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but ask from the side, "Why?"
The Ancient Tree slowly replied, "Because, as I said earlier, the path has been blocked."
"A Divine Spirit controls a path to the highest realm; you use its Law fragments for breakthrough."
"Naturally, your achievements cannot surpass that being."
"Unless, one day, the Divine Spirit controlling this path suddenly falls."
"Then the Demigods in the same system below would have a chance to break through to Divine Spirit."
As these words were spoken, everyone frowned.
This was another crucial piece of information.
The number of Divine Spirits is fixed.
However many types of Laws there are, only that many Divine Spirits can be born.
If the Divine Spirit mastering a Law does not die, latecomers cannot break through.
Only ancient beings like the Holy Tree can know these secrets.
It seemed to have seen the worry on everyone’s faces.
The Ancient Tree continued, "However, besides this path, there is another method to break through to a Demigod."
"This method is not restricted by the unique Law, and can lead all the way to the Divine Spirit, even the True God Realm!"
Hope once again appeared in everyone’s eyes as they asked, "What is this method?"
The Ancient Tree didn’t keep them in suspense, replying slowly, "That is to condense your own Divine Format!"
The moment these words were said.
A bolt of lightning suddenly struck the top of the Ancient Tree.
It seemed as if its words touched upon some kind of taboo within the world, provoking some kind of punishment!
However, the Ancient Tree seemed unperturbed.
After the lightning entered its body, it merely trembled slightly, and then it dissipated into nothingness.
The Ancient Tree paused before continuing, "If you can condense your own Divine Format, it amounts to creating a brand-new path among the myriad of controlled Laws."
"The significance of this is no less than creating a new world!"
While feeling shocked in his heart, Han Xing couldn’t help but ask.
"Will breaking through to Demigod by condensing my own Divine Format be stronger than others?"
Han Xing was unconcerned with the so-called significant meaning.
He only wanted to know how much combat power condensing his own Divine Format would give him.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots chuckled, "Master of the Human Race, this cannot simply be expressed in terms of combat power."
"Throughout history, those who have condensed their own Divine Format."
"Once they break through, they possess the formidable combat power to confront even the Divine Spirits head-on, and even slay them!"
"They are considered the most demonic figures of an era!"
Hearing these words, everyone felt a shock in their hearts.
Upon reaching the Legendary Realm.
The more people can feel the vast gap between each realm.
For example, Han Xing.
Even now, he can defeat a Demigod across levels.
But as mentioned earlier, there’s also a difference between Demigods.
If divided.
Helas and Nelos should be considered among the lower-middle tiers of Demigods.
The Ancient Tree and Shadow Monarch belong to high-tier combat strength.
Only the Golden Dragon should be part of the top-tier combat strength of Demigods, almost approaching a real Divine Spirit.
Thus, while Han Xing can threaten something like the Golden Dragon by relying on the Defense Tower.
If he relies on his own combat strength.
At most, he could draw with Nelos.
The ancient tree before them, even if it is in a weakened state now.
Han Xing without employing the Defense Tower doesn’t have much confidence to defeat it.
Therefore, what the Ancient Tree said.
To confront a real Divine Spirit with the strength of a Demigod sounds extraordinarily impressive!
At this moment, Han Xing had already made a silent decision.
He must try to condense a Divine Format of his own!
Of course, even if he fails, it doesn’t matter.
Han Xing still possesses a very powerful Divine Format belonging to the Hunter.
That is something even real Divine Spirits covet.
It must be much stronger than the average Divine Format.
Seeing the expectation in Han Xing’s eyes seemingly.
The Ancient Tree continued, "Therefore, condensing your own Divine Format is extremely difficult and profoundly significant."
"As an old being, I’ve lived for so many years."
"In my experience, I know of only two beings who have achieved such a feat."
Hearing these words, Han Xing was surprised.
In the Ancient Tree’s narrative, condensing a Divine Format was described as incredibly difficult.
Unexpectedly, there are actually people who can accomplish it.
"Oh? Experts exist."
"Who are they?"
Han Xing couldn’t help but ask.
The Ancient Tree didn’t keep him in suspense, and said slowly, "The first one, you should recognize."
"The Power within you comes from him."

chapters.title: Chapter 556 - 353: True God, Undying and Indestructible!
paragraphs: Han Xing pondered for a moment and looked at himself.
At this moment, he seemed to suddenly understand something, his heart shook violently!
The entity the ancient tree spoke of is Hunter.
And what Han Xing didn’t expect was,
Hunter actually relied on his own power to condense the divine format, then broke through to become a demigod.
No wonder, that so-called God of Tricks.
Would rather go to great lengths to threaten him with the Witch Race, to force him to hand over Hunter’s divine format.
If what the ancient tree said is true.
Then Hunter’s divine format might very well be a key to the supreme path!
The importance of the divine format in Han Xing’s backpack increased several times in his eyes.
Han Xing took a deep breath and endeavored to calm the shock in his heart.
He continued to ask, "And the second one?"
The ancient tree looked at the distant ancient kingdom, then slowly spoke a name.
"Demon Race Emperor."
Everyone present was stunned for a moment.
"It’s him..."
Everyone knew of this existence.
In the item material ’Strong Fragment’, it notes the grand event of the Abyss Realm invading the Holy Spirit Realm.
The Demon Race Emperor was the mastermind behind this event.
It is said that he, relying on his own strength, suppressed all the strong of the Holy Spirit Realm to the point where they couldn’t lift their heads.
After being defeated by a joint effort.
He could still slash out an Abyssal Rift, a channel connecting the two realms with a single sword.
If it was him, possessing such power wouldn’t be surprising.
The ancient tree nodded slowly.
"Having talked about demigods, let me tell you about the realm above demigods, which is divine spirits."
Everyone focused all their spirit and listened sideways.
The ancient tree continued, "Demigods have the ability to sever the lines of destiny of mortals, which is actually an evolution of the power of rules."
"When reaching divine spirits, they have completely mastered these rules."
"Aside from having short-term foresight, the ability to seek fortune and avoid calamity, etc."
"The flesh bodies of divine spirits also turn towards a non-life state."
"They are nearly eternally undead, even if you destroy their flesh, turning it to ash, they will resurrect from the rules."
"Therefore, as long as these rules exist, divine spirits cannot be killed."
Han Xing and the others furrowed their brows.
They finally realized the terror of the divine spirit realm.
As long as the rules remain, they won’t die.
This kind of enemy truly makes one feel despair.
No wonder there’s been no divine spirit downfall since the Dark Age ended.
Ask, what kind of existence can erase the rules of the world?
Han Xing felt a burst of relief in his heart.
Thankfully, before they went to provoke that divine spirit, they came to the Sky Island Forest to inquire about such information.
Otherwise, they would plunge in blindly, and not even know how they died.
Han Xing tentatively said, "So according to what you say, below divine level, there really isn’t a way to kill a divine spirit?"
The ancient tree laughed, "Master of the Human Race, don’t be nervous."
"What I mentioned as eternally undead, able to resurrect infinitely from the rules, are the means of True Gods."
"True Gods completely integrate the rules into their bodies, they themselves are the embodiment of rules."
"And most ordinary divine spirits have only just condensed their divine bodies, far from reaching this level."
"As long as their divine bodies are completely destroyed, preventing them from returning to the rules, you can completely obliterate such an existence."
Hope reignited in Han Xing’s eyes.
Among divine spirits, there are also distinctions between strength.
Aside from the True Gods who integrate completely with rules,
there are also divine spirits who have just condensed their divine bodies.
"You mean, this God of Tricks is just an ordinary divine spirit who has condensed a divine body?"
The ancient tree nodded.
"However, you mustn’t underestimate ordinary divine spirits either."
"The mighty power they possess is far beyond comparison to demigods."
"Although they can’t resurrect infinitely, they can also perfectly use the power of rules."
"For example, the God of Tricks."
"It is a divine spirit that controls the rule of ’trickery’."
At this moment, the ancient tree said something terrifying.
"In other words, when living creatures in the world have trickery thoughts in their minds, they will be captured by this power of rules."
"Including when you are plotting against the ’God of Tricks,’ it might already know your intentions!"
Everyone’s heart shook violently!
If it really is as the ancient tree said,
The God of Tricks controls the trickery law.
Then this creature excels at using schemes to deal with enemies.
And Han Xing and the others planning to deal with it is like brandishing a sword before Guan Gong, courting death!
"Brother Xing..."
Cheng Jianyong shouted worriedly beside him.
After Han Xing pondered for a moment, he waved his hand.
Indicating to everyone not to worry.
There wasn’t much fear in his eyes.
"Don’t worry, even if that guy knows, it’s no problem."
"Anyway, we eventually have to confront it head-on."
"Moreover, this ancient tree elder also said, the God of Tricks can be killed."
"Then there’s nothing to fear!"
Although the strength of the God of Tricks exceeded Han Xing’s expectations.
But Han Xing’s improvement speed has far surpassed everyone’s imagination.
Ever since the end of the battle with the Giant Dragon Race.
Han Xing has once again welcomed a terrifying transformation!
Everyone also held great confidence in Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing said again:
"I understand, thank you for explaining so much to us."
"Then, we shall leave."
The ancient tree then said, "Master of the Human Race, have you already decided to fight this divine spirit head-on?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, blindly avoiding and yielding will accomplish nothing."
"It will only continually demand more conditions, squeezing every bit of value from us."
"I don’t want to become like you, neither human nor ghost."
The ancient tree listened, smiled bitterly, and shook its head.
Han Xing said no more, took his team, and left the center of the Forest Continent.
Just as they were about to leave.
Aging voice suddenly came from behind the ancient tree.
"Master of the Human Race, please stay..."

sentences.text: Han Xing pondered for a moment and looked at himself.
At this moment, he seemed to suddenly understand something, his heart shook violently!
The entity the ancient tree spoke of is Hunter.
And what Han Xing didn’t expect was,
Hunter actually relied on his own power to condense the divine format, then broke through to become a demigod.
No wonder, that so-called God of Tricks.
Would rather go to great lengths to threaten him with the Witch Race, to force him to hand over Hunter’s divine format.
If what the ancient tree said is true.
Then Hunter’s divine format might very well be a key to the supreme path!
The importance of the divine format in Han Xing’s backpack increased several times in his eyes.
Han Xing took a deep breath and endeavored to calm the shock in his heart.
He continued to ask, "And the second one?"
The ancient tree looked at the distant ancient kingdom, then slowly spoke a name.
"Demon Race Emperor."
Everyone present was stunned for a moment.
"It’s him..."
Everyone knew of this existence.
In the item material ’Strong Fragment’, it notes the grand event of the Abyss Realm invading the Holy Spirit Realm.
The Demon Race Emperor was the mastermind behind this event.
It is said that he, relying on his own strength, suppressed all the strong of the Holy Spirit Realm to the point where they couldn’t lift their heads.
After being defeated by a joint effort.
He could still slash out an Abyssal Rift, a channel connecting the two realms with a single sword.
If it was him, possessing such power wouldn’t be surprising.
The ancient tree nodded slowly.
"Having talked about demigods, let me tell you about the realm above demigods, which is divine spirits."
Everyone focused all their spirit and listened sideways.
The ancient tree continued, "Demigods have the ability to sever the lines of destiny of mortals, which is actually an evolution of the power of rules."
"When reaching divine spirits, they have completely mastered these rules."
"Aside from having short-term foresight, the ability to seek fortune and avoid calamity, etc."
"The flesh bodies of divine spirits also turn towards a non-life state."
"They are nearly eternally undead, even if you destroy their flesh, turning it to ash, they will resurrect from the rules."
"Therefore, as long as these rules exist, divine spirits cannot be killed."
Han Xing and the others furrowed their brows.
They finally realized the terror of the divine spirit realm.
As long as the rules remain, they won’t die.
This kind of enemy truly makes one feel despair.
No wonder there’s been no divine spirit downfall since the Dark Age ended.
Ask, what kind of existence can erase the rules of the world?
Han Xing felt a burst of relief in his heart.
Thankfully, before they went to provoke that divine spirit, they came to the Sky Island Forest to inquire about such information.
Otherwise, they would plunge in blindly, and not even know how they died.
Han Xing tentatively said, "So according to what you say, below divine level, there really isn’t a way to kill a divine spirit?"
The ancient tree laughed, "Master of the Human Race, don’t be nervous."
"What I mentioned as eternally undead, able to resurrect infinitely from the rules, are the means of True Gods."
"True Gods completely integrate the rules into their bodies, they themselves are the embodiment of rules."
"And most ordinary divine spirits have only just condensed their divine bodies, far from reaching this level."
"As long as their divine bodies are completely destroyed, preventing them from returning to the rules, you can completely obliterate such an existence."
Hope reignited in Han Xing’s eyes.
Among divine spirits, there are also distinctions between strength.
Aside from the True Gods who integrate completely with rules,
there are also divine spirits who have just condensed their divine bodies.
"You mean, this God of Tricks is just an ordinary divine spirit who has condensed a divine body?"
The ancient tree nodded.
"However, you mustn’t underestimate ordinary divine spirits either."
"The mighty power they possess is far beyond comparison to demigods."
"Although they can’t resurrect infinitely, they can also perfectly use the power of rules."
"For example, the God of Tricks."
"It is a divine spirit that controls the rule of ’trickery’."
At this moment, the ancient tree said something terrifying.
"In other words, when living creatures in the world have trickery thoughts in their minds, they will be captured by this power of rules."
"Including when you are plotting against the ’God of Tricks,’ it might already know your intentions!"
Everyone’s heart shook violently!
If it really is as the ancient tree said,
The God of Tricks controls the trickery law.
Then this creature excels at using schemes to deal with enemies.
And Han Xing and the others planning to deal with it is like brandishing a sword before Guan Gong, courting death!
"Brother Xing..."
Cheng Jianyong shouted worriedly beside him.
After Han Xing pondered for a moment, he waved his hand.
Indicating to everyone not to worry.
There wasn’t much fear in his eyes.
"Don’t worry, even if that guy knows, it’s no problem."
"Anyway, we eventually have to confront it head-on."
"Moreover, this ancient tree elder also said, the God of Tricks can be killed."
"Then there’s nothing to fear!"
Although the strength of the God of Tricks exceeded Han Xing’s expectations.
But Han Xing’s improvement speed has far surpassed everyone’s imagination.
Ever since the end of the battle with the Giant Dragon Race.
Han Xing has once again welcomed a terrifying transformation!
Everyone also held great confidence in Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing said again:
"I understand, thank you for explaining so much to us."
"Then, we shall leave."
The ancient tree then said, "Master of the Human Race, have you already decided to fight this divine spirit head-on?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, blindly avoiding and yielding will accomplish nothing."
"It will only continually demand more conditions, squeezing every bit of value from us."
"I don’t want to become like you, neither human nor ghost."
The ancient tree listened, smiled bitterly, and shook its head.
Han Xing said no more, took his team, and left the center of the Forest Continent.
Just as they were about to leave.
Aging voice suddenly came from behind the ancient tree.
"Master of the Human Race, please stay..."

chapters.title: Chapter 557 - 354: Holy Artifact: Heart of the Endless Tree Sea
paragraphs: "Master of the Human Race, please wait."
Han Xing turned around in confusion.
The ancient tree said, "Although I don’t know where you young friends have found the courage, nor what means you’ll employ against the God of Tricks."
"However, I’ve been tormented by its curse for countless years."
"More than anyone, I hope you will succeed."
"To that end, I’m willing to offer a small token of help."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes instantly lit up.
"You mean to say you’re coming with us to deal with that guy?"
It’s essential to understand that this old tree clearly possesses the strength of a high-tier demigod.
Even in its current injured state, it feels much more formidable to Han Xing than the Shadow Monarch.
With such a powerful demigod assisting us, our chances against the God of Tricks would undoubtedly increase.
However, the ancient tree awkwardly coughed twice.
"Master of the Human Race, you might have misunderstood..."
"In this form, I can no longer easily leave the Tree Sea Continent, and naturally, I can’t lend a hand to help you against the God of Tricks."
"Ugh... Then why did you say you’d help us?" Cheng Jianyong muttered softly.
The ancient tree appeared even more embarrassed.
But quickly, it recovered and said: "Young friend, while I can’t directly take action."
"However, I can lend you a rare treasure from my race to combat the God of Tricks."
Upon hearing the word ’rare treasure,’ Han Xing’s eyes lit up again.
He eagerly asked, "What treasure?"
Seeing Han Xing’s expression.
The ancient tree pulled a grin across its face.
However, the smile seemed a bit eerie.
The next moment.
A branch burst through the sky.
"Whoosh!"
The sound of breaking through echoed.
As everyone watched expectantly, they suddenly saw that branch rapidly descend again.
At the end of the branch, something seemed to be hanging and emitting a dazzling green light.
On the green light, everyone sensed a powerful aura.
"What is this?" Han Xing asked in confusion.
The ancient tree slowly said, "A holy artifact from my race, the Heart of the Endless Tree Sea."
Upon hearing ’holy artifact,’ Han Xing’s pupils contracted sharply.
By now, Han Xing understood that every holy artifact is unique and critically important!
The Sun Crown Stele grants him the power to resist divine spirits!
And the holy artifact necklace in his hand is part of a holy artifact set, possessing unimaginable mighty power!
And this ancient tree’s claim about the Tree Spirit Race’s holy artifact, it must have incredibly strong power too!
Staring at the branch, hanging with that piece resembling a green agate gem, Han Xing had its attributes appear before him.
[Heart of the Endless Tree Sea]: Holy artifact of the Tree Spirit Race.
[Binding Attributes]: Life Limit +1 million, Divine Power Value +2000.
[Attached Effects]: Primordial Breath, Endless Vines, Seed of Rebirth.
[Primordial Breath]: The Heart of the Endless Tree Sea autonomously breathes, releasing absorbed energy every 24 hours, increasing the user’s Life Limit by 100 points.

[Endless Entanglement]: Instantly releases countless vines, forcibly controlling enemies for 3 to 100 seconds, and siphoning 30 to 100 Divine Power Value from the opponent, cooldown time is 12 hours. (Can control a True God.)
[Seed of Rebirth]: Upon binding this holy artifact, if the user suffers fatal damage, they can retain a thread of life force to escape and revive.
Note: After resurrection, the user’s level will decrease by 10 levels, this effect can be used once every 100 years, remaining usage 1/1.
After seeing the attributes of this holy artifact.
Han Xing fell into long-standing shock.
He finally understood why this ancient tree was so strong.
Merely the first effect of [Primordial Breath] is worthy of the name holy artifact.
With this thing, even by doing nothing, it can increase its life value every day.
A daily increase of 100 Life Limit might not sound like much.
But it benefits from having no side effects and no upper limit.
Accumulated over time, in a year it would be over 30,000 points, in a hundred years it would be over 300,000?
Converted, that’s more than 300,000 Constitution points!
And how many centuries has this old tree lived?
It’s been thousands of years, hasn’t it?
Just this holy artifact alone has likely brought the ancient tree’s Life Limit to over 10 million.
Maybe even much more!
One must know that Han Xing’s current constitution, combined with the Witch Race Saint Master’s title bonus, converts to just over 500,000 life value.
And the ancient tree’s life value is hundreds of times greater than Han Xing’s!
In terms of life value alone, it’s probably scarier than an average divine spirit.
And beyond [Primordial Breath].
The latter two effects are even more formidable.
[Endless Entanglement] can control divine spirits and siphon their Divine Power Value.
Moreover, it only has a 12-hour cooldown time.
If used wisely, Han Xing can gain dozens of Divine Power Value in a day.
In a month, that’s over a thousand, nearly exceeding Han Xing’s current divine power strength.
And the final [Seed of Rebirth], is even more outrageous.
It grants the holder the ability to resurrect...
Apart from those True Gods who meld with rules, likely no one in the Holy Spirit Realm wouldn’t want it.
This ancient tree, to deal with the God of Tricks, has made a huge sacrifice.
Even taking out such a treasure.
Han Xing said in slight shock: "Are you sure you want to give me something so precious?"
The ancient tree chuckled: "Lend it to you, young friend, don’t get it wrong."
Han Xing squinted his eyes, nodding repeatedly.
"No problem, no problem, after the matter I’ll definitely return it to you."
Though he said he’ll return it, Han Xing hasn’t promised when he’d give it back.

chapters.title: Chapter 558 - 354: Holy Artifact: Heart of the Endless Tree Sea (2)
paragraphs: After several hundred or thousand years, it will still be returned.
The ancient tree seemed to see through Han Xing’s thoughts and laughed, "Young friend, the holy artifact is crucial to my race, and we must not lose it. I ask you to sign a contract with me."
"After this mission, please make sure to return the holy artifact to us!"
The smile on Han Xing’s face instantly froze.
He hadn’t expected this ancient tree to be so unyielding, even resorting to a contract to bind him.
At this moment, he gave Cheng Jianyong a look.
Cheng Jianyong instantly understood.
"Damn, you old coot. Not only are you dragging your feet when lending something, but you also want us to sign a contract!"
"Are you really afraid we’ll run away?"
"Damn it, why are we going to deal with the God of Tricks?"
"Isn’t it to help you break free from this half-dead state?"
"Without us, where would you find someone to help you fight a divine spirit?"
"You ungrateful old coot!"
Cheng Jianyong cursed passionately, his face full of anger.
The ancient tree was left bewildered by Cheng Jianyong’s harsh scolding.
Although Cheng Jianyong’s scolding made sense.
But it also realized that this member of the Human Race was deliberately avoiding the real issue.
Dealing with the God of Tricks wasn’t just for its own sake.
This Human Race member’s goal was not to return the holy artifact to it.
However, before the ancient tree could speak.
Cheng Jianyong said, "Let’s go, Brother Xing, we won’t do it!"
"I’d rather cooperate with the God of Tricks than with this guy."
"He doesn’t have to do anything and gets benefits."
"Wanting everything without giving anything in return, isn’t that treating us like fools?"
"Where in the world is there such a good deal?"
Cheng Jianyong was even more enraged.
The crowd listened and also felt he made sense.
Han Xing nodded, "Then let’s go."
After speaking, they turned around and left.
Then, at this moment, the ancient tree panicked.
Although it knew that half of these Humans’ performance was out of indignation, and half was an act for it.
But if they really walked away and didn’t fight the God of Tricks.
It would be in big trouble!
As mentioned before.
Their goal in dealing with the God of Tricks wasn’t for it.
But no matter what, it would indeed benefit.
If these Humans could succeed, it could truly lift the curse that had plagued it for years and restore its peak strength.
Even if it takes the holy artifact as a price, so what?
The holy artifact is precious, but you have to be alive to take it.
It had already felt the curse spreading faster on itself.
The remaining time was running out.
"Hold on, young Humans."
The voice of the ancient tree calling them stopped them in their tracks.
Cheng Jianyong turned his head, still looking very defiant.
"What? We don’t want your stuff, nor do we want to help you!"
The ancient tree smiled wryly and said, "Please calm your anger, young friend."
"I thought about it, and you do have a point."
"In that case, let’s not sign anything."
"Whenever you’re done using it, just return the holy artifact to me."
It seemed to have had an epiphany, suddenly becoming extraordinarily generous.
Hearing this, everyone’s eyes lit up instantly.
Unexpectedly, this ancient tree actually compromised.
It turned out that Cheng Jianyong’s provocation, although clumsy, was quite effective.
Just when Han Xing was about to agree.
Cheng Jianyong seemed to think of something.
"Not enough!" Cheng Jianyong spoke again.
"What?"
The ancient tree asked in confusion.
"Your holy artifact is just on loan to us, and in the future, we still have to return it to you."
"By that calculation, you still haven’t given anything."
"This time we are dealing with the God of Tricks at the risk of our lives."
"Shouldn’t you offer something as a token of goodwill?
Cheng Jianyong spoke convincingly.
The crowd seemed to remember something.
Wow, it makes sense!
This time they did such a big favor, and if successful, they would basically save the ancient tree from a near-death state.
The Tree Spirit Race offering something in return would be justified, wouldn’t it?
The ancient tree was momentarily stunned but helplessly laughed:
"Okay."
"How about this, young friends tell me what you need, and I’ll try my best to fulfill it."
Hearing the ancient tree’s promise, Cheng Jianyong smiled.
He gave Han Xing a look.
Signaling that the task was accomplished satisfactorily.
Han Xing, beside him, gave a thumbs up.
Sometimes, someone indeed needs to play the bad guy.
There you go, a few words, and you get even more benefits, why not?
Han Xing wasn’t worried that this ancient tree would back out.
He could see that the other party didn’t have long to live.
Once it dies, the Sky Island Forest will no longer have a demigod-level stronghold.
By then, the situation they face might be like the Witch Race back in the day.
Not only might they lose these treasures, but the entire Tree Spirit Race might also face extinction.
Not everyone can get as lucky as the Witch Race and encounter Han Xing.
Han Xing then picked up the conversation: "If we succeed this time, it would be equivalent to completing your previous commission."
"How about you first give us a Demigod-level Life Tree Heart."
"And ten Legendary Level Life Tree Hearts, we won’t take the divine artifact for now, what do you think?"
The ancient tree with entwined roots seemed a bit hesitant.
But upon recalling, it had initially prepared to part with these items.
Decidedly, it nodded.
"Okay."
The satisfied smile reappeared on Han Xing’s face.
He didn’t plan to push his luck any further, knowing when to stop.

chapters.title: Chapter 559 - 354: Holy Artifact: Heart of the Endless Tree Sea (3)
paragraphs: The words fell.
The ancient tree extended a few branches once more, rushing towards the Tree Sea Continent.
In the blink of an eye, it broke through over a thousand kilometers to reach a certain place.
When those branches retracted.
Everyone saw that there were already two simple redwood boxes.
Though they hadn’t been opened yet,
Han Xing could already feel the rich life aura within them.
Then.
The ancient tree handed the three items directly to Han Xing.
Han Xing reached out to accept them.
[Acquired Tree Spirit Race Holy Artifact: Heart of the Endless Tree Sea, acquired Life Tree Heart (Demigod Level) *1, Life Tree Heart (High-tier Legendary) *10.]
Upon hearing the system prompt, Han Xing felt at ease and deeply glanced at the other.
It seemed that this ancient tree hadn’t cut corners.
Even the Legendary Level Life Tree Heart was of High-tier Legendary Level.
Han Xing was very satisfied.
"Then, we need to set off now."
"Esteemed Ancient Tree, until we meet again."
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots shuddered, an aged voice echoed in Han Xing’s ear.
"Master of the Human Race, may you have a triumphant victory this time."
Han Xing waved his hand.
He didn’t speak.
Instead, he led everyone away from the center of this Forest Continent.
Not until Han Xing’s figure vanished over the horizon.
Did the ancient tree slowly turn around.
Presenting its side, which symbolized life and majesty, back to everyone.
While on its other side, a complex expression appeared.
"I don’t know if placing hope on these humans is right."
"But the situation has reached this point, and there’s no room for regret."
"All we can do is hope that they succeed..."
Han Xing promptly left the realms of the Sky Island Forest.
On the road, Han Xing glanced back at the Forest Continent.
He wasn’t worried that this ancient tree was an informer for the God of Tricks.
As previously mentioned, even if discovered, it didn’t matter.
After all, sooner or later, they had to confront him.
Given the deviousness of the God of Tricks, he was probably already figuring out a way to deal with them.
An hour later.
They returned unobstructed to their own Sky Island.
The harvest from this trip was quite outstanding.
Not only did they gather information about their opponent.
They also obtained a powerful holy artifact.
And over a dozen Life Tree Hearts.
Han Xing was utterly expectant of such treasures.
Consequently, he immediately took out the agate gem emitting a faint green light from his backpack.
The system prompt appeared.
[Would you like to bind the Tree Spirit Race Holy Artifact: Heart of the Endless Tree Sea?]
"Yes."
[Binding successful, Life Value cap +1,000,000, Divine Power Value +2000.]
At this moment.
A formidable aura of life burst forth from Han Xing.
This aura of life swept over like a gentle breeze, bringing a refreshing feeling.
The once barren ground, as if caressed by the God of Life, unexpectedly displayed patches of greenery.
Countless grass seeds swiftly grew and sprouted from the soil.
Everyone simultaneously turned to look and discovered that Han Xing’s life force had become prolonged and profound.
There was even a hint of the same aura as that ancient tree.
After all, a 1,000,000-point increase in life value cap was no joke.
It practically boosted Han Xing’s current life value by 200%.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt a change in his body again.
His body became healthier, and his complexion appeared younger.
His features became as vibrant as when he was just over 20, full of vitality!
"This feeling...is really nice."
Han Xing contentedly stretched his body,
he could feel that his lifespan had significantly increased.
At the current strength of his life value, living for tens of thousands of years wouldn’t be an issue.
"Tsk tsk!"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in surprise at Han Xing’s transformation, marveling out loud.
"How come it feels like Brother Xing has returned to his university days.
"He’s suddenly become so young."
Shen Yun nodded on the side, "Indeed, is this perhaps what they call rejuvenation?"
After hearing this, Han Xing, with exasperation, said: "Shush, you’re the one who’s old."
"Even if I hadn’t changed, I’m just a young man of twenty-five or twenty-six, alright?"
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun both laughed heartily.
And the two women, upon seeing Han Xing’s transformation, felt even more admiration in their eyes.
Han Xing was extremely pleased with his current state.
Aside from the significant increase in life value.
He had also gained an enhancement.
Which was Divine Power Value.
[Divine Power Value]: 3513.
Originally, his Divine Power Value was only 1500 points.
Now, after binding the holy artifact, he directly gained 2000 points more!
Causing his attack power and defense to surge again!
Han Xing glanced at the ’Heart of the Endless Tree Sea’ in his backpack.
With this holy artifact, his life value and divine power value would consistently increase every day!
Given time, how formidable Han Xing could become was simply unimaginable!
Settling his excited emotions.
Han Xing still had two treasures in his backpack.
As specialties of the Tree Spirit Race, they were items even demigods longed for.
Han Xing promptly checked their attributes.
[Life Tree Heart (High-tier Legendary Level)]: Upon consumption, permanently increases life value cap by 10,000 points, Divine Power Value +100 (maximum use: 10/10)
[Life Tree Heart (Demigod Level)]: Upon consumption, permanently increases life value cap by 50,000 points, Divine Power Value +500. (maximum use: 5/5.)
The effects were straightforward and clear, capable of significantly increasing life value and divine power value.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing.
Directly distributed the High-tier Legendary Life Tree Hearts to everyone.
Including the Coal Ball, each received two, just enough to go around.
As for himself, he consumed the Demigod Level Life Tree Heart.
Given their relationship, there was no need to decline in these matters.
Moreover, they were about to face a great battle soon.
Naturally, Han Xing was eager to seize every opportunity to enhance his strength.
At this moment.
The five people and the wolf looked at the Life Tree Hearts before them, radiating a strong aura.
And directly swallowed them whole!

Han Xing could already feel the rich life aura within them.
Then.

chapters.title: Chapter 560 - 355: Facing the Divine Spirit, the Godwar Begins!
paragraphs: At the same time.
A formidable burst of life force erupted from within them.
The plants on the ground of the Sky Island grew wildly again!
In the blink of an eye, the small grass grew to more than a meter high.
The strength of the five increased once more!
After digesting the Life Tree Heart.
Han Xing gazed in the direction of the Beastman Kingdom and began to move forward in a straight line.
Eight hours later.
In front of Han Xing, huge rocky Sky Islands appeared.
[You have entered the Beastman Kingdom, new map unlocked, world influence +132, Legendary Points +5.]
Seeing the system prompt, everyone knew they had arrived at the destination.
Just like before.
Han Xing tossed out a small white ball, releasing clouds to cover the Sky Island.
Then the five took black potions, entering a state shielded by divine power.
In the next moment—
They stepped directly into the territory of the Beastman Kingdom.
All the way.
They encountered many giant Sky Islands once more.
The style of the Sky Islands here was entirely different from those of the Witch Race and the Tree Spirit Race.
On top, everywhere were barren rocky mountains.
Hidden within these rocks were many caves.
Beastmen also live in a communal lifestyle.
On any Sky Island, there are at least hundreds of thousands of beastmen.
These beastmen vary in strength.
Similar to the Witch Race, the greatest number were ordinary beastmen.
They didn’t even have the strength of the First Transformation.
According to this ratio.
The population of the Beastman Kingdom is much more terrifying compared to the Witch Race.
The vast population base naturally gave rise to more powerful individuals.
Lord Level Fourth-Turn Leaders were not uncommon.
The power possessed by the Beastman Kingdom was stronger than that of the Witch Race.
However, Han Xing wasn’t surprised by this.
The Witch Race is already a fallen great race.
Compared to those great races in the Holy Spirit Realm, they can barely hold their own.
It’s a miracle that they have persisted without extinction until now.
They completely ignored the nearby Beastman Sky Islands.
Directly seeking a place where the divine spirit might be hiding.
Han Xing already knew.
The other senses that he was coming to deal with it.
Even, that divine spirit might be waiting for them to walk into the trap.
However, at this moment.
Han Xing would not retreat.
At this time, inside the Divine Hall.
A massive shadow descended.
Zhou Huang still lay on the ground like a dead dog.
Yet a somber voice sounded near his ear.
"Child of Destiny."
"If before this, someone told you."
"That a few legendary ants were plotting against me, would you believe such talk?"
Zhou Huang raised his head with difficulty, staring at the shadow.
Without waiting for Zhou Huang’s reply, the other continued self-talking.
"That’s correct, I also wouldn’t believe it."
"But the fact is, it really happened."
"Those kids are not just thinking about opposing me, but they are immediately taking action!"
"Are they truly bold enough to fear no death, or young calves unafraid of tigers?"
"Too arrogant, too presumptuous, huhahaha!"
At this point, the voice held a touch of crazed laughter.
"Interesting, so very interesting!"
"It’s been so many years since I encountered something so entertaining."
"Hahahahaha!"
Its laughter grew increasingly mad, shaking the entire Divine Hall.
A moment later, sounds of a tongue licking reached Zhou Huang’s ears.
Like slippery tentacles brushing over his head.
"Do you say, should I personally take action and crush these few humans on the spot?"
"Or capture them to slowly torment?
Zhou Huang was shocked in his heart, "You... cannot act..."
He uttered in a strained voice.
"The Holy Spirit Realm places restrictions on beings like you..."
"If you expose your aura, you will be detected and then obliterated..."
In the air, the silhouette remained silent for a moment.
Then, somewhat unexpectedly, said: "Interesting, didn’t think you were so knowledgeable."
"In fact, you even know about the Holy Spirit Realm forbidding divine spirits to act."
However, the voice sounded disdainful: "But you overthink things."
"Do you wonder why I’ve wandered in the Holy Spirit Realm for so long without being discovered?"
"Do you wonder why, having acted secretly so many times, the Holy Spirit Realm’s power hasn’t punished me?"
Zhou Huang felt a bad premonition.
"Heh heh... hahahah!"
"That’s because I am the God of Tricks, after all!"
"With just a few minor tactics, I can deceive the Holy Spirit Realm’s power!"
"They simply cannot discover me!"
"Thus, now in the entire Holy Spirit Realm, only I can freely act with divine level power."
"You have no idea how much those guys envy me!"
While Zhou Huang was in shock, he spoke again: "You... don’t make a move on him..."
At this time, the voice self-talked again.
"Forget it, let’s capture them to torment slowly."
"Such good material, I don’t want them to be played to death all at once."
"Just like you, heh heh!"
At the same time.
Han Xing and his group penetrated tens of thousands of kilometers into the Beastman Kingdom’s territory.
The size of the Sky Islands here grew increasingly vast, and the aura of Legendary Beastmen became more frequent.
But Han Xing ignored them all.
He came to find that divine spirit and had no interest in dealing with these Beastman Legends.
Right then.
On a vast continent within the Beastman Kingdom.
They sensed a robust yet decayed aura.
At least, it housed demigod level power.
The group knew.
That aura should belong to the King of the Beastman Kingdom.

chapters.title: Chapter 561 - 355: Facing the Divine Spirit, the Divine War Begins! (2)
paragraphs: It has completely fallen into being a cursed servant.
Moreover, the other party has already noticed that Han Xing has arrived.
However, Han Xing didn’t mind.
At this point, there was no need to hide anymore.
Next, all he needed to do was follow his plan to handle the God of Tricks.
This Beastman King better not make a move.
If it dared to make a move.
Then Han Xing wouldn’t mind spending a bit more time to free it completely!
At this moment.
At the center of the Beastman Sky Island Continent.
In a grand stone-carved palace.
The towering Beastman King sat on the throne, with red and green liquids flowing under its feet.
Its body was completely decayed, with not a single piece of flesh intact.
The Beastman King had its eyes slightly closed, as if it were dead.
And around it were numerous black chains filled with patterns.
But the legendary beastmen below knew that this was their king’s way to resist the curse.
It had been completely corroded by the curse.
If it didn’t fall into a dormant state, it wouldn’t be sure what outrageous things it might do.
Just at this moment.
The Beastman King suddenly opened its eyes.
It gazed into the sky over the Beastman Continent and let out a surprised exclamation.
"Here?"
The legendary beastmen below, upon seeing their king awake, were overjoyed one by one.
However, amidst their joy, there was some worry.
Afraid that what had woken up was a king completely controlled by the curse, driven to madness.
A mad demigod could bring about a catastrophic disaster for the entire Beastman Kingdom.
"Your Majesty, are you awake?" A legendary beastman cautiously probed.
A moment later, the Beastman King gently moved.
"Hmm."
Upon hearing such a calm response, the legendary beastmen exchanged glances, showing expressions of surprise and joy.
At this time, the Beastman King asked, "How long has it been since I last awoke?"
The legendary beastmen thought for a moment and replied, "About half a year ago."
"When the Witch Race sought help from our tribe, you awoke."
"So soon..." A trace of surprise appeared in the Beastman King’s eyes.
"Your Majesty, do you have any new instructions upon waking this time?"
The legendary beastmen asked below.
The Beastman King sighed with self-mockery: "Now, our entire nation is under that one’s control."
"What more instructions could I give?
The legendary beastmen were momentarily stunned, then shook their heads with bitter smiles.
"However, if I’m not mistaken."
"The Beastman Kingdom, and even the entire Holy Spirit Realm, are about to change today."
Below, those legendary beastmen were filled with confusion.
Meanwhile.
Upon discovering that the Beastman King did not attack him, Han Xing also withdrew his attack mode.
The five soared through the sky at tremendous speed under the cover of divine power.
Just then.
An aged voice echoed beside Han Xing’s ear.
"Southwest direction, proceed eighty thousand kilometers..."
Once the voice finished, the connection was abruptly cut off.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly looked back towards the Beastman Continent.
He suddenly realized.
The Beastman King might not be fully controlled yet.
Perhaps, it still retained the slightest bit of consciousness.
And this was the kind of message it conveyed to him.
"Southwest direction?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment.
Then proceeded directly in that direction.
Legendary level powerhouses have extremely fast movement speed.
A few minutes later, Han Xing arrived at the location described by the voice.
In front of everyone.
An island in the sky shrouded in black smoke appeared.
The island wasn’t large, but the black smoke on it could obscure everyone’s divine power and sight.
Even Han Xing couldn’t detect the scene within.
"Brother Xing, do we make a move?"
Shen Yun stood beside, asking with a serious tone.
In his words, there was a hint of tension and concern.
But Han Xing understood it.
Because they were now facing a deity.
A being that truly mastered the power of rules.
To say there was no nervousness was simply impossible.
Han Xing took a deep breath,
"That guy should know we’re already here."
"In that case, let’s make our move!"
As he finished speaking.
Shen Yun directly bestowed two blessings upon everyone.
Then.
The five of them struck simultaneously!
Burning flaming arrows!
A gigantic meteorite over a kilometer in diameter.
And an overwhelming swarm of sword qi.
At this moment, all launched towards that black smoke.
The soaring flames and rampant sword qi enveloped the entire island in the sky.
"Swish swish swish!"
"Boom!"
A terrifying explosion sounded!
The combined strike of the five was enough to slay a demigod!
The black smoke began to gradually dissipate.
Everyone watched the island in the sky with tension.
They seemed to expect that, once the mist cleared.
They would see the true form of the deity!
However.
When the mist completely cleared.
What appeared before them was a collapsed Flesh and Blood Divine Hall.
This divine hall was constructed from various human tissues, covered with wriggling blood clots.
And in the center of the divine hall.
A figure knelt there.
At the instant of seeing that figure, Han Xing’s pupils contracted sharply.
"Zhou Huang!"
Upon hearing this name, everyone’s heart shuddered.
"How could this guy be here?" Cheng Jianyong asked with a face full of confusion.
However, the Zhou Huang on the ground sensed Han Xing and the others’ arrival.
Laboriously lifted his head.
He hurriedly opened his mouth to reveal wriggling eyes inside.
Zhou Huang raspily said: "Quick... run!"
At the same time, everyone suddenly felt a sense of foreboding.
The previously clear sky was instantly covered by dark clouds.
The next moment.
A black lightning bolt suddenly struck down from the sky.
