Below, those legendary beastmen were filled with confusion.
Meanwhile.
Upon discovering that the Beastman King did not attack him, Han Xing also withdrew his attack mode.
The five soared through the sky at tremendous speed under the cover of divine power.
Just then.
An aged voice echoed beside Han Xing’s ear.
"Southwest direction, proceed eighty thousand kilometers..."
Once the voice finished, the connection was abruptly cut off.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly looked back towards the Beastman Continent.
He suddenly realized.
The Beastman King might not be fully controlled yet.
Perhaps, it still retained the slightest bit of consciousness.
And this was the kind of message it conveyed to him.
"Southwest direction?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment.
Then proceeded directly in that direction.
Legendary level powerhouses have extremely fast movement speed.
A few minutes later, Han Xing arrived at the location described by the voice.
In front of everyone.
An island in the sky shrouded in black smoke appeared.
The island wasn’t large, but the black smoke on it could obscure everyone’s divine power and sight.
Even Han Xing couldn’t detect the scene within.
"Brother Xing, do we make a move?"
Shen Yun stood beside, asking with a serious tone.
In his words, there was a hint of tension and concern.
But Han Xing understood it.
Because they were now facing a deity.
A being that truly mastered the power of rules.
To say there was no nervousness was simply impossible.
Han Xing took a deep breath,
"That guy should know we’re already here."
"In that case, let’s make our move!"
As he finished speaking.
Shen Yun directly bestowed two blessings upon everyone.
Then.
The five of them struck simultaneously!
Burning flaming arrows!
A gigantic meteorite over a kilometer in diameter.
And an overwhelming swarm of sword qi.
At this moment, all launched towards that black smoke.
The soaring flames and rampant sword qi enveloped the entire island in the sky.
"Swish swish swish!"
"Boom!"
A terrifying explosion sounded!
The combined strike of the five was enough to slay a demigod!
The black smoke began to gradually dissipate.
Everyone watched the island in the sky with tension.
They seemed to expect that, once the mist cleared.
They would see the true form of the deity!
However.
When the mist completely cleared.
What appeared before them was a collapsed Flesh and Blood Divine Hall.
This divine hall was constructed from various human tissues, covered with wriggling blood clots.
And in the center of the divine hall.
A figure knelt there.
At the instant of seeing that figure, Han Xing’s pupils contracted sharply.
"Zhou Huang!"
Upon hearing this name, everyone’s heart shuddered.
"How could this guy be here?" Cheng Jianyong asked with a face full of confusion.
However, the Zhou Huang on the ground sensed Han Xing and the others’ arrival.
Laboriously lifted his head.
He hurriedly opened his mouth to reveal wriggling eyes inside.
Zhou Huang raspily said: "Quick... run!"
At the same time, everyone suddenly felt a sense of foreboding.
The previously clear sky was instantly covered by dark clouds.
The next moment.
A black lightning bolt suddenly struck down from the sky.

chapters.title: Chapter 562 - 355: Facing the Divine Spirit, The Divine Battle Begins!
paragraphs: "Boom!"
Before everyone could react.
A terrifying aura descended from the sky!
Divine might filled the heavens and earth!
At the moment that aura appeared.
Han Xing and the others heard a system prompt simultaneously.
[You have gazed upon an existence beyond the rules, your vision has been forcibly reduced by 50%...]
[You have been shrouded by the aura of an existence beyond the rules, all attributes reduced by 30%...]
[You are under the divine might of an existence beyond the rules, action capability reduced by 50%...]
Just like when encountering the God of Light before, Han Xing and the others’ attributes were drastically reduced upon contact.
However, compared to the despair of meeting the God of Light.
Now, Han Xing and the others at least possessed a bit of resistance.
"Hehehe... you finally arrived!"
The voice seemed to have been waiting for Han Xing for a long time.
This time, Han Xing and his companions did not have their vision completely stripped away.
He looked up.
And saw a massive, beastly silhouette appearing in the sky.
It had a slender body, like an elongated rat.
Sly eyes, filled with sharp, jagged teeth.
Covered in black fur, with long claws hanging in mid-air, exuding a terrifying and sinister aura!
In front of Han Xing, the attributes of this monstrous creature appeared.
[God of Tricks: Anduin]
[Level]: Unknown.
[Attributes]: Unknown.
[Skills]: Unknown.
[Divine Body]: 100%.
Note: An exceedingly ancient deity mastering the law of trickery.
[Survivors take note!]
[Survivors take note!]
[Divine Spirit Level entities possess unimaginable mighty power, survivors should quickly move away...]
Even the system warned that this entity was extremely dangerous.
It was imaginable how terrifying a Divine Spirit Level being could be!
The hearts of the team members felt as if they were being gripped by the creature’s claws, seemingly about to burst at any moment.
Yet, they forcefully suppressed the fear in their hearts, looking toward Han Xing’s back.
At this moment, an old and crafty voice appeared in the sky.
Like a witch from a fairy tale that devours humans.
"Kekeke, let me see..."
"One, two, three... as many as five rats!
"Fantastic!"
"With this, I can be entertained for a long time!"
The voice dropped.
A terrifying pressure descended upon them.
Just then.
Han Xing’s mind moved.
He was about to pull out the [Giant Beast Tail Spike] from his backpack for a deadly strike.
However.
The God of Tricks was worthy of mastering the ’Trick’ rule.
At the moment Han Xing was about to launch an attack.
It seemed to anticipate something, its crafty eyes suddenly squinting.
The action of striking stopped instantly, and its figure vanished from its original location.
"To think that it could make me feel fear, even to the point of a life-threatening danger..."
"It appears, you have quite a few secrets on you?"
Han Xing remained silent.
He just wanted to test.
To see how far the so-called deities with the ability to foresee danger and avoid harm could go.
It now seemed even more absurd than he imagined.
He hadn’t even taken action, yet it was already sensed by the entity.
However, this might be because this entity mastered the ’Trick’ rule.
Just as the God of Tricks was ready to strike again.
A burst of white light suddenly appeared on Han Xing and the others.
"Trying to run?"
In the air, the black, elongated beastly shadow seemed to realize something.
Its divine power surged, seemingly trying to seal the space.
However.
What Han Xing was using.
Was the teleportation effect of the [Oracle Throne].
[Divine Oracle Summon]!
Capable of ignoring space and location for teleportation.
Even a deity’s space seal could not affect it.
In the next moment.
The five figures vanished from their original spot.
In the sky.
The elongated beastly shadow’s waving claws halted mid-air.
Its eyes also revealed considerable surprise.
As if it hadn’t expected Han Xing and the others to escape from its grasp.
Even below, Zhou Huang’s face, once filled with despair, suddenly displayed joy.
They actually escaped from the hands of a deity!
This man was indeed more formidable than I imagined!
At this moment, the beastly shadow in the sky also noticed the joyful expression on Zhou Huang’s face.
It chuckled lightly: "Are you very happy, relieved that those little ones escaped?"
"Child of Destiny, underestimating the power of a deity makes me quite furious."
Zhou Huang’s heart sank once more, sensing an ominous feeling.
"Gurgle-gurgle..."
After a strange bubbling sound.
Then, from within the God of Tricks.
A terrifying divine might erupted.
Black fog instantly obscured the sky.
And it began to spread at an incredibly terrifying speed.
Thousands of kilometers, tens of thousands of kilometers, a hundred thousand kilometers!
It continued to expand wildly!
And then.
Enveloping the entire Beastman Kingdom completely!
The sky went completely dark.
Countless beastmen trembled in their caves in fear.
Including those legendary beastmen, they were no exception.
They knew that the terrifying presence was getting serious!
"Boom boom boom!"
In the sky, above the layer of dark clouds.
Various bolts of lightning were gathering.
But due to the obstruction of the dark clouds, it seemed to obscure something.
Making it impossible for the lightning to find a target to attack.
Only continuously unleashing their firepower.
At the same time.
In the extremely secret regions of the Holy Spirit Realm.
Ancient auras were awakening.
Deep within the Path of the Giant Dragon.
A massive creature comparable in size to a star murmured.
"This aura is, trickery? What is this guy up to again?"
On the Flame Plateau, constantly shrouded in high temperatures, a giant burning with flames awoke.
"That trickster again?"
"Why has this guy been so active lately, is he afraid that the guys in the sky won’t sense him?"
"This fool!"
Meanwhile, in the Realm of Darkness, the Sea of Light.
The three powerful races of elves, dwarves, and giants saw ancient presences awakening.
They all turned their gaze to the region where the Beastman Kingdom was located.

chapters.title: Chapter 563 - 356: So You’re the God of Tricks, Huh?
paragraphs: At this moment.
Under the overwhelming divine power of that terrifying beast shadow.
Zhou Huang lay prostrate on the ground, unable to move.
He was stripped of all senses, feeling immensely desperate.
He never imagined that the power of a Divine Spirit could be so terrifying!
It covered the entire Beastman Kingdom!
What kind of concept is this?
One needs to understand that the diameter of the Beastman Kingdom spans millions of kilometers!
Bigger than a star!
At this moment.
The God of Tricks closed its eyes in the air, seemingly searching for the whereabouts of Han Xing and others.
A moment later, it opened its eyes and chuckled softly.
"So, you’re here..."
"Little darlings, I’ll come for you right away!"
The next moment.
The figure of the God of Tricks vanished from where it was.
At the same time.
Han Xing and his group had been transported a whole million kilometers away.
Before they could relax for long, they suddenly saw the dark aura looming above.
"Damn! This exaggerated?"
Cheng Jianyong exclaimed: "Damn, the power of a Divine Spirit is truly terrifying!"
At this moment.
Han Xing suddenly received a frantic warning message from Zhou Huang.
He told Han Xing that the Divine Spirit was coming to hunt him.
Advising him to flee the Beastman Kingdom as quickly as possible.
As long as he escaped the Beastman Kingdom, that guy wouldn’t dare to continue attacking.
"Brother Xing, this guy is terrifying."
"Do we proceed directly to the next step, or do we flee?"
Han Xing shook his head and said.
"It’s already here."
"Everyone, prepare for the second wave of battle!"
As the words fell.
The terrifying figure had already appeared before Han Xing and his group!
"A bunch of little mice, you run quite fast?"
Everyone’s expression turned serious.
But by now, they didn’t have the same fear as before.
The first contact, this ancient deity didn’t instantly kill them.
Which means there’s still a fight to have!
At this moment.
Shen Yun was the first to release the Sun.
Holy light enveloped the sky above.
Everyone felt an immense power boost.
Their attributes were greatly enhanced.
"Strike, the strongest attack!" Han Xing shouted aloud.
As the words left his mouth.
Everyone began casting their strongest skills.
Han Xing instantly initiated with the [Ultimate Skill - Sun-Destroying Arrow].
As his most powerful burst skill, Han Xing launched it directly.
Then, Zhang Lianmeng’s Heaven-Burning Fire Rain Forbidden Curse.
Su Xiaoyang’s arrows filled with greens.
And Cheng Jianyong’s tens of thousands of Sword Qi.
At this moment, they all launched.
This was the strongest attack they had ever unleashed!
Even the Shadow Monarch from half a year ago would have fallen to this blow!
However.
The God of Tricks neither dodged nor evaded.
A hint of interest appeared in its narrow eyes as it smiled.
Choosing to take their attacks head-on.
"Boom!"
This strike shook the heavens and the earth.
The terrifying energy wave nearly tore the space apart!
Dense cracks appeared in the space within ten thousand miles radius.
However.
When the energy wave dissipated.
The black creature, like a mouse, bore no wounds.
Instead, it licked its lips, seemingly savoring Han Xing and the others’ attack.
In front of Han Xing, the panel attributes of the opponent appeared.
[God of Tricks: Anduin]
[Level]: Unknown
[Attributes]: Unknown
[Skills]: Unknown
[Divine Body]: 99.9%
At this moment, everyone was stunned...
The terrifying attack capable of killing a High-level Demigod landed on it.
Yet only inflicted a tiny bit of damage to its Divine Body.
Not even 1%, but a mere 0.1%!
In other words, for an attack as terrifying as just now.
They would have to unleash it a thousand more times.
To have a chance to kill the opponent!
This is too exaggerated!
How can the gap between a Demigod and a Divine Spirit be so vast?
However, the God of Tricks seemed to greatly enjoy the look of despair on their faces.
A crafty smile appeared on its lips.
"Hehe, humans, is this your limit?"
"It seems, it’s far from enough!"
Han Xing and the others drew in a cold breath.
As the opponent prepared to unleash its divine power again.
"Go!" Han Xing suddenly said.
"Huh? Trying to run again?"
"Stay here!"
The pervasive divine power suddenly solidified, seemingly sealing the surrounding space once more.
But at this moment.
Beneath Zhang Lianmeng’s feet, a dark red throne suddenly appeared.
Exactly like Han Xing’s.
Previously, Han Xing had dropped some Divine Oracle Scriptures after defeating the Dominator Level creature, Thunderfire Crystal Elemental Divine Beast.
The newly crafted Oracle Throne was given to Zhang Lianmeng by him.
Because a group transmission using the Oracle Throne comes with a cooldown.
But if it’s the second throne, used by another person, there’s no problem at all.
At this moment, the Oracle Throne once again played its role!
The five of them vanished from their original spot.
Once again escaping a million kilometers!
This distance, even for a Divine Spirit, would take some time to catch up!
At this moment.
The five already appeared at the edge of the Beastman Kingdom.
With two consecutive transports.
They effectively traversed nearly two million kilometers in an instant!
Looking at the dark clouds overhead, contrasting with the bright sky far away.
Han Xing knew, as long as they broke out of the Beastman Kingdom.
Then, this Divine Spirit likely wouldn’t dare to act further.
Han Xing took a deep breath, gritted his teeth, and said, "Charge through!"
The five, enveloped in divine power, began to advance furiously.
Seeing they were about to break out of the Beastman Kingdom’s area.
Suddenly, from behind came that familiar, sinister voice.
"Hehehe... You little mice do run fast."
"This won’t do."
"If you run away, where would I find such good toys."

chapters.title: Chapter 564 - 356: So You Call Yourself the God of Tricks, Huh? (Part 2)
paragraphs: The words fell.
It stretched out its claws, making a swinging motion.
Before the claws even descended, Han Xing and the others felt a tearing sensation on their bodies!
"Keep charging forward!"
Blood streamed from Han Xing’s body as he almost grit his teeth and shouted!
Hearing this, the other team members also buried their heads and pushed forward.
At that moment.
Han Xing’s mind stirred.
He was about to retrieve the [Giant Beast Tail Spike] once more.
However, the God of Tricks let out a scornful laugh.
"Little mouse, trying to scare me with the same trick again?"
"This time, I won’t be fooled by you again!"
The next moment.
The God of Tricks struck out with a black aura, which entered the bodies of Han Xing and his team.
Everyone felt waves of terrifying weakness washing over them, to the point of nearly fainting.
[You have been influenced by the Power of Rules, unable to use Divine Power for five minutes.]
[You have been constrained by the Power of Rules, unable to take any action for three minutes.]
Upon seeing these notifications.
Everyone’s faces filled with ominous foreboding.
At this moment.
They were like prey trapped in a cage.
They could be bitten to death by this fierce beast at any time.
"Heh heh... A few little mice, can’t move now, can you?"
"If I didn’t want to kill you so quickly."
"You would have died the moment you saw me."
However, at this moment.
Han Xing forced a faint smile.
"Who said we were going to run?"
"Bringing you here was all to take you down, wasn’t it?"
In the sky, the God of Tricks seemed completely unconvinced.
It chuckled and said, "Oh, really?"
"Are you saying you have other methods?"
"Or perhaps you’ve set a trap here?"
The God of Tricks’ lips curled up to the back of its ears.
"Humans, you severely underestimate the power of the rule of tricks."
"Before me, all your schemes are invalid.
"Including your malice and intent to kill, which I can immediately sense."
Han Xing laughed, "I know."
"But who said I was going to use schemes against you?"
"I said I’m going to take you down head-on and blast you to pieces!"
Before the God of Tricks could speak again.
It suddenly noticed.
A distant Sky Island, obscured by clouds, suddenly emitted a dazzling white light!
Those white lights contained an immense sacred aura.
"Holy Artifact!" The God of Tricks blurted out.
"You actually possess such an item?"
"No wonder you dare to challenge me so boldly."
The God of Tricks’ tone shifted.
"But even if you have a Holy Artifact, so what?"
But before it could finish its sentence.
On that Sky Island, three hundred beams of dazzling white light shot forth at an incredibly terrifying speed.
At that moment, the God of Tricks finally saw the scene on the Sky Island.
There were two steles of immense power, radiating dazzling white light.
Augmenting the Sky Island, a full three hundred gigantic Godslaying Cannons!
At this moment, the God of Tricks finally understood the confidence of these humans.
What they held wasn’t just one Holy Artifact!
But two!
This time, Han Xing ventured out, determined to ensure a one hundred percent victory.
Actually bringing out both Sun Crown Steles!

Even the God of Tricks sensed the mortal danger in that attack.
"What is this?"
"Steles?"
Han Xing did not answer.
Because at this moment, the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons had already launched their terrifying attack!
"Boom!"
As soon as the cannon was fired, Han Xing and the others felt a strong tremor.
The area where the Sky Island resided, the space shattered directly, revealing the dark Chaotic Void!
Feeling the horror of this strike, the God of Tricks decided to temporarily avoid confrontation.
"Interesting."
"But it’s still too naive to try using a Holy Artifact against me!
"You’d still need to be able to hit me."
A Divine Spirit Level creature, with near instantaneous movement speed.
Could cross millions of kilometers in just a few seconds as seen.
If Han Xing’s Energy Cannon wants to deal with it, it first needs to be able to hit it.
However, would Han Xing overlook this point?
The next moment.
Behind the God of Tricks, a round moon took shape.
It glanced behind, an expression of disdain in its eyes.
"Such a feeble Power of Rules."
"Using it to trap me, isn’t that a bit presumptuous?"
Instantly.
The previously invincible Broken Moon shattered directly.
Yet, Han Xing remained unfazed.

Su Xiaoyang’s [Elf Secret Technique—Withered Life Vine] and Zhang Lianmeng’s legendary control skill [Ice Age] were unleashed simultaneously.

A gigantic Sword Array appeared within a radius of ten thousand meters.

Four consecutive powerful control skills.
Even the God of Tricks felt as if it was sinking into a quagmire.

"Damn it!"
Divine Power rippled from its body.

That was the attack from the Godslaying Cannon, rapidly approaching!

paragraphs: Equivalent to the full force strike of 900 sets of [Spiritual Godslaying Cannons].
And the 0.1-second delay had already caused it to miss the best time to escape!
The next moment.
The terrifying light pillar directly hit the God of Deception.
"Buzz!"
A wild wind suddenly rose within hundreds of thousands of kilometers.
The space was like a calm lake that began to ripple.
Then, countless space rifts appeared.
"Crack! Crackle!"
Red humanoid lightning.
Purple snowflakes.
And an invisible hurricane.
In the territory of the Beastman Kingdom, countless Sky Islands seemed to have encountered a terrifying natural disaster.
The massive rocks weighing tens of thousands of tons were instantly blown away.
Hundreds of thousands of beastmen were swept away by the shockwave, disappearing into the boundless horizon.
"Boom!"
Only then did the sound travel out.
A thunderous noise echoed throughout the Beastman Kingdom, shocking all beastmen.
They all looked to the sky, hearts feeling as if doomsday had approached,
The power of 300 sets of [Spiritual Godslaying Cannons] was equivalent to the full force strike of a True God!
Even those powerful beings hiding in secret regions couldn’t help but pay attention.
"A True God..."
"How is there a True God-level power fluctuation?"
"Could it be, that Trick has broken through?"
However, what they didn’t know.
At this moment, the God of Deception’s heart was already in turmoil!
On its black and shiny body, a large area of injury had appeared!
The glossy fur was no longer pristine, as if it had been burned by fire, charred and blackened.
There was even smoke emitting from its body.
Not only that.
It even saw a huge wound in its abdomen blasted into existence!
"Puff!"
At the same time, injuries all over its body erupted suddenly.
The God of Deception opened its mouth, spitting out a mouthful of blood filled with divine power!
[Due to unknown reasons, the binding effect of the God of Deception’s rules has lost effect, you have regained divine power control...]
Upon hearing this notification, Han Xing smiled.
He knew that his earlier shot had already caused horrifying damage to the God of Deception.
It even rendered its rule binding ineffective.
At this moment.
The attributes of the other party appeared in front of Han Xing again.
[God of Tricks: Anduin]
[Level]: Unknown
[Attributes]: Unknown.
[Skills]: Unknown
[Divine Body]: 43.7% (Severely Injured)
One shot reduced 56% of the God of Deception’s divine body.
It also shattered the myth of the invincibility of the so-called divine spirits.
"Indeed, firepower is truth, it is justice!"
Han Xing said excitedly at this point.
"So you call yourself the God of Deception, huh?"
"Let me see how many shots you can withstand!"
His voice revealed strong confidence!
Even the faint golden divine power on his body began to transform into pure gold!
An invisible aura of an emperor overflowed from Han Xing’s body!
At this moment.
A strong shock appeared in the eyes of the God of Deception.
Looking at Han Xing, the arrogance in its gaze disappeared completely.
There was even a look of fear.
This was the first time in tens of thousands of years of its life that it felt fear from a legendary-level ant!
"Legendary level, yet has the ability to slay gods!"
"Who are you? Dayan or Hunter? Or that guy from the Abyss Realm?"
Han Xing chuckled, "I’m not those guys you mentioned."
"I’m just an ordinary human being."
"Human?"
Confused divinity appeared in the eyes of the God of Deception.
"Impossible! You can’t be a human!"
"How could the human race have someone like you?"
However, Han Xing did not respond.
Because at this time, his second energy beam was ready to go.
The God of Deception sensed a strong threat.
If it were hit by this shot again.
The God of Deception had a premonition that it would really die today!
Its deep eyes rapidly rotated.
It seemed to be hesitating, whether to run immediately.
Or first deal with these few humans!
With its speed, it could completely deal with them before the Godslaying Cannon’s attack came over!
Rationality told the God of Deception.
Don’t mind these humans, just run!
However, another voice in its heart told it.
Kill them!
These humans must have big secrets!
As long as you can kill them, these opportunities will be yours!
The God of Deception struggled continuously between these two voices.
However, Han Xing seemed to have seen through its thoughts.
He chuckled softly, "Are you thinking of taking me out before the defense tower’s attack arrives?"
The God of Deception was taken aback.
Han Xing continued: "Your thinking is correct."
"With your speed, you could definitely kill us all in an instant, making my Godslaying Cannons useless."
Han Xing actively exposed his weakness.
However, the more the God of Deception listened, the more frightened it became.
The rules it mastered conveyed a message to itself.
Don’t care about any secrets anymore.
Run quickly!
If you don’t leave, you’ll really die!
However, this human’s voice, like the whispering of a devil, rang in its ear again.
"Try it, God of Deception."
"As long as you kill me, not only will you directly get two holy artifacts, but the thing in my backpack will also fall into your hands."
"You don’t even know what that is, do you?"
"It’s something that can deal with True Gods, even making them fall."
"The core part of an ancient fierce beast."
"Come on, God of Deception!"
"Kill me, and they’re all yours."
Han Xing spread his hands, with a mad smile on his face.
At this moment, the God of Deception only felt a daze.
Damn it!
Why is this kid so sinister?
Who is the real God of Deception here?
At this moment, the God of Deception seemed to come back to its senses.
"Human, you want to deceive me, wishful thinking!"
Smoke covered the God of Deception.
It intended to disappear from its original spot.
Han Xing sighed with regret.
"Indeed, you guys have become wise with age, not so easy to trick."
At this moment.
A gem exuding endless greenness appeared in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 566 - 357: Curtain Falls, God-Defier
paragraphs: The moment that gem appeared.
The God of Tricks trembled inside.
Another sacred artifact!
Damn it!
How many treasures does this kid have on him?
At the same time.
A strong aura emerged from the green sacred artifact in Han Xing’s hand.
The space of ten thousand miles was filled with countless thick vines.
The target of these vines was only one.
That was the God of Tricks.
At this moment, the God of Tricks was about to teleport away, to distance himself from this terrifying guy.
Suddenly, he found his actions severely restricted.
Even if his divine power burst forth, destroying hundreds of thousands of vines in an instant.
But more vines would immediately entangle him.
"Damn it, what is this thing?"
Han Xing did not answer.
This was naturally the special effect of [Sacred Artifact: Heart of the Endless Tree Sea].

[Endless Entanglement]: Instantly releases countless vines, forcibly controlling the enemy for 3 seconds~100 seconds, and drains 30~100 divine power points from the opponent, with a 12-hour cooldown in the mortal realm. (Can exert control effects on a True God.)
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[Endless Entanglement successfully released, 100 divine power points absorbed from the opponent.]
The moment he heard the system prompt, Han Xing knew.
His control skill had taken effect.
And this also meant that the God of Tricks was doomed today!
One must know that even a True God, immersed in the rules,
has to be controlled by Endless Entanglement for at least three seconds.
And in three seconds,
is enough for Han Xing to blast the enemy to pieces!
At this moment, the God of Tricks also realized his current predicament.
Today, he might really die at the hands of this human!
As the terrifying energy beam was about to strike,
the God of Tricks suddenly let out sound waves towards the sky.
"Soul, Blood Shadow, save me!"
In order to survive, he unexpectedly abandoned the dignity of a divine spirit and called for help from other ancient beings!
Hearing the cry for help,
the ancient beings in those hidden places were shocked.
They even thought they had heard it wrong.
At this moment, an existence covered in blood red was stunned.
It hurriedly released the Divine Stone to communicate with other ancient beings.
For beings of their level, consciousness communication could be completed in an instant.
Then, these ancient beings confirmed.
Just now, it really was the God of Tricks calling for help!
My goodness!
What exactly did he encounter?
This guy is a divine spirit!
"Let’s go see, even if we’re discovered by the power of the Holy Spirit Realm, we must know what’s happening to the God of Tricks!"
These ancient beings reached a consensus.
At this moment.
They’d rather take great risks to gather the Eye of the Divine Spirit and look towards the God of Tricks’ location.
However, what they saw was indeed darkness.
The God of Tricks’ black mist not only blocked the heavenly mechanisms but also obscured the prying of other divine spirits.
"Damn it, that fool of a trickster!"
"Act together and break through the trickster’s black mist barrier!"
At the same time.
The previously dark sky suddenly shot in more than a dozen beams of light.
Han Xing suddenly sensed many terrifying auras appearing in the sky.
They simultaneously locked their gazes below.
Then, they saw an astonishing scene.
In the void, countless vines were emerging, tightly entangling the God of Tricks.
And not far away, a beam of energy was hurtling swiftly towards them.
Even these divine spirits felt a deadly crisis from the aura emitted by that energy beam!
"What is that pillar of light? An energy cannon?"
"Damn it, how can the Holy Spirit Realm have such a terrifying energy weapon?"
At this moment, another puzzled voice arose.
"Is that trickster about to die?"
The beings enduring the thunder suddenly realized something, all showing shocked expressions.
"Go save the trickster!"
"He cannot die, we still need him for our operations in the Holy Spirit Realm later!"
But then.
Han Xing’s icy voice suddenly sounded.
"Come on, today I want to see who dares to save him!"
"Whoever comes, I will kill them!"
Han Xing’s voice carried an infinite arrogance!
He was actually issuing a death threat to the entire divine level existence of the Holy Spirit Realm!
At this moment.
That group of divine spirits finally noticed the few humans beside the God of Tricks.
Initially, because their aura was just too weak.
They didn’t attract the attention of this group of divine spirits at all.
But now, from the moment Han Xing spoke those words,
all the divine spirits focused their attention on that young man.
At this moment, connecting the situation on the field, they instantly understood something.
The trickster ended up in this situation because of this human.
But, he is just a legend, right?
How could he possess such terrifying means!
However, no matter how much they didn’t believe it, the facts were right in front of them.
The divine spirits fell silent.
Seeing this, Han Xing already understood, those ancient beings had been intimidated by him.
They wouldn’t come to aid the God of Tricks anymore.
At this time, Han Xing, with a victorious smile on his lips, looked at the sky.
A human not even at the level of a demigod threatening a group of divine spirits.
This was just too arrogant, too presumptuous!
And he had the basis for his arrogance.
At this moment, the severely wounded God of Tricks was the best evidence.
And at this very moment.
The thunder brewing in the sky for a long time seemed to finally find a place to strike.
"Rumble!"
At this moment.
At least a dozen special-shaped lightning bolts fell on those hidden places in the Holy Spirit Realm.
"Damn it! We’ve been discovered!"
"Quickly block these Destruction Divine Thunders!"
The sky of the Holy Spirit Realm seemed to be extremely furious at this moment.
Angry that this group of beings actually deceived it.

That group of divine spirits finally noticed the few humans beside the God of Tricks.
Initially, because their aura was just too weak.
They didn’t attract the attention of this group of divine spirits at all.
But now, from the moment Han Xing spoke those words,
all the divine spirits focused their attention on that young man.
At this moment, connecting the situation on the field, they instantly understood something.
The trickster ended up in this situation because of this human.
But, he is just a legend, right?
How could he possess such terrifying means!
However, no matter how much they didn’t believe it, the facts were right in front of them.
The divine spirits fell silent.
Seeing this, Han Xing already understood, those ancient beings had been intimidated by him.
They wouldn’t come to aid the God of Tricks anymore.
At this time, Han Xing, with a victorious smile on his lips, looked at the sky.
A human not even at the level of a demigod threatening a group of divine spirits.
This was just too arrogant, too presumptuous!
And he had the basis for his arrogance.
At this moment, the severely wounded God of Tricks was the best evidence.
And at this very moment.
The thunder brewing in the sky for a long time seemed to finally find a place to strike.
"Rumble!"
At this moment.
At least a dozen special-shaped lightning bolts fell on those hidden places in the Holy Spirit Realm.
"Damn it!
We’ve been discovered!"
"Quickly block these Destruction Divine Thunders!"
The sky of the Holy Spirit Realm seemed to be extremely furious at this moment.
Angry that this group of beings actually deceived it.

chapters.title: Chapter 567 - 357: Curtain Falls, God-Defier
paragraphs: The ancient divine spirits who had just released strands of divine power were caught in a storm of violent thunder!
"Boom!"
"Crack!"
On this day, it seemed some great upheaval had occurred in the Holy Spirit Realm.
The sky was continuously rumbling.
In spots rarely visited normally, all were being baptized by thunder!
"Ah! Damn it!"
"I can hardly hold on!!"
"Help me!"
At this moment, those ancient beings could no longer care about anything else.
Although Han Xing couldn’t see what was happening in the Holy Spirit Realm.
He also noticed that the aura had entirely retreated.
At this time, Han Xing’s mouth curled into a victorious smile.
Because, with this.
There would no longer be anyone who could save the God of Tricks.
He would die for sure today!
It’s a long story.
But in reality, only three or four seconds had passed.
At this moment.
The God of Tricks was still ensnared by the vines of the Endless Tree Sea, unable to break free.
The control effects of the holy artifact far exceeded Han Xing’s skills!
At this moment, the God of Tricks seemed to also realize.
The retreat of those divine spirits.
Things had developed beyond its expectations.
The look in its eyes showed shock.
Because it already saw.
Three hundred Spiritual Godslaying Cannons emitting dazzling light.
Then, that awe-inspiring aura appeared again, making people kneel.
"Rumble!"
The entire space of hundreds of thousands of kilometers shattered completely.
The God of Tricks screamed in despair.
"I am the God of Tricks, Anduin!"
"Even in the Age of Ten Thousand Gods, I did not fall."
"How can I die?"
"How could I possibly die?"
However, Han Xing’s cold voice came.
"Shut up.
"In this world, no one is immortal."
"Including you gods, it’s the same!"
In the next moment.
The attack of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon completely burst forth.
A thick beam of light appeared.
The space of hundreds of thousands of kilometers, and scores of Beastman Sky Islands were torn apart by the violent void energy.
At least over a billion beastmen were caught in the aftershock of the fight and met untimely deaths.
Han Xing’s cannon shot was comparable to the attack of a True God.
Even the aftermath was enough to obliterate an entire race.
However.
As expected, the system prompt announcing the death of the God of Tricks, Anduin, did not appear.
This brought a look of surprise to Han Xing’s eyes.
When the berserk energy dissipated.
Han Xing saw a colossal beastly figure appear.
The God of Tricks was bombarded to the brink of death at this moment.
"Not dead?" Han Xing was astonished.
He quickly checked the God of Tricks’ panel attributes.
[Divine Body]: 7.7% (Near Death)
This shot only reduced the God of Tricks’ divine body value by less than 40%.
Though it pushed the God of Tricks into a near-death state.
It was still lower than Han Xing’s expectation.
He knew the first cannon shot had taken a full 56% of the God of Tricks’ divine body.
The second shot hit completely, yet did not instantly kill it.
In the next moment.
Han Xing understood why the God of Tricks had not been taken down with one shot.
Nearby the beastly shadow, two human-like figures appeared.
One clad in black armor, wielding a Shadow Greatsword.
It was the Shadow Monarch, who had vanished for half a year.
The sight of the figure next to him made Han Xing’s pupils constrict.
It was a hooded woman.
With a seductive figure, dressed in a loose black robe.
Yet you could still tell she had an exaggeratedly voluptuous form.
However, this was not what Han Xing focused on.
He focused on the woman’s appearance.
It was identical to what he had seen in the Secret Realm before.
Han Xing took a deep breath, setting aside all those thoughts.
Because he still had important business to attend to.
Han Xing knew.
It was these two who helped the God of Tricks bear most of the attack.
Though he didn’t know what means they had used.
To withstand the concentrated fire of his Godslaying Cannon.
But this only stirred Han Xing’s killing intent.
"Dark Shadow, are you seeking death by obstructing me?" Han Xing asked very seriously.
The Shadow Monarch lifted his head, giving Han Xing a deep look.
Just not long ago.
He could manipulate this human race individual as he pleased.
Even, to contend against him.
The Witch Race didn’t hesitate to submit their entire race to the other side’s authority, only barely managing to counter him.
And now.
Within merely half a year.
This human race had gained power enough to crush him.
And was now even taking on terrifying divine spirits!
Moreover, nearly succeeding.
Glance at the God of Tricks’ tragic state for proof.
Just now, had he and that woman not joined forces, using some powerful supreme defense treasure.
Otherwise, even themselves would have been taken out by that horrifying energy cannon in a single burst of concentrated fire!
Not waiting for Han Xing to speak.
The seductive woman beside him chuckled gently.
"Oh my~ This generation’s Master of the Human Race is truly a hothead~"
"Don’t be in such a hurry, can you be a little gentler to me~"
Her voice seemed to carry a special magic.
Capable of tempting one’s mind.
[You are being disrupted by Desire Witch’s voice of temptation, determining spirit values between both parties...]
[Determination successful, your spirit value has met the requirement, this disruption state is immune...]
Han Xing looked at the system prompt.
A trace of a cold smile flashed in his eyes,
"Foul woman."
"If you dare use mental attacks to charm me again, I’ll kill you first."
The sultry woman’s body trembled.
She seemed not to expect that Han Xing was completely unaffected by her voice of temptation.
A moment later.
She slowly lifted her hood.
Revealing a face of unparalleled beauty.
It was a kind of extremely alluring beauty.

chapters.title: Chapter 568 - 357: Curtain Falls, God-Defier
paragraphs: Delicate features, akin to the world’s most perfect artwork.
Enchanting beauty, perhaps this is how such a person would be described.
Her appearance, even caused Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang nearby to be somewhat mesmerized.
"So beautiful..."
The two women couldn’t help but whisper softly.
The next moment, they realized the person before them was their enemy.
Hurriedly covering their mouths.
Han Xing looked at the woman, spoke again: "I’ll give you three seconds."
"Hand over the God of Tricks."
"Otherwise, I’ll take you all down together!"
The seductive woman’s face slightly changed, then revealed a charming smile.
"Master of the Human Race, why must you always think of fighting and killing."
"I’d like to discuss cooperation with you."
"Three."
Unmoved, Han Xing began a countdown.
At this moment.
The Spiritual Godslaying Cannon once again entered a charging state.
The seductive woman’s smile slightly trembled.
"Master of the Human Race, I genuinely want to discuss cooperation with you."
"As long as you release the God of Tricks, I’ll give you unimaginable benefits!"
"One."
With these words, Han Xing directly activated all Spiritual Godslaying Cannons to attack mode.
The blinding white light started to gather again.
The seductive woman’s face stiffened.
She didn’t expect Han Xing to be so decisive.
Is he determined to eliminate them no matter what?
However.
What she didn’t know.
Because she stopped Han Xing from killing the God of Tricks.
He missed the first-kill reward.
Remember.
When Han Xing first killed a Demigod Level Giant Dragon, the system rewarded him with a Holy Artifact Set.
Now, if he achieves the feat of first-kill among divine spirits.
What terrifying reward will the system give him?
How much will his power enhance?
Just thinking about it fills him with immense anticipation.
Yet now, suddenly two sneaky entities popped up to stop him.
How could Han Xing not feel angry!
But fortunately, it could still be salvaged.
As long as another shot is fired.
Han Xing believes he could absolutely annihilate the Shadow God completely!
As for these two demigods before him.
Han Xing no longer deemed them worthy of concern.
Although he doesn’t have other strong control skills in hand.
Nonetheless, Han Xing still possesses an unused trump card.
Enough to deal with these two demigods!
Seemingly recognizing Han Xing’s determination to kill the God of Tricks,
The seductive woman gently waved a hand, and a space fluctuation appeared.
A peculiar purple vortex appeared beside them.
The vortex resembled a teleportation gate.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly felt a power of restriction.
[You have been imprisoned by the Desire Witch’s divine power, your actions are restricted, the effect lasts five seconds...]
Han Xing frowned.
For five seconds, he wouldn’t be able to move.
Although he could still attack.
But, he appears to have no means to stop them.
Watching the teleportation gate forming.
Han Xing coldly said at this moment, "If you take the God of Tricks away today."
"I swear, no matter where you flee, I will drag you out and blast you to pieces!"
Listening to Han Xing’s threat,
The seductive woman knew he was serious.
If it were someone else, she might completely disregard it.
But this man before her, indeed, with Legendary Power, was one who slays gods.
It’s hard to assure that such a day won’t arrive in the future.
Moments later, she sighed deeply.
"Master of the Human Race, the Trick cannot die yet."
"If you were going to kill other divine spirits today, I absolutely wouldn’t intervene."
"But Trick is of great use to me."
Before she finished, Han Xing retorted, "What does it matter to me?"
"Today, I am here to kill it!"
"Whoever blocks me, dies!"
At this point, the seductive woman gazed deeply at Han Xing.
"Then there is no choice."
"Although I don’t want to offend you, Trick cannot die."
With these words, a divine power enveloped both the Shadow Monarch and the God of Tricks.
And gradually disappeared into the purple vortex.
"You won’t escape!"
At the moment Han Xing was about to take out the Divine Beast Tail Spike for a lethal strike,
An unexpected voice came to his ear.
"Master of the Human Race, I’ll provide you with some positions..."
"As the condition for saving the God of Tricks this time..."
Upon hearing the content of the voice,
Han Xing’s heart slightly moved.
And the hand he was about to use to attack, hovered in mid-air.
Han Xing gazed deeply at the woman’s back.
Until she completely disappeared with the God of Tricks and the Shadow Monarch into the purple vortex.
Meanwhile, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun and the others beside him, looked at Han Xing with perplexed eyes.
At the same time.
The black clouds that covered the entire Beastman Kingdom slowly began to dissipate with the departure of the God of Tricks.
Trillions of beastmen hiding in caves were now blankly looking up.
They felt the oppressive sensation of death was gone.
Countless acquaintances poked their heads out of caves.
With a mixture of tension and unease, they asked in faint voices.
"Has the divine... punishment finally ended?"
"So terrifying, I thought the end of the world was coming!"
"Indeed, what exactly happened?"
The divine-level battle, to them, was practically like the end of the world.
But beyond those ancient beings in the Holy Spirit Realm,
These ordinary beastmen had no idea what had transpired.
Even those of the Legendary Level among the beastmen were in a bewildered state.
The God of Tricks’ last cries for help could only be sensed by ancient beings of its same level.
Han Xing gazed at the gradually brightening sky.
At this moment, a system notification appeared.
[You have successfully repelled the God of Tricks, this is a battle worthy of being inscribed in history, you and your team have delivered an astounding performance.]
[World influence +2374 for all team members, your Legend Points +100, all team member Legend Points +50.]
[Received Title: God-Defier!]
[God-Defier]: Divine Power Value +10%, additional 15% damage to enemies whose divine power exceeds own.
Note: To confront divine spirits, one must first conquer the inner fear of them, congratulations, you have taken the first step.

chapters.title: Chapter 569 - 358: Divine Treasure Vault, Liberation
paragraphs: Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong simultaneously showed expressions of surprise and joy on their faces.
This indicated that they too heard the same system notifications.
"The title of God-Defier!"
"And 50 Legendary Points!"
"Wow, such generous rewards!" Cheng Jianyong said excitedly.
Beside him, Shen Yun’s face also displayed an excited smile.
"I didn’t expect defeating the God of Tricks to reward us with so many Legendary Points."
"With this, we can draw a second Legendary Skill!"
Legendary Points are just enough to draw a second skill.
Each Legendary Skill can significantly aid everyone.
And this was only the reward for repelling the God of Tricks.
If Han Xing had successfully slain the opponent just now.
The rewards the group received would certainly be even more terrifying!
At this moment, the team members thought of this.
They all looked towards Han Xing.
Shen Yun asked in confusion, "Brother Xing, why didn’t you kill the God of Tricks just now?"
"If you let it go this time, won’t it be hard to find such an opportunity again next time?"
Cheng Jianyong also chimed in, "Yeah... And with this, won’t those cursed civilians in the Witch Race Territory have no chance of recovery?"
Han Xing shook his head,
"Don’t worry, those cursed civilians will recover."
"Including the curses on the Tree Spirit Race and the Beastman Race, they will also disappear."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s face showed expressions of confusion and puzzlement.
Han Xing explained at this time.
"The reason I let the God of Tricks go in the end."
"Is because that woman made a deal with me."
"A deal?" everyone became even more puzzled.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Yes."
"As a price for letting the God of Tricks go, she agreed to lift everyone’s cursed state."
"And, she also told me a few locations."
"In these locations, there are other divine formats of the Elemental God’s attributes."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun took a deep breath.
Even Zhang Lianmeng, who was standing nearby, flashed a look of surprise in her eyes.
The divine format of the Elemental God, everyone already knew its use.
A single divine format can allow a Legendary Powerhouse to break through to Demigod after reaching the Legendary Limit.
And it doesn’t reduce one’s level.
After gathering seven different elemental divine formats, one can transfer to the Supreme Hidden Profession, Elemental Law God!
Right now, in the Holy Spirit Realm.
The value of a single divine format is even more terrifying than a Divine Artifact.
If more can be obtained, this force could even have several more Demigod Level powerhouses.
Cheng Jianyong at this moment realized, "I see, that’s why Brother Xing agreed to let the God of Tricks go."
"Exchanging the lifting of curses and a few divine format clues for the life of the God of Tricks is indeed not bad."
Everyone nodded together.
In their hearts, the feeling of loss from letting the God of Tricks go had already dissipated.
However, what they didn’t know was.
Besides these two conditions.
The woman also added one more condition!
That is, the location of the God of Tricks’ Divine Treasure Vault.
It’s hidden somewhere special in the Holy Spirit Realm.
This condition is what truly tempted Han Xing.
As is known.
The God of Tricks, being an ancient divine spirit, has seen countless treasures in its lifetime.
During its tens of thousands of years of life, it hid these treasures in one place.
The Divine Treasure Vault!
And there are surely unimaginable amounts of precious treasures in its vault!
Various Divine Golds, Divine Artifacts!
Everything needed is there.
It’s definitely much stronger than the foundation of the Witch Race’s vault!
If it can be found, Han Xing will strike it rich!
The materials collected from the remains of the beast last time.
Have already been mostly used by Han Xing to construct the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon.
With his current power, it’s more than enough to deal with a divine spirit.
But Han Xing also realized.
The divine spirits hiding in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Are far more than one.
The auras that came to probe today numbered at least a dozen.
Therefore, Han Xing still needs more, stronger power!
Before he can dominate the Holy Spirit Realm, Han Xing doesn’t feel secure!
As for whether the God of Tricks will come back for revenge after escaping this time.
Han Xing has no worries at all.
As long as it dares to come, Han Xing is confident that it will never return.
After all, if Han Xing can kill it the first time.
He can kill it a second time.
At this moment, Shen Yun leaned over to Han Xing and said softly.
"Brother Xing, it feels like that woman in the hood is not simple."
"It seems like everything is under her control."
"I really don’t know what she’s plotting."
Han Xing nodded.
This woman is indeed not simple.
She knows so many hidden places in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Even knowing the location of the Divine Treasure Vault.
That is the most secretive place to a divine spirit.
Moreover.
Han Xing also faintly felt.
Helas’ death last time might also be related to this woman.
According to High Priest Xiao.
The Ancestral God Altar of the Witch Race was taken by the Shadow Monarch.
The Shadow Monarch was also with this woman.
And the Ancestral God Altar, is said to be a tool used by the Witch Race to contact the Ancient Witch God.
Han Xing doesn’t know what they want the Ancestral God Altar for.
But it certainly isn’t anything good.
Han Xing took a deep breath.
Through this great battle today.
He saw so much.
In the Holy Spirit Realm.
Many ancient existences are plotting.
This woman too, and those divine spirits as well.
So far.
Han Xing doesn’t know what their purposes are.
A moment later, Han Xing shook his head.

sentences.text: Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong simultaneously showed expressions of surprise and joy on their faces.
This indicated that they too heard the same system notifications.
"The title of God-Defier!"
"And 50 Legendary Points!"
"Wow, such generous rewards!" Cheng Jianyong said excitedly.
Beside him, Shen Yun’s face also displayed an excited smile.
"I didn’t expect defeating the God of Tricks to reward us with so many Legendary Points."
"With this, we can draw a second Legendary Skill!"
Legendary Points are just enough to draw a second skill.
Each Legendary Skill can significantly aid everyone.
And this was only the reward for repelling the God of Tricks.
If Han Xing had successfully slain the opponent just now.
The rewards the group received would certainly be even more terrifying!
At this moment, the team members thought of this.
They all looked towards Han Xing.
Shen Yun asked in confusion, "Brother Xing, why didn’t you kill the God of Tricks just now?"
"If you let it go this time, won’t it be hard to find such an opportunity again next time?"
Cheng Jianyong also chimed in, "Yeah...
And with this, won’t those cursed civilians in the Witch Race Territory have no chance of recovery?"
Han Xing shook his head,
"Don’t worry, those cursed civilians will recover."
"Including the curses on the Tree Spirit Race and the Beastman Race, they will also disappear."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s face showed expressions of confusion and puzzlement.
Han Xing explained at this time.
"The reason I let the God of Tricks go in the end."
"Is because that woman made a deal with me."
"A deal?" everyone became even more puzzled.
Han Xing nodded and said, "Yes."
"As a price for letting the God of Tricks go, she agreed to lift everyone’s cursed state."
"And, she also told me a few locations."
"In these locations, there are other divine formats of the Elemental God’s attributes."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun took a deep breath.
Even Zhang Lianmeng, who was standing nearby, flashed a look of surprise in her eyes.
The divine format of the Elemental God, everyone already knew its use.
A single divine format can allow a Legendary Powerhouse to break through to Demigod after reaching the Legendary Limit.
And it doesn’t reduce one’s level.
After gathering seven different elemental divine formats, one can transfer to the Supreme Hidden Profession, Elemental Law God!
Right now, in the Holy Spirit Realm.
The value of a single divine format is even more terrifying than a Divine Artifact.
If more can be obtained, this force could even have several more Demigod Level powerhouses.
Cheng Jianyong at this moment realized, "I see, that’s why Brother Xing agreed to let the God of Tricks go."
"Exchanging the lifting of curses and a few divine format clues for the life of the God of Tricks is indeed not bad."
Everyone nodded together.
In their hearts, the feeling of loss from letting the God of Tricks go had already dissipated.
However, what they didn’t know was.
Besides these two conditions.
The woman also added one more condition!
That is, the location of the God of Tricks’ Divine Treasure Vault.
It’s hidden somewhere special in the Holy Spirit Realm.
This condition is what truly tempted Han Xing.
As is known.
The God of Tricks, being an ancient divine spirit, has seen countless treasures in its lifetime.
During its tens of thousands of years of life, it hid these treasures in one place.
The Divine Treasure Vault!
And there are surely unimaginable amounts of precious treasures in its vault!
Various Divine Golds, Divine Artifacts!
Everything needed is there.
It’s definitely much stronger than the foundation of the Witch Race’s vault!
If it can be found, Han Xing will strike it rich!
The materials collected from the remains of the beast last time.
Have already been mostly used by Han Xing to construct the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon.
With his current power, it’s more than enough to deal with a divine spirit.
But Han Xing also realized.
The divine spirits hiding in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Are far more than one.
The auras that came to probe today numbered at least a dozen.
Therefore, Han Xing still needs more, stronger power!
Before he can dominate the Holy Spirit Realm, Han Xing doesn’t feel secure!
As for whether the God of Tricks will come back for revenge after escaping this time.
Han Xing has no worries at all.
As long as it dares to come, Han Xing is confident that it will never return.
After all, if Han Xing can kill it the first time.
He can kill it a second time.

chapters.title: Chapter 570 - 358: Divine Treasure Vault, Liberation_2
paragraphs: Put aside all thoughts.
No matter what these guys are plotting.
As long as Han Xing maintains his own rhythm.
Time and again, demonstrating power beyond their imagination.
By then, no matter what those ancient beings are scheming.
Han Xing won’t be without the ability to protect himself on the day the situation explodes.
At this moment.
Han Xing’s communication jade suddenly started vibrating.
Han Xing glanced at the message.
It was sent by Wu Ling’Er.
As soon as he clicked it, he heard Wu Ling’Er’s surprised voice.
"Brother Xing! It’s a success!"
"The curses on the bodies of our clansmen have been lifted, and their bodies are rapidly recovering."
"Brother Xing, you’re amazing, truly incredible!"
"I can hardly believe how you managed to do it."
Listening to Wu Ling’Er’s excited cheers.
A hint of a smile appeared on Han Xing’s lips.
He certainly understood why Wu Ling’Er was so excited.
After all, this time they were dealing with a divine spirit.
Even in the most glorious period of the Witch Race’s ten-thousand-year history, they wouldn’t dare claim to contend with such a being.
But Han Xing actually did it.
Not only repelled the God of Tricks but also lifted the curse from the Witch Race People.
It’s simply unimaginable!
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly realized.
That alluring woman truly fulfilled her promises to him.
And very quickly.
Han Xing smiled and replied, "It’s good as long as they are recovering."
At this moment.
On the Witch Race Continent.
Countless Witch Race People looked at each other excitedly.
Their minds gradually cleared, and the decayed flesh on their bodies began to quickly recover.
At this moment, all the Witch Race People walked out of the shelter simultaneously.
They knelt on the street, looking up at the sky.
"Great Saint Master Han Xing! We are forever grateful to you!"
"Saint Master, you are the light of hope for our Witch Race, we are willing to be eternally loyal to you!"
"Praise the great Saint Master Han Xing!"
They knew it was Saint Master Han Xing who saved them once again.
Each person was in tears.
Including the infected high-level officers.
Also awakened from their chaotic state at this moment.
Then, the image of that man appeared in their minds simultaneously.
A fervent expression appeared in their eyes.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing heard a series of system prompts in his ear.
[Your actions have impressed the Witch Race’s seventh commander: Kalina, and her affinity has improved (current affinity 71: Close Friend)]
[Your actions have impressed the Witch Race’s third commander: Kathy, and her affinity has improved (current affinity 83, Trust)]
[Due to your actions...]
On Han Xing’s affinity interface, hundreds of new characters appeared simultaneously.
A hint of a smile appeared on his lips.
"Ling’Er, it’s fine as long as everything is okay."
Han Xing responded back using the communication jade.
"Go and notify the soldiers, once the clansmen in the underground shelters have fully recovered, they can let them out."
"Okay okay!" Wu Ling’Er quickly agreed.
A moment later.
Wu Ling’Er suddenly asked tentatively, "Brother Xing, when can you come back?"
Han Xing thought for a moment.
Then said, "Maybe in a while, I have some things to do outside."
Upon hearing this, Wu Ling’Er’s mood suddenly dropped a bit.
"Alright then..."
She felt a slight sense of loss.
This time with Han Xing gone, Wu Ling’Er had been on edge.
Even in her heart, she had prepared herself for the worst outcome.
But fortunately, he succeeded again.
Just like before, victorious in every battle.
Wu Ling’Er deeply longed to be embraced by Han Xing at this moment.
However.
Han Xing indeed had matters to attend to now.
Next.
He not only needed to find the remaining six divine formats but also open the Divine Treasure Vault of the God of Tricks.
Along the way, see if there are clues about the Holy Artifact Set.
If possible, he also needed to visit the territories of the three great races.
Especially the Dwarf Race.
This time, he exposed too much.
Now, the Holy Spirit Realm’s Divine Spirit Level experts all know he has means to deal with divine spirits.
Until he gains more cards, or before he breaks through to demigod,
Han Xing holds the strongest vigilance against these divine spirits.
Therefore, he must seize the time to enhance himself.
Or enhance the power of his team members.
Anyway, he left dozens of [Spiritual Godslaying Cannons] at the Witch Race side.
At least the defense side is not a problem.
After comforting Wu Ling’Er a few words, Han Xing ended the communication.
At this moment.
Cheng Jianyong walked over excitedly and said.
"Brother Xing, what’s our next step?"
"Is it directly to find the remaining six divine formats?"
Han Xing shook his head.
"These six divine formats are scattered too far, and they are extremely distant from us."
"If we go over, just the travel time would take nearly half a year."
"Besides, several places are extremely dangerous."
Pausing, Han Xing said: "Now, let’s go and see that Beastman King first."
"This time, we helped them a lot."
"These guys have to show some appreciation, right?"
Han Xing is certainly not a selfless person.
As long as he puts in effort, he expects a corresponding return.
This time, they repelled the Shadow God.
Equivalent to saving the Beastman Kingdom, trillions of beastmen.
Among them, there are at least a hundred legends, and a demigod level Beastman King.
Others hearing this, also showed a smile of course on their faces.
As the saying goes, people with different views cannot be forced together.
They all shared the same thoughts with Han Xing.

chapters.title: Chapter 571 - 358: Divine Treasure Vault, Liberation_3
paragraphs: Everyone took the risk of their lives this time to battle with the Divine Spirits.
Shouldn’t there be some rewards?
As the words fell.
The five figures flickered, appearing on Sky Island.
Then, they swaggered into the territory of the Beastman Kingdom and advanced towards their Central Continent.
At this moment.
In the Sky Island Forest, the center of the Tree Sea Continent.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots looked at its body in astonishment.
The once decaying and foul-smelling flesh had actually begun to stop eroding its body.
And all the densely packed eyeballs on it had disappeared completely.
At this moment.
A strong shock appeared in the eyes of this Ancient Tree!
Because it knew, those humans had succeeded.
"Oh my, they actually lifted the curse!"
"How did they manage to do it?"
"Could it be, did they really kill the God of Tricks?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots was startled by its own thoughts.
It was merely a Demigod level existence.
It had no qualifications or ability to investigate battles at the Divine Level.
So, it didn’t know what had ultimately happened.
"No, if the God of Tricks had been killed by them, we would all sense it."
"Exactly what... happened?"
The Ancient Tree pondered for a long time but couldn’t come up with a conclusion.
It quickly brushed these thoughts aside.
Then, excitedly checked its own body.
At this moment, the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots felt like it was in a dream.
For thousands of years, it had never felt this momentary unreality in front of its eyes.
However, the facts before it told it.
This was real.
It watched its body as those rotten parts gradually turned black, solidified, and were about to fall off.
This proved that the terrifying curse had truly vanished from its body.
"Great."
"Great..."
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots wept tears of joy.
Although the source of the curse had been severed.
Because it was eroded by this curse for so long.
It would also take a very long time to recover.
Moreover, these completely necrotic parts couldn’t be used anymore.
It needed to expel these parts bit by bit.
Imagine that.
It would take the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots at least a very long time to recover.
However, despite this.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots already felt content.
In its heart, it felt a strong gratitude towards those humans.
It also felt that its previous sacrifices were completely worth it!
So what if it had to sacrifice a Holy Artifact?
So what if it had to sacrifice part of the Life Tree Heart?
It was previously only worried that Han Xing would cheat and run away with its Holy Artifacts.
But now, it didn’t need to worry about this anymore.
At least.
The others took the things and actually did the task.
At this moment.
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots murmured: "Although it’s unclear whether the God of Tricks is dead."
"But the curse on me is gone, which means, they definitely succeeded."
"With legendary power, they defeated Divine Spirits."
"Has this kind of thing ever happened before?"
The Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots pondered for a moment but couldn’t find any records about this.
"Is another Hunter or Demon Emperor level powerhouse about to emerge from the Holy Spirit Realm?"
Deep in the Path of the Giant Dragon.
The Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser was summoned in great fear by that ancient presence.
"Ancestor, you called me?"
The colossal figure slowly opened its eyes.
"Little Golden Dragon, did you just sense it?"
Hawthorne Glaser said in fear: "I sensed it."
"The God of Tricks was calling for help!"
Indeed.
The God of Tricks emitted a distress signal that only those of the Divine level could hear.
And the Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser clearly had such power.
The Golden Dragon asked in shock: "Ancestor, what kind of existence is battling the God of Tricks?"
The colossal figure sighed: "He has grown stronger again."
Hawthorne Glaser was at a loss after hearing it.
It didn’t know who the Dragon Ancestor referred to as he.
At this time, the Dragon Ancestor continued: "That human."
"What!?
The Golden Dragon’s pupils instantly constricted, and it couldn’t help but exclaim!
It swore that it had never lost composure like this before.
Because it knew who the Dragon Ancestor referred to as that human.
"Isn’t he legendary?"
"How could he possibly possess the power to slay a god?"
The Golden Dragon’s doubts filled its heart, eagerly seeking an answer.
The Dragon Ancestor did not answer.
After a moment, it sighed and said: "Last time, the task that woman entrusted you with, do not continue it."
"Also, immediately stop the layout for the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
"As long as we old ones don’t come forth now."
"There are no forces in the entire Holy Spirit Realm that can contend with the current humans."
Hawthorne Glaser, hearing the ancestor’s solemn instructions, also understood the seriousness of the matter.
After all, that was the power of godslaying!
Without a Divine Spirit appearing.
Who would dare act rashly in front of that group of humans?
It nodded with difficulty, "Yes, Dragon Ancestor."
After Hawthorne Glaser left, it urgently issued a series of commands.
The territory of the Beastman Kingdom.
A Sky Island was rapidly heading towards the Central Continent of the Beastman Kingdom.
Because they didn’t want any side issues.
Han Xing covered the Sky Island with Divine Power, then entered a concealed state.
Their speed was extremely fast.
It only took a few hours.
To reach the Central Continent of the Beastman Kingdom.
At the same time.
On that vast continent filled with megaton boulders.
Countless Beastmen were dancing with excitement.
Before this.
Nearly half of the Beastman Kingdom had been infected by that kind of curse.
Now restored, they began to unleash their nature one by one.
"Howl! Finally free!"
"Long live His Majesty the King!"
Those Beastmen didn’t know that the ones who defeated the God of Tricks were Han Xing and his group.
They only knew that a terrible battle had erupted in the Beastman Kingdom today.
So they instinctively believed that it was their King who saved them.

So they instinctively believed that it was their King who saved them.

chapters.title: Chapter 572 - 359: Tearing Off the Mask, Extermination!
paragraphs: The beastmen began to cheer enthusiastically.
Even though this great war.
Caused billions of beastmen to be affected and lost their lives.
However.
With the terrifying population of the Beastman Kingdom.
That amount is essentially a drop in the ocean to them.
Relying on the beastman’s scary reproductive ability, it will only take a few months to regenerate billions of little beastmen.
In the sky.
Cheng Jianyong looked at the excited appearance of those beastmen and chuckled, "Look at how excited they are."
"If they knew it was Brother Xing who saved them, would they be moved to utter prostration?"
The crowd chuckled.
Shen Yun said at this moment, "I wonder what kind of reward the Beastman King will give us."
"It seems, this race’s strength is comparable to that of the Tree Spirit Race."
"Their treasury must contain countless treasures."
The eyes of the crowd lit up.
Understand that this time they went to the Sky Island Forest.
That Ancient Tree was willing to help them, even taking out a powerful Holy Artifact.
And this Holy Artifact also brought great help to Han Xing.
The Beastman Kingdom must at least offer a reward of equivalent value, right?
With excited hearts, the crowd continued to fly towards the center of the Beastman Continent.
Soon after.

Han Xing sensed the presence of a demigod.
No doubt, the Beastman King must be inside.
Then, Han Xing led his team and they entered the massive stone palace together.
Inside the palace, there stands a giant throne.
And seated upon the throne was a half-alive figure.
"Ding! Ding! Ding!"
As a series of metallic clanging sounds rang out.
At this moment.
A group of Legendary Beastmen was trying everything to remove the iron chain from the Beastman King.
However.
This iron chain was specially crafted by the Beastman King to control himself.
It contained the Dwarf Race’s core technology.
Even a demigod could not use brute force to break it.
He sighed and said, "Stop trying."
"I’ve already sent a message to the Dwarf Grandmaster, Tadak, to come and help unlock this chain."
"It won’t be long before Grandmaster Tadak arrives."
The group of Legendary Beastmen stopped attacking the chain upon hearing this.
At this time.
Several strong auras suddenly appeared in the palace.
The Beastman King sensed them first.
He suddenly raised his head to look at the few people at the entrance.
At that moment.
The Beastman King’s pupils shrank abruptly.
The group of Legendary Beastmen also followed his gaze.
"Human Race!"
"When did they come in?"
They exclaimed together, and some even entered a combat state.
"How dare you! Who allowed you to enter the palace?"
"Human Race, leave immediately, or don’t blame us for taking action!"
Han Xing and the others frowned.
They initially thought this group of beastmen would warmly welcome them once they saw them.
But now, it’s different from what they imagined.
But after thinking about it.
The crowd understood.
After all, this group of beastmen didn’t know about Han Xing and the others’ arrival.
Nor did they know that it was Han Xing and his team who had just battled with the God of Tricks.
At this moment, Han Xing focused his gaze on the central Beastman King.
It was a tall figure.
With a body nearly five meters tall lying on the throne, like a pile of decaying giant.
He had been eroded by the curse for too long.
Even after the curse was lifted, it would take a long time to recover.
"Would you like to explain to your subordinates?"
Han Xing suddenly said.
However, the Beastman King looked at Han Xing with a puzzled face, seemingly unable to understand his meaning.
"A few friends from the Human Race, may I ask why you are here?" The Beastman King said slowly.
Upon hearing this, the group frowned.
"You..." Cheng Jianyong was about to speak.
But Han Xing stopped him.
Han Xing said directly, "Don’t play dumb, you should be aware of what just happened."
However, the Beastman King still looked confused.
"Everyone, I have been in a coma and still can’t recall the previous events clearly."
"I also have no idea why you have come to the Beastman Kingdom."
Once again Han Xing frowned.
"Can’t remember?"
"Are you doing it on purpose?"
"Or have you been eroded by the curse for so long that even your mind is damaged?"
Upon hearing this, the group of Legendary Beastmen rebuked.
"You arrogant fool!"
"Do not speak ill of His Majesty!"
At this moment.
Shen Yun and others furrowed their brows even tighter.
They didn’t know what the Beastman King was up to.
Cheng Jianyong at the back nearly burst out, but seeing Han Xing silent, he
At this time, the Beastman King seemed to remember something and quickly stopped the Legendary Beastmen.
"Stand down!"
"These individuals from the Human Race are the benefactors who just saved our beastmen race."
Upon hearing this.
The crowd of Legendary Beastmen showed astonishment.
"What?"
"Was it them?"
They stared with dark eyes, filled with disbelief.
"Your Majesty, are you mistaken?"
"They are just some legendary figures from the Human Race, and some are extremely weak, how could they defeat the God of Tricks."
Other Legendary Beastmen echoed, "Yes, Your Majesty."
"You must be mistaken!"
These Legendary Beastmen revealed skeptical expressions.
Without waiting for Han Xing and others to speak.
The Beastman King slowly said, "Are you questioning your king?"
"Those who spoke just now, all of you are to be thrown into the Land of Storms to guard for a month!"

chapters.title: Chapter 573 - 359: Tearing Off the Mask, Extermination! (Part 2)
paragraphs: Its tone carries a trace of anger.
Below, that group of Legendary Beastmen instantly felt terrified!
"We dare not! Your Majesty the King!"
"Your Majesty the King, please be merciful!
"We just found it hard to believe, we absolutely did not mean to question you."
"Yes, Your Majesty the King, after all, before this, we have never heard of Legends defeating a Divine Spirit."
"Even the most talented and powerful warriors of our Beastman Race could not accomplish such a feat."
"Please forgive us, Your Majesty the King!"
That group of Legendary Beastmen all kneeled on one knee.
Hearing their pleas, the anger in the Beastman King’s eyes gradually dissipated.
"You don’t need to overthink it, if I say it is, then it is."
"These Human Race warriors are the benefactors who saved our Witch Race."
"Now, all the War Kings, join me in thanking these warriors for their life-saving grace."
At the behest of the Beastman King.
Although those Legendary Beastmen were still somewhat unwilling.
They still respectfully kneeled on one knee and spoke in unison.
"We thank the Human Race warriors for helping our Beastman Kingdom rid ourselves of the Divine Spirit’s curse, the Beastman Kingdom bestows upon you our highest respect."
The system prompt appeared.
[Due to your outstanding performance, you’ve gained the recognition of the Beastman Kingdom, Affinity +3000, current Affinity (Friendly)]
Han Xing frowned.
Only added three thousand?
This is a matter of saving an entire race.
It’s even more significant than the last time Han Xing rescued the Witch Race.
That time, the Witch Race maxed out the Affinity directly.
Thinking about it, Han Xing didn’t mind.
After all, his goal wasn’t to get in good with the Beastman Race.
At this moment, the Beastman King said slowly, "Mighty Human Race warriors, I apologize for being unable to personally welcome you due to my immobility."
"I hope you won’t hold it against me."
"To thank you for your contributions, I shall erect statues for you in the capital of the Beastman Kingdom."
"The Beastman Race will remember your kindness."
The Legendary Beastmen’s expressions changed, but they didn’t dare to act out.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Whether the Beastman Kingdom thanks me or not, it doesn’t matter to me.
"I came here just to take what we deserve."
Upon hearing this, the Beastman King’s face slightly changed.
While he knew these Humans had suddenly arrived for some purpose.
Or perhaps to gain some benefit from them.
He didn’t expect this Human to be so direct.
Coming straight out to ask for a reward.
At this time, the nearby Legendary Beastmen also showed unpleasant expressions.
But the King didn’t speak, and they reluctantly stayed silent.
The Beastman King then spoke slowly, "Several mighty Human warriors have saved our Beastman Kingdom from disaster."
"We indeed must offer appropriate rewards as thanks."
Upon hearing this, Cheng Jianyong’s eyes lit up.
The anger held within his heart subsided a bit.
"At least you’re sensible!" Cheng Jianyong shouted.
However, the Beastman King’s next sentence again brought a sense of displeasure to their hearts.
"However... our Beastman Kingdom has been under the control of that being for thousands of years."
"Most of the treasures in the treasury have already been taken by it."
"Perhaps this time’s reward might not completely satisfy you."
Han Xing slightly narrowed his eyes, looking at the Beastman King on the stage.
This means you’re unwilling to reward them.
Or rather, you want to dismiss them with some trash?
Han Xing then said, "No problem."
"You just need to open the kingdom’s treasury and let us choose for ourselves."
Upon hearing this, before the Beastman King could speak.
The Legendary Beastmen below exclaimed in anger.
"How dare you!"
"A group of lowly Humans actually dares to make such an impudent request?"
"Do you really think you’re some big shots?"
At this moment.
The confused Cheng Jianyong behind them said, "What the hell, are you Beastmen brain dead?"
"Do you know who you’re talking to right now?"
"Hmm?"
"We just took down a Divine Spirit!"
"Are you talking to me like this because you think you’re not dying fast enough?"
However.
After hearing this, those Legendary Beastmen sneered coldly.
"Stop pretending."
"Legendary Level defeating a Divine Spirit, you’re bold to even say such a thing!"
"Yeah indeed, aren’t you afraid of biting your tongue with such wind?"
"A single finger of the Divine Spirit could easily crush you."
"Our Beastman Race’s most talented War King couldn’t do such a thing, how could you insignificant Humans?"
After these words.
Han Xing and the others finally understood.
Why this group of Beastmen held such an attitude towards them.
It turns out, from the beginning, they didn’t believe Han Xing and the others defeated the God of Tricks.
They couldn’t believe that a group of Humans could accomplish what their Beastmen couldn’t.
The Beastmen were extremely proud of their race’s bloodline.
Even more confident than those Giant Dragons.
However, the arrogance of the Dragons comes from their actual strength.
While these Beastmen are completely mindless.
Otherwise, why call them Beastmen?
Thinking of this, Han Xing suddenly amused himself.
At the same time, a system prompt rang in Han Xing’s ear.
[Beastman Kingdom Affinity -1000.]
Alright!
He painstakingly saved these Beastmen from the control of the God of Tricks.
Only to gain 3000 Affinity, not to mention.
Now he just said he wanted the deserved reward, and lost 1000 Affinity directly.
This group of Beastmen really changes sides faster than turning pages in a book.
At this time, the Beastman King spoke, "Everyone, be silent."
