chapters.title: Chapter 574 - 359: Tearing Off All Pretense, Annihilation of the Tribe! (Part 3)
paragraphs: "Although I don’t know what methods these Human Race friends used to defeat the Divine Spirit."
"Whether it was luck or other factors."
"But they have indeed helped our Beastman Race."
"We should try to satisfy their requests."
The Beastman King’s words were dignified and grand.
However, the people below almost laughed in anger.
It turns out, even this guy doesn’t believe they defeated the God of Tricks."
He thought it was by sheer luck.
Han Xing shook his head, not wanting to explain further.
All that matters is that this group of beastmen hands over the rewards they deserve.
Yet, at this moment, the Beastman King spoke again.
"However, you Human Race friends can see, I am unable to move right now and cannot lead you to open our race’s treasure vault."
"After some time, when I invite friends from the Dwarf Race to unlock the chains on me, I will surely present the rewards with both hands."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s expressions gradually darkened.
The meaning of that sentence was.
Right now I can’t give you rewards, you’d better leave.
As for the sentence that followed, Han Xing didn’t believe it at all.
After all, they often used this kind of rhetoric themselves.
This ’after some time’ is hard to specify how long.
Including Han Xing, who squinted his eyes, watching the Beastman King with interest.
Seemingly embarrassed by Han Xing’s stare.
It awkwardly coughed twice.
"A few Human Race warriors, I need to recuperate for a while."
"Please forgive me for not sending you off personally."
Seeing the other party had issued a formal expulsion order.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t bear it anymore.
He drew the longsword in his hand, angrily saying: "Damn it, stop pretending!"
"This time, we took such a big risk to defeat the God of Tricks."
"You bastards have recovered and want to turn your backs and deny us?"
The sword tip of the Divine Artifact Longsword pointed at the Beastman King on the throne.
Murderous intent appeared in Cheng Jianyong’s eyes.
The legendary beastmen instantly reacted with anger.
"Don’t be rude to His Majesty the King!"
"Madman! Kneel immediately and apologize to the King!"
"Or I’ll make you pay!"
Listening to the shouts of these beastmen.
A system prompt once again appeared in Han Xing’s ears.
[Beastman Kingdom Affinity -2000, current affinity 0 (Indifferent)]
At that moment.
Han Xing laughed.
It seems this group of beastmen was also not intending to keep pretending.
They had already torn faces with him.
If that’s the case...
Han Xing directly pulled the bowstring.
As everyone failed to react, he shot an arrow at the most vocal legendary beastman.
"Whoosh!"
The speed of this arrow was terrifyingly fast.
On the scene, only the Beastman King reacted.
Its pupils contracted slightly, but due to being bound, it had no chance to intervene.
In the next moment.
It watched the arrow pierce through the legendary beastman’s head.
Then it struck the palace stone wall beside, making a resounding explosion!
"Boom!!"
Fragments of stone flew everywhere.
At the same time.
The body of the legendary beastman collapsed limply.
A system prompt appeared in Han Xing’s ear.
[Successfully killed Legendary Beastman: Rama, gained 2.374 billion Experience Value, automatically absorbed opponent’s Divine Power, Divine Power Value +10.]
[Beastman Kingdom Affinity -1000, current affinity (Hostile)]
Seeing the death of their companion.
On the scene.
Dozens of legendary beastmen immediately reacted.
They erupted with earth-shattering fury.
"Bastard!"
"Dare to commit murder right in front of us, I will slaughter you all!"
Han Xing looked at the furious beastmen before him, and the negative affinity.
"Is it that I have been too nice to you?"
"Making you think I’m easier to deal with than the God of Tricks?"
"Hmm?"
In the next moment.
Han Xing pulled the bowstring.
Meanwhile, the other team members also entered combat mode.
Across from them, the legendary beastmen shouted in anger: "Still dare to resist!"
"Brothers, call all Beastman War Kings over, today we cannot let these humans escape!"
At the same time.
In the entire Beastman Kingdom, legendary beastmen from other places were informed.
Han Xing knew the beastmen’s brain circuits were different from ordinary people.
But he did not expect them to be this foolish.
Han Xing sneered: "Very well then."
"Call all your legends over."
"Today, we’ll catch all of you in one net."
"I don’t mind slaughtering your entire Beastman Race!"
Han Xing was genuinely intent on killing.
A race this stupid, if not for relying on their many strong individuals, would hardly survive to now.
"Still daring to speak wildly!"
"Activate the Palace Sealing Array, don’t let them run out of the palace!"
This group of beastmen may have muscles for brains.
But their combat experience was quite rich.
They knew to first use geographical advantages to restrict Han Xing and the others.
Meanwhile.
The entire stone palace emitted dazzling white light.
Han Xing and others heard a system prompt.
[You have stepped into the Great Stone Array, mobility reduced by 50%...]
This group of beastmen wanted to use this array to control Han Xing and the others.
Then, with their number advantage, they would launch a group attack on Han Xing and his team.
The idea and tactics were good.
However, how could Han Xing not have other means?
Just then.
Underneath Shen Yun’s feet appeared a similar Gem Throne.
It was the same Oracle Throne as Han Xing’s and Zhang Lianmeng’s.
Last time, Han Xing hadn’t made a single throne.
But two.
Distributed to Zhang Lianmeng and Shen Yun.
So, they still had one teleportation opportunity.
In the next moment.
Shen Yun directly activated the teleportation function of the Oracle Throne.
The figures of five people were enveloped by a white light.
Then, they directly disappeared from the place.
"Damn it, they got away!"
"Wait a second, their Sky Island seems to be outside, let’s chase!"
That group of beastmen was surprised and furious.
One after another rushed towards the palace exit.
At this moment.
Han Xing appeared on the Sky Island.
Looking at the dozens of legendary beastmen rushing out of the palace.
Han Xing’s face showed a smile filled with murderous intent.
Then, with a wave of his hand.
A tenth of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons on the Sky Island entered attack mode at this moment.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s faces showed expressions of schadenfreude.
They knew the firepower of these Spiritual Godslaying Cannons well.
Even if there was only a tenth.
It could still pose a threat to the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots—such high-tier demigods.
"These foolish beastmen, let’s see how many of them can survive after this cannon blast." Cheng Jianyong said excitedly.

"However, you Human Race friends can see, I am unable to move right now and cannot lead you to open our race’s treasure vault."
"After some time, when I invite friends from the Dwarf Race to unlock the chains on me, I will surely present the rewards with both hands."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s expressions gradually darkened.
The meaning of that sentence was.
Right now I can’t give you rewards, you’d better leave.
As for the sentence that followed, Han Xing didn’t believe it at all.
After all, they often used this kind of rhetoric themselves.
This ’after some time’ is hard to specify how long.
Including Han Xing, who squinted his eyes, watching the Beastman King with interest.
Seemingly embarrassed by Han Xing’s stare.
It awkwardly coughed twice.
"A few Human Race warriors, I need to recuperate for a while."
"Please forgive me for not sending you off personally."
Seeing the other party had issued a formal expulsion order.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t bear it anymore.
He drew the longsword in his hand, angrily saying: "Damn it, stop pretending!"
"This time, we took such a big risk to defeat the God of Tricks."
"You bastards have recovered and want to turn your backs and deny us?"
The sword tip of the Divine Artifact Longsword pointed at the Beastman King on the throne.
Murderous intent appeared in Cheng Jianyong’s eyes.
The legendary beastmen instantly reacted with anger.
"Don’t be rude to His Majesty the King!"
"Madman!
Kneel immediately and apologize to the King!"
"Or I’ll make you pay!"
Listening to the shouts of these beastmen.
A system prompt once again appeared in Han Xing’s ears.
[Beastman Kingdom Affinity -2000, current affinity 0 (Indifferent)]
At that moment.
Han Xing laughed.
It seems this group of beastmen was also not intending to keep pretending.
They had already torn faces with him.
If that’s the case...
Han Xing directly pulled the bowstring.
As everyone failed to react, he shot an arrow at the most vocal legendary beastman.
"Whoosh!"
The speed of this arrow was terrifyingly fast.
On the scene, only the Beastman King reacted.
Its pupils contracted slightly, but due to being bound, it had no chance to intervene.
In the next moment.
It watched the arrow pierce through the legendary beastman’s head.
Then it struck the palace stone wall beside, making a resounding explosion!
"Boom!!"
Fragments of stone flew everywhere.
At the same time.
The body of the legendary beastman collapsed limply.
A system prompt appeared in Han Xing’s ear.
[Successfully killed Legendary Beastman: Rama, gained 2.374 billion Experience Value, automatically absorbed opponent’s Divine Power, Divine Power Value +10.]
[Beastman Kingdom Affinity -1000, current affinity (Hostile)]
Seeing the death of their companion.
On the scene.
Dozens of legendary beastmen immediately reacted.
They erupted with earth-shattering fury.
"Bastard!"
"Dare to commit murder right in front of us, I will slaughter you all!"
Han Xing looked at the furious beastmen before him, and the negative affinity.
"Is it that I have been too nice to you?"
"Making you think I’m easier to deal with than the God of Tricks?"
"Hmm?"
In the next moment.
Han Xing pulled the bowstring.
Meanwhile, the other team members also entered combat mode.
Across from them, the legendary beastmen shouted in anger: "Still dare to resist!"
"Brothers, call all Beastman War Kings over, today we cannot let these humans escape!"
At the same time.
In the entire Beastman Kingdom, legendary beastmen from other places were informed.
Han Xing knew the beastmen’s brain circuits were different from ordinary people.
But he did not expect them to be this foolish.
Han Xing sneered: "Very well then."
"Call all your legends over."
"Today, we’ll catch all of you in one net."
"I don’t mind slaughtering your entire Beastman Race!"
Han Xing was genuinely intent on killing.
A race this stupid, if not for relying on their many strong individuals, would hardly survive to now.
"Still daring to speak wildly!"
"Activate the Palace Sealing Array, don’t let them run out of the palace!"
This group of beastmen may have muscles for brains.
But their combat experience was quite rich.
They knew to first use geographical advantages to restrict Han Xing and the others.
Meanwhile.
The entire stone palace emitted dazzling white light.
Han Xing and others heard a system prompt.
[You have stepped into the Great Stone Array, mobility reduced by 50%...]
This group of beastmen wanted to use this array to control Han Xing and the others.
Then, with their number advantage, they would launch a group attack on Han Xing and his team.
The idea and tactics were good.
However, how could Han Xing not have other means?
Just then.
Underneath Shen Yun’s feet appeared a similar Gem Throne.
It was the same Oracle Throne as Han Xing’s and Zhang Lianmeng’s.
Last time, Han Xing hadn’t made a single throne.
But two.
Distributed to Zhang Lianmeng and Shen Yun.
So, they still had one teleportation opportunity.
In the next moment.
Shen Yun directly activated the teleportation function of the Oracle Throne.
The figures of five people were enveloped by a white light.
Then, they directly disappeared from the place.
"Damn it, they got away!"
"Wait a second, their Sky Island seems to be outside, let’s chase!"
That group of beastmen was surprised and furious.
One after another rushed towards the palace exit.
At this moment.
Han Xing appeared on the Sky Island.
Looking at the dozens of legendary beastmen rushing out of the palace.
Han Xing’s face showed a smile filled with murderous intent.
Then, with a wave of his hand.
A tenth of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannons on the Sky Island entered attack mode at this moment.
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun’s faces showed expressions of schadenfreude.
They knew the firepower of these Spiritual Godslaying Cannons well.
Even if there was only a tenth.
It could still pose a threat to the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots—such high-tier demigods.
"These foolish beastmen, let’s see how many of them can survive after this cannon blast." Cheng Jianyong said excitedly.

chapters.title: Chapter 575 - 360: Massacre and Surrender
paragraphs: "Let’s see how many of them can survive this shot!"
Cheng Jianyong was extremely excited.
Using a weapon meant for the Divine Spirits on these beastmen was indeed a bit overkill.
However, none of them harbored any pity in their hearts.
Even if Han Xing wiped out this entire group of beastmen, even destroying the entire Beastman Kingdom,
they would support Han Xing’s decision.
At this moment.
The legendary beastmen had already charged out.
Seeing the Sky Island overhead, each one let out excited cries.
"They’re there! Those humans haven’t escaped!"
"Capture them, I want to tear them to pieces!"
"They want to escape after killing our brothers? Today, we’ll show them that we beastmen are not to be trifled with."
The group of excited beastmen charged over.
Just then, a beastman with black stripes on its head suddenly noticed the two graceful figures on the Sky Island.
Its pupils shrank instantly, and an obscene glint appeared in its eyes.
"Leave those two human females for me. I want to show them the might of a beastman!"
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang instantly locked their gaze filled with murderous intent on the group of beastmen.
Han Xing sneered coldly.
"A bunch of fools, killing you all would not be a loss."
The next moment.
A dazzling white light emerged.
The ominous aura of death shrouded the entire Beastman Continent.
The legendary beastmen suddenly froze in place.
Because they felt it once again, the feeling of facing that terrifying existence.
And at that moment, they finally understood.
It was indeed these humans who had defeated the God of Tricks!
They possessed the means to deal with a Divine Spirit, precisely that Sky Island emitting bright white light!
The legendary beastmen felt the threat of death and shouted out one after another.
"No! Don’t kill us!"
"Human warriors, I was wrong, spare me!"
"Ah! Your Majesty the King, save me!"
Even the Beastman King inside the monumental stone palace was greatly shaken.
However, he could only remain trapped on his throne, completely unable to move.
In response to the pleas of the beastmen, Han Xing was unmoved.
Then the attack of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon descended directly.
Amid the terrified gazes of the legendary beastmen.
A beam of lethal white light suddenly descended from above.
In the face of that power, even a demigod couldn’t muster a single thought of resistance.
Let alone, it was just a group of legendary beastmen.
"Boom!"
The beam of white light descended from the sky and enveloped dozens of legendary beastmen below.
With extremely swift speed, the legendary beastmen had no chance to escape.
Then, even the massive stone palace covering thousands of square kilometers was struck by the white light column.
In the next moment.
The entire Beastman Continent began to shake violently.
The ordinary beastmen outside clutched their heads in panic.
"Oh my god..."
"That terrifying aura is back!"
"Quick, hide!"
The beam from the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon lasted for one second.
When the commotion ceased.
A giant pit with a diameter of over ten kilometers appeared.
And the previously massive beastman palace had already disappeared.
Not only that.
From this giant pit, one could even directly see the scenery below the Beastman Continent.
This shot.
It pierced directly through the center of the entire Beastman Continent!
And those legendary beastmen that were enveloped by the shot.
The majority were turned directly to ash, leaving not even a corpse behind.
The reason some of the legendary beastmen survived.
Was because they happened to be on the battlefield’s edge.
Just barely avoiding being covered by the white light’s attack.
If not, these legendary beastmen wouldn’t have survived either.
Despite this, the previous arrogance was gone from their eyes.
Looking at Han Xing, their eyes were filled with the fear of death!
Han Xing shook his head slightly.
He felt a bit of a pity.
Because the defense tower strike on legendary powerhouses did not yield experience or other rewards.
Otherwise, with this wave alone, he could have gained vast amounts of experience and divine power value.
However, it wasn’t a complete loss.
After all, this time he came out.
Aside from two Sun Crown Steles, Han Xing had brought other belongings.
Like the Demon Furnace and Miracle Tower, etc.
Simultaneously.
More than thirty large souls rose, being collected by the Demon Furnace.
The number of stored souls surpassed 15 billion directly!
This means Han Xing with that single shot, directly took out over thirty legendary level powerhouses.
At the same time.
Han Xing noticed a charred figure appearing on the distant ground.
It was the Beastman King, already scorched into a charred state.
At this moment.
The chains on his body had been shattered by Han Xing, and severe injuries appeared on him.
The Beastman King’s face no longer had the previous composure; he looked fearfully at Han Xing.
Including the other surviving legendary beastmen, their eyes filled with intense fear as they gazed at Han Xing.
At this moment.
Han Xing no longer heard the system prompts reducing affinity.
He smiled.
Indeed, a gentle policy also needs to be situation-based.
For a race that clearly respects force over kindness.
Han Xing did not mind giving them a lesson.
There you have it.
One shot, and they’re all obedient.
For the first wave of attacks, he only used thirty Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Coupled with the double Sun Crown Stele’s boost.
Han Xing can now launch such an attack that can instantly kill a high-tier demigod almost without interval.
These legendary beastmen, in his eyes, are already piles of ash.
Han Xing was about to launch a second attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 576 - 360: Massacre and Surrender
paragraphs: The Beastman King crawled up from the ground in terror.
And shouted loudly, "Stop!"
Han Xing instantly directed his gaze over, "Are you ordering me?"
Then, he released an arrow.
The Beastman King was hit by the arrow and was directly sent flying thousands of meters away!
At this moment, he finally realized that his attitude needed to change.
"Stop!"
"Stop attacking!"
"We are willing to surrender! We are willing to surrender!"
After he finished speaking.
The Beastman King was the first to kneel on both knees, with his head touching the ground.
To survive.
He completely abandoned his so-called dignity and pride.
The other Legendary Beastmen saw this and did not mock him.
One by one, they followed suit, kneeling and begging Han Xing for mercy.
"We are willing to surrender, oh Human Race warriors, we beg you to spare us."
In the face of life and death, the so-called dignity and honor are indeed insignificant.
These Legendary Beastmen, who were usually accustomed to arrogance, had their courage shattered by Han Xing’s cannon shot.
Yet.
Gazing at their kneeling figures.
Han Xing laughed coldly, "Isn’t it a bit late to say you want to surrender now?"
"Those Beastmen who were shouting the loudest just now, where are they?"
"Will you step forward yourselves, or shall I do it myself?"
Hearing these words, those Legendary Beastmen trembled.
"However, if I do it myself, I might not be able to tell who’s who."
"By then, I might end up killing you all."
Listening to Han Xing’s icy words, all the Legendary Beastmen felt a bad premonition.
Because they knew this Human meant what he said.
The next moment.
Several Legendary Beastmen stepped forward.
Among them was the one who had spoken disrespectfully to Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
Before they could speak.
A few arrows pierced right through their foreheads, penetrating through.
"Poo! Poop poop poop!"
Four piercing sounds echoed.
The next moment.
The bodies of these four Legendary Beastmen exploded into blood mist.
Blood splattered on the ground.
This scene.
Made the other Beastmen tremble with fear.
The way they looked at Han Xing was also filled with terror.
And at this moment.
Dozens of powerful auras appeared in the distance.
"Stop, who dares to commit atrocities in our Beastman Kingdom!"
The voices emanated from Legendary Level Beastmen.
Han Xing counted them, roughly seventy-three in number..
From this, it was clear that the power of the Beastman Kingdom was truly astounding.
Upon receiving the information, they rushed to the Beastman Continent at the first moment.
At this moment.
The newly arrived Legendary Beastmen saw the prostrating figures on the ground.
They seemed completely unable to comprehend what had happened.
Each one showed a shocked expression in their eyes.
"Your Majesty the King... what are you doing?"
On the ground, the Beastmen dared not answer.
However, this group of Beastmen became enraged.
"Damn, you humans, what demon technique did you use on His Majesty the King?"
"How dare you slaughter our War King, I will kill you!"
The group of Beastmen was about to charge at Han Xing to battle him.
The Beastman King beside them tried to stop them.
Then, Han Xing had no interest in communicating with this group of foolish Beastmen.
Directly activated one-tenth of the Godslaying Cannon again!
"Buzz!"
A piercing white light of death reappeared.
When the commotion subsided.
Half of this group of Legendary Beastmen were annihilated once more.
At this moment.
The same expression of horror appeared on their faces.
As if they had seen a ghost, they looked at this Human.
Each one took a sharp intake of breath.
The remaining Legendary Beastmen instinctively wanted to run.
However, Han Xing’s cold voice came from behind.
"Take another step, and the Beastman Kingdom will be wiped out today."
Upon hearing this, all the Legendary Beastmen were so scared that they froze in place, not daring to move at all!
They had no doubt that this Human’s words were true.
He not only had the capability, but he also would put it into action!
The newly arrived Legendary Beastmen quickly mimicked their King, all kneeling on the ground.
"Spare us, mighty warrior!"
"Spare us, mighty warrior!"
At this moment, Han Xing also realized.
Dealing with such a thick-headed Race.
Direct slaughter is the most effective approach.
Look.
Aren’t these Legendary Beastmen now behaving obediently?
Moreover, their Affinity hasn’t decreased.
What does this indicate?
It indicates that they are now afraid of being killed by Han Xing.
Han Xing at this moment said.
"I said, I merely want to take what we deserve."
"In the end, not only did you try to renege, but you also tried to make a move against us."
Han Xing’s face once again showed a cruel smile.
"So now, what should I do with you?"
Falling into the eyes of those Beastmen, it was like a vengeful ghost, deeply unsettling!
Once again, the Beastman King urgently said, "We surrender! We are willing to surrender!"
"Esteemed Human warrior, please cease the slaughter!"
"We, the Beastman Race, are willing to pledge allegiance to you wholeheartedly!"
Upon hearing this.
Originally planning to annihilate the Beastman Race entirely.
Han Xing suddenly had a different thought.
After pondering for a moment.
Han Xing came to the front of the Legendary Beastmen.
Then he threw them a Contract Scroll.
"Sign it."
The Legendary Beastmen looked at this scene blankly, seemingly not understanding Han Xing’s intention.
Han Xing chuckled lightly, "Can’t you understand?"
"Either sign the Lord Contract and become my contract slaves."
"Or the Beastman will be exterminated today."
"It’s your choice."
Hearing these words, all the Legendary Beastmen showed hesitation in their eyes once again.
They knew how terrifying the Lord Contract Scroll was.
Once signed, they would be at this Human’s beck and call for life, without a single thought of rebellion.
It was equivalent to living as slaves for a lifetime.
Unless, they could break beyond the existence of the Rule.

chapters.title: Chapter 577 - 360: Massacre and Submission
paragraphs: That is, the Divine Spirit.
But, is that possible?
All the beastmen felt utterly desperate in their hearts.
And at this moment.
With a cracking sound echoing.
The body of a Legendary Beastman exploded on the spot once again.
Flesh and blood splattered onto the faces of other beastmen.
Such a bloody scene almost woke them up instantaneously.
At this moment, Han Xing’s demonic voice resounded once more.
"I don’t want to waste more words."
"I’ll give you ten seconds to consider."
"After time’s up, those who haven’t signed the contract will end up like this guy."
With that, Han Xing began the countdown directly.
"Ten."
All the beastmen trembled violently.
"Five."
They widened their eyes at Han Xing, only to be met with a pair of cold pupils.
"One."
Damn it!
Where’s the promised ten seconds?
Whose countdown counts like this?
However, the group of beastmen, though frustrated at heart.
Under the threat of death, they each picked up the Lord Contract Scroll from the ground.
"We’ll sign! We’ll sign!"
They shouted at the top of their lungs, fearing that if they were a step too slow, they’d be shot dead on the spot by this man.
Meanwhile, waves of white light shone on those beastmen.
[Lord Contract signed successfully, Beastman Kingdom: Alahan (Initial-stage Legend) has joined your camp, Camp Fortune Value +100.]
[Title: Legendary Beast Tamer, Upgrade Progress increased, current progress 2/10.]
[Lord Contract signed successfully, Beastman Kingdom: Fudao Kan (Middle-tier Legend) has joined your camp, Camp Fortune Value +200.]
[Title: Legendary Beast Tamer, Upgrade Progress increased...]
After dozens of successive system prompts.
Han Xing looked at the hugely increased Camp Fortune Value, a smile appearing at the corner of his mouth.
In this wave alone, there were as many as 64 legendary beastmen who signed contracts.
Among them, 47 were Initial-stage Legendary Beastmen, 13 were Middle-tier Legendary Beastmen, and 4 were High-tier Legendary Beastmen.
A total of 9300 points of Fortune Value was added.
This Fortune can bring a 9.3% enhancement to all attributes.
And it’s not just Han Xing, but the entire Han Xing camp!
At this moment on the Witch Race Continent.
Those Witch Race Legendary Powerhouses were surprised to find that their strength had once again increased significantly!
"What happened? How did I become much stronger again?" a Witch Race Legend exclaimed in surprise.
Other powerhouses were also filled with confusion.
"This feeling seems like a boost brought by Celestial Mandate’s favor."
The next moment, as if they thought of something, they all exclaimed in surprise.
"It’s the Saint Master!"
"Could it be, he broke through again?"
However, other Witch Race Legends denied it: "It shouldn’t be."
"This boost in Fortune Power exceeds any previous time."
"I feel like this is at least the boost brought by hundreds of Legends!"
Hearing this, the pupils of other Witch Race Legends shrank suddenly.
In utter amazement.
"Hundreds of Legends? Oh my God, what has the Saint Master done now?"
At this moment, High Priest Xiao also flew out of the Sky Island full of doubt.
He arrived in the sky over the Witch Race Continent.
He instinctively sensed the current Fortune of the Witch Race.
Back when Helas was in power, Xiao often did this too.
By observing Fortune, one could roughly discern the recent trajectory of the Witch Race.
Xiao vaguely remembered that back then, the Witch Race’s Fortune looked like a blue butterfly, occasionally fluttering its wings.
But when he saw the current shape of the Witch Race’s Fortune.
His pupils instantly contracted.
Because, he saw a humanoid phantom.
And from that phantom’s body, a pale golden light was radiating.
That daunting gaze, sweeping across the entire Holy Spirit Realm.
As if, he was the Emperor of this world!
Xiao was extremely shocked.
Because he recognized this figure.
It was Han Xing.
"The Saint Master... truly a peerless genius!"
"In just one year, he has elevated the Fortune of the Witch Race to such a terrifying degree.
"Even surpassing any previous Saint Master."
At this time, Xiao suddenly shook his head and said: "No, it can no longer be called the Witch Race now."
"It should be called the Han Xing Camp."
A relieved smile suddenly appeared on the corner of his lips.
Meanwhile, at the border, the billions of human race survivors fighting against the Void Beasts.
Also noticed the change in Camp Fortune Value.
"Damn! 9300 points of Fortune Value!"
"What on Blue Star has the Star God done, so much Fortune Value, it’s almost comparable to the boost brought by a piece of equipment."
A 9.3% enhancement to all attributes is indeed roughly equivalent to the boost brought by a piece of equipment.
And this also elevated the strength of everyone within the Han Xing camp by a notch.
At this moment, a survivor clenched his fist.
"Brothers, we must keep striving, kill more Void Beasts."
"After this, I’m aiming to bag a captain’s title! Marry ten or eight Witch Race wives!"
Upon hearing this, a survivor flashed a knowing smile.
Ever since the two races merged.
Such a thing has not been uncommon.
Due to the Witch Race’s open customs and the urgent need to replenish the population.
Many human survivors mingled with the Witch Race people.
Everyone was accustomed to it.
Moreover, this is a world that venerates strength.
Some powerhouses enjoy their privileges.
As long as you have strength, not to mention ten, you could marry a hundred wives.
And for these survivors from Blue Star, this is simply paradise!
Another human survivor said again.
"Speaking of which, the maidens of the Witch Race are truly beautiful!"
"If it weren’t for the current crisis requiring us to fight, I’d want to retire right now, live like a deity with a few wives."
"Yeah, who wouldn’t want that..."
"Tch, look at you, with such little ambition."
Some battle-hungry survivors chuckled with disdain at the corners of their mouths when they heard this.
A system prompt appeared next to Han Xing’s ear.
[Title: Legendary Beast Tamer upgraded, current level: Mid-tier Legendary Beast Tamer.]
[Mid-tier Legendary Beast Tamer (Upgradeable)]: Creatures signed to your contract gain a 15% increase in all attributes, and experience acquisition speed increases by 20%.
[Upgrade Progress]: 55/50 (By signing 50 Legendary Creatures, the title can be further upgraded.)

chapters.title: Chapter 578 - 361: Opening the Beastman Kingdom’s Treasury
paragraphs: [Attention Survivors: The Mid-tier Legendary Beast Tamer title upgrade progress is complete. You have been automatically upgraded to a High-tier Legendary Beast Tamer.]
[High-tier Legendary Beast Tamer (Upgradeable)]: Creatures contracted with you have all attributes increased by 20%, and experience acquisition speed increased by 30%.
[Upgrade progress]: 5/100 (Legendary Level), 0/1 (Demigod Level).
Seeing these two system prompts, a smile appeared once again on Han Xing’s lips.
He didn’t expect that subduing this group of beastmen could also increase the upgrade progress of his ’Beast Tamer’ title.
Moreover, he advanced by 2 levels at once!
But upon thinking, it made sense.
After all, they are beastmen.
Their names naturally include the word beast.
So of course they could upgrade the Beast Tamer title.
At this moment.
The more than sixty legendary beastmen who had just signed contracts suddenly felt a surge of powerful energy within their bodies.
Some beastmen who were originally Initial-stage Legend now possessed the aura of a Mid-stage Legend.
And those Mid-stage Legends, some of them exhibited the aura of a High-tier Legend!
At this moment.
This group of beastmen showed expressions of panic on their faces.
It seemed they didn’t understand why their power had suddenly increased so much!
After all, a 20% all-attribute boost is no joke.
Then they realized the reason for this situation.
It was brought by this human before them.
"Greetings, Master!"
The beastmen respectfully knelt to the ground.
Han Xing glanced at their loyalty.
Very good.
All above 80 points.
There were no special circumstances.
He showed a satisfied smile on his face.
At this point, Han Xing approached the Beastman King and similarly threw over a scroll.
"Alright, now it’s your turn."
The Beastman King stood there in a daze, and after a moment, a forlorn look appeared in its eyes.
As the highest leader of the Beastman Race.
From childhood to adulthood, it was always the focus and expectation of countless eyes.
And it never let its people down, breaking through to demigod with strength and becoming the new king of the tribe.
All these years, it had never yielded to anyone.
Even the God of Tricks only managed to turn it into a cursed servant.
But now, it had to sign a contract with this legendary man before it, to live as his servant for life.
Yet it also understood.
The current situation was firmly in this man’s grasp.
It had no chance to resist.
This was someone more terrifying than the God of Tricks.
The Beastman King sighed.
Feeling a pang of regret for its previous decision.
If it had agreed to take this human to the kingdom’s treasury, none of this would have happened later.
Even leading to the severe casualties of the legendary warriors of the Beastman Race now.
Even it had to be forced to sign a contract with this human.
Then.
The Beastman King directly placed its mark.
System prompt appeared.
[Lord Contract successfully signed, Beastman King: Uman (Middle-tier Demigod) has joined your camp, Fortune Value +2000.]
[As Uman is the first Demigod Level powerhouse to join your camp, you received an additional Fortune Value reward +2000.]
[Beast Tamer title progress has increased...]
After reading the system prompt, Han Xing also displayed a satisfied smile.
The Fortune Value added by a demigod is equivalent to 20 legends.
Plus the extra reward, that’s 40 legends!
Han Xing’s attributes had increased significantly.
At this time.
The original 65 beastmen in front of him had their eyes full of fear and defiance completely changed.
They looked at Han Xing with eyes filled with loyalty and respect.
In unison, they exclaimed, "Greetings, Master!"
Han Xing nodded.
This day, the entire Beastman Kingdom’s high-end combat power was subdued by Han Xing in one fell swoop.
The camp’s Fortune Value skyrocketed rapidly.
"Master, up ahead is the beastman tribe’s treasury, I will take you there."
Beastman King Uman led the way in front.
Towards Han Xing, it no longer held its previous arrogance, but was full of reverence.
Han Xing nodded, "Lead the way."
At this point, Cheng Jianyong walked over and patted him on the shoulder, saying, "Wouldn’t it have been better to do this from the start?"
"You insisted on forcing our hand before you became compliant."
Uman showed an embarrassed expression, "It’s all my fault for not recognizing your greatness, I offended you gentlemen."
"And I almost made a big mistake by acting against Master Han Xing!"
His face revealed a trace of fear and he had completely turned Han Xing into his faith in his heart.
"However, fortunately, Master Han Xing is willing to give me this chance."
Uman said this with gratitude as he looked at Han Xing.
At this moment.
Not only Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong looked at the scene with mixed emotions.
Even Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang gazed at the change in the Beastman King with surprise.
Its attitude could be described as a complete 180-degree shift.
Once again, they developed a clear understanding of the fearsome nature of the Contract Scroll.
Han Xing also had a thoughtful expression on his face.
It seems that the Contract Scroll should also be a kind of Power of Rules.
And considering using the Contract Scroll to constrain those divine spirits should be impossible.
After all, those beings also master the rules.
Just as Han Xing pondered, Uman’s rugged voice came through.
"Here we are, Master."
Hearing the voice, Han Xing raised his head.
Before him appeared a massive earth-colored stone door.
Over a hundred meters high, it appeared to weigh at least tens of thousands of tons.
And as everyone arrived.
The massive stone door slowly began to open.
"Boom!"
When the stone door fully opened.

chapters.title: Chapter 579 - 361: Opening the Beastman Kingdom’s Treasury (Part 2)
paragraphs: A gigantic passage appeared in front of everyone.
Inside the passage, it was brightly lit.
At this moment, a familiar aura began to emanate from within.
It was the aura emitted by the Philosopher’s Stone, a high-level material.
Uman continued to lead everyone into the passage.
Inside, like other races, there were various powerful restrictions.
Additionally, the area was guarded by two or more Legendary Beastmen year-round.
The defensive power here was still very strong.
At this moment.
Uman casually dispelled the restrictions one by one.
The group reached even deeper inside.
Han Xing discovered that in this gigantic passage.
Inside, there was even more to behold.
On both sides of the passage, Han Xing saw hidden stone doors.
Behind these stone doors were places where Beastmen stored some valuable treasures.
For example, some Legendary Armor, weapons, jewelry, etc.
As they continued deeper along the passage.
The contents behind the hidden stone doors became increasingly advanced.
There were more than a dozen pieces of Divine Artifact level equipment.
It’s worth noting that there were only a few Divine Artifacts throughout the entire Witch Race.
Yet in the Beastmen’s treasure vault, they hadn’t even reached the end before discovering more than a dozen pieces.
At that moment.
Han Xing suddenly noticed a gigantic stone door nearby.
Inside, a fluctuation of Divine Power emanated.
"What’s inside here?" Han Xing asked.
Uman respectfully replied at this moment, "Master, inside is the Philosopher’s Stone."
Hearing this, a look of anticipation appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
After all, he needed more Philosopher’s Stones to forge Defense Towers and enhance his power.
"Open it."
Han Xing ordered.
Uman did not hesitate and opened the stone door directly.
The next moment, a mountain of Philosopher’s Stones appeared before Han Xing’s eyes!
With a rough estimate, there were at least a million of them!
"How many Philosopher’s Stones are in here, do you know?"
Han Xing asked with a hint of excitement.
Uman thought for a moment and reported a number.
"About 1.2 million."
Han Xing nodded.
This number was roughly what he had estimated.
About four times the resources of the Witch Race.
At this time, Uman added: "Actually, our previous reserves of the Philosopher’s Stone were far more than this."
"During the period when I was infected by the curse, the entire nation fell into that being’s hands."
"That Divine Spirit took away a large amount of our treasures..."
Hearing this, Han Xing nodded.
Then, as if offering comfort, he patted Uman on the shoulder.
But in truth, Han Xing was overjoyed inside.
It seemed that the God of Tricks was also quite the covetous type.
And this indicated that its treasure vault must be filled with immense and rich resources!
Then.
He followed Uman to check the resources of several other vaults.
Among them, the number of Shimmering Terra Stones was about 1.07 million, and Calamity Divine Gold was about 1,500.
Just enough to construct 150 Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Although, compared to the harvest from the Beastman, it was much less.
But it was still much stronger than the Witch Race’s foundation.
Han Xing wasn’t modest, taking half of the Terrastones and Philosopher’s Stones with him.
As for the Calamity Divine Gold, he took it all.
He needed the Power to confront Divine Spirits, so naturally he needed more resources to enhance his territory’s strength.
However, these resources were not for building Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Through this battle, Han Xing also realized one of his own weaknesses.
That was, a lack of sufficient means of control.
Currently, even with all his methods, he could at most achieve two waves of strong control.
That is, to focus the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon’s attack twice.
If facing a single Divine Spirit, that’s fine.
But if there were more than two Divine Spirits attacking at once.
Then Han Xing would find himself in an extremely dangerous situation.
Although the likelihood of this happening was very small.
Han Xing still needed to take precautions.
Therefore, Han Xing needed some Defense Tower blueprints that had additional functions while being powerful.
Han Xing suddenly asked, "Uman, where are the blueprints in your treasure vault kept?"
Upon hearing this, Uman replied to Han Xing, "Master, our Beastman Tribe doesn’t have building blueprints."
"None?"
Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
He knew that after Uman signed the Lord Contract, it was impossible for him to deceive himself.
"Then do you not usually build Defense Towers, or other war tools?"
Uman respectfully replied, "Of course, we do, but when it comes to these sorts of things, we leave them entirely to the Dwarf Race."
"Including warships and war chariots, we purchase them all from the Dwarf Race."
At this point, Uman added, "Our Beastman Tribe has always maintained a cooperative relationship with the Dwarf Race."
"Master Forger Tadak is a close friend of mine."
"Whatever I need forged, I always commission him for help."
Han Xing was at a loss for words.
Uman spoke very casually, even feeling proud about maintaining a cooperative relationship with the Dwarf Race.
But what he didn’t know was, for such war weapons, commissioning other races to construct them.
It was both foolish and dangerous.
Not to mention the cut the Dwarf Race might take.
If they tampered with these weapons in any way.
With the Beastmen’s level of intelligence, they’d never realize it.
The Beastmen truly didn’t want to use their brains.
Anything involving a bit of technology, they gave entirely to other races to handle.
Han Xing shook his head and continued to ask, "Do you know what high-end technology the Dwarf Race has?"
Uman seemed a bit confused.
Han Xing explained, "I mean those Defense Towers."

"During the period when I was infected by the curse, the entire nation fell into that being’s hands."
"That Divine Spirit took away a large amount of our treasures..."
Hearing this, Han Xing nodded.
Then, as if offering comfort, he patted Uman on the shoulder.
But in truth, Han Xing was overjoyed inside.
It seemed that the God of Tricks was also quite the covetous type.
And this indicated that its treasure vault must be filled with immense and rich resources!
Then.
He followed Uman to check the resources of several other vaults.
Among them, the number of Shimmering Terra Stones was about 1.07 million, and Calamity Divine Gold was about 1,500.
Just enough to construct 150 Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Although, compared to the harvest from the Beastman, it was much less.
But it was still much stronger than the Witch Race’s foundation.
Han Xing wasn’t modest, taking half of the Terrastones and Philosopher’s Stones with him.
As for the Calamity Divine Gold, he took it all.
He needed the Power to confront Divine Spirits, so naturally he needed more resources to enhance his territory’s strength.
However, these resources were not for building Spiritual Godslaying Cannons.
Through this battle, Han Xing also realized one of his own weaknesses.
That was, a lack of sufficient means of control.
Currently, even with all his methods, he could at most achieve two waves of strong control.
That is, to focus the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon’s attack twice.
If facing a single Divine Spirit, that’s fine.
But if there were more than two Divine Spirits attacking at once.
Then Han Xing would find himself in an extremely dangerous situation.
Although the likelihood of this happening was very small.
Han Xing still needed to take precautions.
Therefore, Han Xing needed some Defense Tower blueprints that had additional functions while being powerful.
Han Xing suddenly asked, "Uman, where are the blueprints in your treasure vault kept?"
Upon hearing this, Uman replied to Han Xing, "Master, our Beastman Tribe doesn’t have building blueprints."
"None?"
Han Xing was momentarily stunned.
He knew that after Uman signed the Lord Contract, it was impossible for him to deceive himself.
"Then do you not usually build Defense Towers, or other war tools?"
Uman respectfully replied, "Of course, we do, but when it comes to these sorts of things, we leave them entirely to the Dwarf Race."
"Including warships and war chariots, we purchase them all from the Dwarf Race."
At this point, Uman added, "Our Beastman Tribe has always maintained a cooperative relationship with the Dwarf Race."
"Master Forger Tadak is a close friend of mine."
"Whatever I need forged, I always commission him for help."
Han Xing was at a loss for words.
Uman spoke very casually, even feeling proud about maintaining a cooperative relationship with the Dwarf Race.
But what he didn’t know was, for such war weapons, commissioning other races to construct them.
It was both foolish and dangerous.
Not to mention the cut the Dwarf Race might take.
If they tampered with these weapons in any way.
With the Beastmen’s level of intelligence, they’d never realize it.
The Beastmen truly didn’t want to use their brains.
Anything involving a bit of technology, they gave entirely to other races to handle.
Han Xing shook his head and continued to ask, "Do you know what high-end technology the Dwarf Race has?"
Uman seemed a bit confused.
Han Xing explained, "I mean those Defense Towers."

chapters.title: Chapter 580 - 361: Opening the Beastman Kingdom’s Treasury
paragraphs: "Have you ever seen defense towers with power similar to those in my territory?"
Upon hearing this, Uman quickly replied, "No, in this world, how could there be technology stronger than your defense towers!"
There was a hint of fear in its eyes.
It seemed to still vividly remember that shot Han Xing fired not long ago.
Hearing this, Han Xing showed a thoughtful expression.
After all, the [Spiritual Godslaying Cannon] was already a high-tier ancient weapon.
Coupled with the enhancement of two Holy Artifact Steles, its power was truly unique.
While the Dwarf Race had advanced technology, it wasn’t that exaggerated.
At this point, Uman added a remark.
"However, there are some that are quite comparable to the master’s defense towers."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes lit up again.
"What are they?"
He asked eagerly.
Uman recalled in his mind and then thought, "Seems to be called Silent Annihilation Lightning, Fury Heart Storm, Withered Snowflakes, Ghost Wind, and several other types of defense towers."
"These defense towers can simulate those calamities in the void and unleash even greater power..."
Simulating calamities?
Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
The calamities in the void were indeed terrifying in power.
And the deeper into the void, the calamities there could easily heavily injure demigods.
Han Xing suddenly thought: ’I remember, Coal Ball awakened a Great Calamity Skill before, which was about unleashing these calamities.’
’However, the power wasn’t as great as imagined, at most capable of injuring Legends.’
’Far from matching the power of those calamities deep in the void.’
’If the Dwarf Race could truly harness this power and refine it.’
’Then the power unleashed would indeed be comparable to my Spiritual Godslaying Cannon, maybe even surpass it!’
Because, Han Xing’s Spiritual Godslaying Cannon reached its destructive power through the enhancement of the Sun Crown Stele.
As for the Dwarf Race, Han Xing wasn’t sure if they had any related Holy Artifacts.
But the probability seemed low.
After all, Holy Artifacts were unique.
In other words.
The Dwarf Race’s Calamity Towers, without the enhancement of the Sun Crown Stele, already reached such terrifying destructive power.
If he could get them, Han Xing could mass-produce them.
With the enhancement from two Sun Crown Steles, their power would surely surpass the [Spiritual Godslaying Cannon]!
In his heart, Han Xing felt more and more intrigued about the Dwarf Race.
Han Xing asked, "Are these Calamity Towers the strongest weapons of the Dwarf Race?
Uman shook his head, "No, master."
"The Dwarf Race, as one of the three major races in the Holy Spirit Realm, has a depth and strength beyond imagination."
"The Calamity Tower is their top-tier weapon that they developed, but in reality, the Dwarf Race possesses much more that can rival the Calamity Tower."
"The biggest reason is that they have control of a complete ancient ruin."
Han Xing asked in confusion, "An ancient ruin?"
"Yes, they excavated numerous ancient weapon blueprints from that ancient ruin."
"Currently, most of the ancient weapons in the Holy Spirit Realm have flowed out from the Dwarf Race."
A look of realization appeared in Han Xing’s eyes.
So that’s it.
The Dwarf Race’s ancient weapons weren’t created by them.
They were based on blueprints found by excavating ruins.
Then crafted by them.
At this moment, Uman added again.
"By the way, I also heard Grandmaster Tadak mention, recently, they’ve discovered a new weapon blueprint in the ruin."
"This blueprint seems to harbor power surpassing high-tier ancient weapons."
"Tentatively named: Godslayer."
Godslayer.
Goodness!
This name alone sounds incredibly formidable.
Godslayer level weapon, even more powerful than high-tier ancient weapons.
This means, this thing is truly meant to deal with divine spirit-level beings?
Han Xing’s curiosity about the Dwarf Race grew stronger again.
Through this conversation.
Han Xing gained a deeper understanding of this vast race, the Dwarf Race.
And realized.
The three major races in the Holy Spirit Realm held strength and depth far beyond what he previously imagined.
At least.
Their side might possess means to deal with divine spirits just like his own.
Half an hour later...
Through conversations, Han Xing and his company finished exploring the Beastman Treasure Vault.
Besides taking some Philosopher’s Stone and Calamity Divine Gold.
Han Xing also took part of the rarer materials.
As for those Divine Artifacts, Han Xing didn’t take them.
Because most of those Divine Artifacts were level 60 equipment.
And had racial wearing requirements.
After tallying the treasure vault’s gains.
Han Xing’s figure flickered, and he walked out of the Beastman Treasure Vault, back to the Beastman Continent.
At this moment.
Uman was respectfully following behind Han Xing, seemingly waiting for his next instruction.
However, Han Xing glanced at it, and casually said, "Uman, let the Beastman Kingdom develop as they see fit next."
"I won’t bother managing you."
Upon hearing this, Uman was suddenly stricken with terror.
Then respectfully knelt and thanked.
Han Xing waved his hand and added, "But if there’s a place you can assist me, come at the first opportunity."
Uman nodded hastily and said, "Whenever the master summons, this servant will go through fire and water without hesitation."
Han Xing nodded.
"Next, handle the injuries on your body first."
"You’re too weak right now."
Uman’s face showed a sheepish smile.
It had been under a curse controlling its body for years, and just upon recovering, took a hit from Han Xing.
If not for relying on its demigod-level robust life force for support.
It would have been long dead by now.
Just as Uman was preparing to get up and leave.
Shen Yun suddenly remarked, "Brother Xing, something is flying over."
Upon hearing this.
Everyone simultaneously squinted their eyes and looked in the direction Shen Yun pointed.
In the distant sky, a small black dot seemed to appear.
Heading straight for the center of the Beastman Continent.
As the black dot flew closer and closer.
They gradually saw what the thing looked like.
It seemed to be a huge ship flying in the air...

chapters.title: Chapter 581 - 362: Purchasing Ancient Weapons
paragraphs: In the distance, a massive warship over a thousand meters long approached.
The ship’s hull, made of unknown materials, was entirely golden.
Under the sun’s rays, it emitted bursts of dazzling golden light.
As it came closer,
everyone saw it.
The sides of the ship had pure white wings,
resembling an angel’s wings, appearing both solemn and elegant.
Han Xing looked to Uman beside him and asked, "What is that thing?"
Uman thought for a moment and replied.
"The Dwarf Race’s warship, the Golden Angel..."
Han Xing asked in confusion, "The Dwarf Race, why are they here?"
Uman, looking a little embarrassed, said, "Maybe, because of me."
"Previously, the chains on me were crafted by the Dwarf Race, impossible to unbind through ordinary means."
"So, I contacted my close friend, Tadak."
"He must have received my message and rushed over immediately."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing nodded.
Uman had indeed mentioned before.
Master Forger Tadak from the Dwarf Race was his intimate friend.
Meanwhile,
on the Kingdom Continent, those ordinary Beastmen, upon seeing this sacredly radiant ship,
all knelt on the ground, paying respectful homage.
Cheng Jianyong, standing by, commented, "Tsk tsk, what a spectacle."
"When we arrived, there wasn’t such a reception."
"If one didn’t know better, they’d think this guy saved your Beastman Race."
Hearing Cheng Jianyong’s slightly mocking voice,
Uman showed an awkward smile on his face.
He explained, "The Dwarf Race and our Beastman Race have always maintained a good cooperative relationship."
"Besides being highly skilled in forging, Grandmaster Tadak also possesses middle-tier Legend combat strength."
"Even among the Dwarf Race, his status is more honorable than some Demigods."
"That’s why he receives such high honors."
Listening to Uman’s explanation, Han Xing showed a surprised expression.
"More honorable than Demigods?
"I’ve always heard you mention Master Forger, Master Forger."
"What exactly can this Master Forger do?"
Upon hearing this, Uman began to explain patiently.
"It’s like this, Master."
"In the Holy Spirit Realm, equipment is divided into six levels: common, refined, rare, legend, epic, and divine artifact, which you should know."
Han Xing nodded.
"The higher the quality of these weapons, the stronger the power."
"But correspondingly, the difficulty in forging increases as well."
"A single mistake can result in failure."
"Moreover, if one hasn’t surpassed the corresponding forging level, it’s hopeless to think about crafting high-quality weapons."
Uman paused and continued, "And a Master Forger is someone capable of crafting divine artifacts."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes showed a peculiar look.
It requires a Grandmaster Level to craft divine artifacts.
In this case, wouldn’t all the billions of survivors on Blue Star be Master Forgers?
After all, they just need the blueprint to forge directly.
The difference is only in their success rate.
Han Xing asked, "Besides these, do Master Forgers have any other capabilities?"
Uman seemed puzzled about what Han Xing meant.
After all, just being able to craft divine artifacts is already quite formidable, isn’t it?
So many people crave it.
Despite this thought, Uman still replied, "Besides crafting divine artifacts, their success rate for crafting other equipment is also much higher."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing finally understood.
Now that’s more like it.
Players crafting equipment using blueprints have a frustratingly low success rate.
Especially for higher quality blueprints, the success rate is extremely low.
This appears to be the distinction between the natives of this world and them.
As they chatted,
in the sky,
the holy warship, radiating golden light, descended from above.
From it,
a figure slowly walked down.
He wore a luxurious robe, arms crossed, standing proudly.
Although less than 1.2 meters tall, resembling a human child,
his features appeared quite aged,
like a seventy-year-old elder, even with some wrinkles on his face.
A typical Dwarf Race appearance.
At this moment,
the dwarf surveyed the crowd on the scene.
Upon seeing Han Xing and the others, his eyes flashed with indifference, appearing supremely arrogant.
Then, he focused his gaze on Uman.
His arrogant eyes instantly gleamed with brilliance.
"Uman! My good brother, you’ve truly recovered!"
The dwarf shouted excitedly, then hopped over to Uman.
Uman nodded, a genuine smile spreading across his face.
"Tadak, my dear friend, you weren’t mistaken, I have indeed recovered."
With that, they were already in contact.
Uman, standing three meters tall,
had to squat down to embrace the dwarf.
Moments later,
the peculiar pair of a dwarf and a beastman gradually separated.
At this moment, Dwarf Tadak released divine power, scanning Uman.
Seemingly confirming something.
A moment later, he exclaimed, "Unimaginable, that you’ve genuinely freed yourself from such a terrifying curse."
"When you sent me the communication message earlier, I was surprised for quite a while,"
"Then, I rushed over immediately."
A sincere smile appeared on Uman’s face.
"My dear friend, thank you so much."
Dwarf Tadak also showed a gratified smile.
"By the way, Brother Uman, are the Divine Sealing Chains on you already unbound?"
Uman nodded, "Yes, I forgot to tell you."
"Sorry for making you come all this way."

chapters.title: Chapter 582 - 362: Purchasing Ancient Weapons_2
paragraphs: Tadak waved his hand, "No trouble at all."
"You’ve lifted such a significant curse, it’s only right for me to come by and celebrate."
It was obvious.
Their relationship was indeed close.
But in the eyes of Han Xing and the others, it somehow seemed a bit odd.
After all.
Their body sizes were too different.
It seemed Tadak noticed the strange look in Han Xing and the others’ eyes.
Tadak asked in confusion, "Uman, who are these people?"
Uman turned his gaze to Han Xing.
After receiving a nod from Han Xing.
Uman explained, "Brother Tadak, these are warriors from the Human Race, and they are honored guests of our Beastman tribe."
Han Xing did not let Uman mention how they dealt with the God of Tricks.
After all, it did sound too extraordinary.
Moreover, Han Xing didn’t want to expend energy explaining so much.
The dwarf Tadak just nodded lightly after listening.
The gaze he directed at Han Xing and the others was still filled with arrogance.
Then he turned his focus back to Uman.
After a round of reminiscing.
Uman said, "My dear friend, let me take you to the Royal Palace for a while."
"Then, as always, we’ll have a couple of drinks."
The dwarf Tadak nodded, "That sounds perfect."
Just as he spoke.
Uman suddenly realized something.
Damn, his Royal Palace was gone!
Half a day ago, Han Xing blasted it through, and it hadn’t been repaired yet.
Seeing that something was off with Uman.
Tadak asked, "What’s wrong?"
Uman wore an awkward smile and apologized, "No big deal, we’ll just go somewhere else today."
A few minutes later.
The party appeared in another smaller stone palace.
With a few casual excuses, Uman brushed off the matter of the God of Tricks.
Tadak had a thoughtful look on his face.
After all, not everyone could sense what happened on the Beastman Continent before.
You had to at least possess high-tier Demigod strength to qualify.
At this moment.
Everyone sat on a large stone chair.
Uman had his people bring in a lavish feast.
At this time, Han Xing suddenly asked, "Master Tadak."
"I have a few questions I’d like to consult. I wonder if it would be convenient for you."
The dwarf glanced at Han Xing, then snorted disdainfully, as if he didn’t want to engage with Han Xing at all.
Uman, with a smile, said, "Brother Tadak, these human guests are my esteemed visitors."
"This Lord Han Xing is also the contemporary Saint Master of the Witch Race."
"Young and promising, with great strength."
"His future is limitless."
Hearing this, the dwarf Tadak was a bit surprised.
He began to reassess Han Xing.
Upon detecting Han Xing’s legendary level strength.
Tadak nodded, saying plainly, "Ask your questions."
The tone was still arrogantly consistent.
However, compared to before, where he didn’t want to communicate at all, it was much improved now.
But Han Xing didn’t mind.
It was just a matter of tone, no need to take it too seriously.
As long as the other party was willing to answer his questions, those aspects could be ignored.
Han Xing wasn’t the type to kill indiscriminately.
Previously on the Beastman Continent.
It was because those guys weren’t willing to part with what they deserved.
Still, the dwarves owed Han Xing nothing.
After a pause, Han Xing asked.
"Master Tadak, do you know where Kaelon’s laboratory is?"
Hearing the name, the dwarf Tadak looked slightly surprised.
"How do you know this name?"
"Heard about it."
Han Xing shrugged, casually throwing out an excuse.
After all, it wasn’t possible to tell a dwarf.
He discovered it in the Cloud Secret Realm.
Tadak thought for a moment and didn’t press further, instead replying.
"Lord Kaelon is now one of our top researchers."
"Many advanced technologies of our people are his handiwork."
"His information is classified as top secret within our race."
"So the fact that you know his name surprises me."
Tadak gave Han Xing a long, deep look before answering, "Lord Kaelon has many laboratories."
"I don’t know which one you mean."
"So I can’t answer that question for you."

Although that Spiritual Puppet no longer offered him much improvement.
Han Xing still wanted to see if there was anything else he could discover.
After finishing this question, Han Xing continued, "I have another question."
"I heard that Rhythm Black Iron can be traded with dwarf master forgers for ancient weapon blueprints. Is this true?"
Tadak nodded.
There was nothing strange about that.
After all, the Dwarf Race’s search for Rhythm Black Iron was known throughout the Holy Spirit Realm.
"It’s true."

Han Xing nodded, "Yes, I was planning to go to the Dwarf Realm."
But Tadak waved his hand directly, "If it’s not a large transaction, there’s no need to go to the Dwarf Realm."
"The grandmasters are all very busy."
"I happen to have a batch of ancient weapon blueprints here. See if there’s anything you need."
Hearing this, Han Xing was slightly surprised.
"What blueprints do you have there?"
Tadak chuckled softly, then with a grand gesture, displayed over a dozen yellowed blueprints in front of Han Xing.
Han Xing scanned them briefly.

After all.
Their body sizes were too different.

Uman turned his gaze to Han Xing.

paragraphs: [Enhanced Barrier]: Defense Value 50000, includes Basic Resilience Aura, price: 10000 Rhythm Black Iron
[Disaster Shelter]: Defense Value 100000, includes Intermediate Shock Absorption Aura, price: 10000 Rhythm Black Iron.
After examining these blueprints, Han Xing felt somewhat uninterested.
Clearly, Tadak didn’t bring anything good this time.
These blueprints were, at best, on the same level as the Hellfire Missile Silo.
However, the advantage lies in their low price.
You only need less than ten thousand Rhythm Black Iron to trade for them.
Seeing Han Xing’s expression, Tadak had a mocking smile on his face.
"Don’t think my pricing is expensive, even though Rhythm Black Iron is a rare metal."
"But compared to these blueprints, it’s worth it."
"If you can’t afford it, I have a batch of lower-level blueprints."
After hearing this, Han Xing showed a strange expression.
Is Rhythm Black Iron really that precious?
From the dwarf’s tone, it seemed like ten thousand Rhythm Black Iron was a lot?
He didn’t speak, instead he asked: "Grandmaster Tadak, there’s no need to look at those lower-level blueprints."
"I want to know if you have more advanced blueprints."
Tadak’s eyes showed a hint of disdain again.
Can’t even afford these, yet wants more advanced blueprints?
Tadak was about to lose his temper.
But after thinking about it, he felt there was no need to argue with this human.
It was just right to let this human see the strength of the Dwarf Race.
"Yes." Tadak said directly.
After saying this.
A new blueprint appeared in front of Han Xing.
[Ancient Weapon: VII Type Mark Robot]: Can be created by consuming materials, producing a Mark Robot with Five-star Elite Level strength.
Note: Mark Robots possess extremely rich battlefield experience and are naturally born combat weapons.
Upon seeing this blueprint, Han Xing’s eyes finally lit up.
Five-star Soldier Type!
And it possesses elite-level strength!
In Han Xing’s current camp, the technology of the wolf cavalry and the Minotaur Camp had already been maxed out.
The highest level soldiers summoned were only level 50, which is the limit of Four-star.
This level is fine against ordinary monsters.
Against those Fifth-Turned Creatures, it gradually becomes ineffective.
Except for Chimera.
Han Xing doesn’t have any Tier Five soldier types at hand.
This [VII Type Mark Robot] is equivalent to strengthening the territory’s military forces once more for Han Xing.
At this moment, Han Xing eagerly asked: "Grandmaster Tadak, how much Rhythm Black Iron are you planning to sell this blueprint for?"
After hearing this, Tadak looked at Han Xing with some surprise.
Could it be that this kid was really planning to buy it?
After pondering for a moment, Tadak slowly quoted a price.
"Fifty thousand."
After saying this, he tentatively looked at Han Xing.
But unexpectedly, Han Xing simply said: "I’ll take it!"
"Including those blueprints you showed earlier, I want them all!"
After hearing this, Tadak’s eyes showed surprise.
Seemingly incredulous, he said: "All... all of them?"
"You wouldn’t..."
He was about to say, you wouldn’t be tricking me, right?
But then he saw Han Xing wave his hand grandly.
On the floor of the Royal Palace, there appeared a pile of Rhythm Black Iron stacked like a small hill!
"Oh my god!"
Tadak’s eyes suddenly widened.
"Here’s 200,000, should be enough to trade for all the blueprints you have."
At this moment, Tadak suddenly stood up and took a deep breath.
"This... this much?"
His tone was filled with intense shock.
Even having some doubts whether he was seeing things.
To know.
This much Rhythm Black Iron, even in his forging career, he hadn’t encountered it many times.
No, or perhaps only those three grandmasters in the entire Dwarf Kingdom could have the privilege to mobilize this much Rhythm Black Iron at once.
Han Xing and his company looked at Tadak perplexedly, seemingly not understanding why this guy was so shocked.
After all, the quantity of Rhythm Black Iron he was pulling out now.
Compared to his own reserve stocks, it was hardly worth mentioning.
At this moment, Tadak spoke with a serious tone: "Human Race, are you sure you want to use so much Rhythm Black Iron for the exchange?"
Han Xing nodded, "Of course, otherwise why would I take it out?"
Tadak was rebuked yet didn’t get angry at all.
His eyes were filled only with the desire for Rhythm Black Iron.
He quickly responded: "Good, good, let’s trade immediately!"
Accordingly, both sides couldn’t wait to collect the items from the ground.
[Obtained Ancient Weapon: Holy War Spear Launcher Blueprint*1...]
[Obtained Ancient Weapon: VII Type Mark Robot Blueprint*1...]
After a dozen prompts in a row.
Both sides had satisfied expressions on their faces.
While the dwarf Tadak’s smile seemed barely contained.
Han Xing might not know.
Rhythm Black Iron, this metal is in short supply within the Dwarf Race.
It has a significant role, which is to increase the crafting experience for these master forgers and grandmasters.
Every strike, the unique melody born from it, can inspire them, thus enhancing their forging skills.
Accumulated over time, it could break through to higher forging levels.
This is one of the secrets of the Dwarf Race, never disclosed to other races.
Therefore, those forging masters particularly need large amounts of Rhythm Black Iron to accumulate forging experience.
Striving to break through to the higher level as soon as possible.
But evidently, the amount of Rhythm Black Iron is limited.
Even Tadak, a master forger, doesn’t get much of it allocated normally.
200,000 Rhythm Black Iron already equates to four years’ worth for him!
Looking at the pile of Rhythm Black Iron in his Space Ring.
Tadak couldn’t help but feel exceptionally motivated.
"With so much Rhythm Black Iron for me to craft, my crafting experience can be greatly enhanced."
"This way, I’m even closer to breaking through to the Grandmaster realm!"

chapters.title: Chapter 584 - 363: Three Kings Conference
paragraphs: Tadak’s eyes lit up with surprise and delight.
The gaze towards Han Xing no longer held the previous arrogance.
It even carried a hint of expectation.
However.
Han Xing still looked at him with eager eyes and asked, "Grandmaster Tadak, do you have any other blueprints?"
Tadak’s hands trembled as he heard this.
Then he coughed awkwardly and said, "For now, no, I don’t have any."
Hearing this, Han Xing sighed with a bit of disappointment.
At this moment, Tadak asked with a probing tone.
"Uh, esteemed hero of the Human Race, may I ask?"
"How much Rhythm Black Iron do you have on you, if it’s convenient to disclose?"
His tone was completely different from before.
It even carried a touch of inquiry.
Even the Beastman King beside him looked at his change with some surprise.
It seemed Tadak was afraid Han Xing would misunderstand, and he explained, "I have no intention of prying into your personal affairs."
"But if the quantity is large, I can lead you to exchange for more high-level ancient weapons in my realm."
Hearing this, Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
He asked excitedly, "More high-level ancient weapons."
"Can those Calamity Defense Tower blueprints also be exchanged?"
Tadak was taken aback, "I didn’t expect you to even know about the Catastrophe-level Weapons of our realm."
He glanced at Uman in the distance.
Uman lowered his head somewhat sheepishly.
However, Tadak didn’t mind.
Instead, he continued, "Catastrophe Weapons are the pinnacle of our realm’s technology."
"Generally, we do not sell them externally."
"However, if you have enough Rhythm Black Iron, I can seek special permission from the King."
At this moment.
Han Xing understood.
It’s not a matter of not selling; it’s about whether you can offer a tempting figure.
As long as you pay, everything is for sale!
This style of the Dwarf Race quite suited Han Xing’s taste.
Han Xing nodded, "What’s the approximate price, just give me a number."
Tadak thought for a moment, "If you’re purchasing a finished Catastrophe-level Weapon, one is worth about 100,000 Rhythm Black Iron.
"If what you want is the blueprint, this price would multiply several times."
"I estimate at least 3 million or more Rhythm Black Iron!"
After saying this, Tadak cautiously glanced at Han Xing.
Hearing this, Han Xing waved his hand, "No problem!"
"If we go to the Dwarf Realm, can we trade immediately?"
However, these words landed on Tadak’s ears.
Good heavens!
This means, do you really have it?
million!
Do you even know what that means?
In his entire life, he’d never seen so much Rhythm Black Iron!
Rhythm Black Iron, while not top-grade in quality, is extremely scarce.
Moreover, it has many uses and is usually very hard to collect.
However, Tadak didn’t know.
Han Xing’s method of obtaining Rhythm Black Iron is quite different from theirs.
As a Survivor.
They could open Rhythm Black Iron from the Bright Moon Treasure Chest.
After several Battle Merit Store rounds.
Countless Survivors have opened Bright Moon Treasure Chests.
And all the Rhythm Black Iron they obtained was in Han Xing’s possession.
So far.
Han Xing has amassed a total of 15 million!
Therefore.
Regarding Tadak’s pricing, Han Xing didn’t find it expensive at all!
After all, those are Catastrophe Weapons, far more powerful than the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon.
To exchange them for 3 million Rhythm Black Iron would be a huge profit!
Looking at Han Xing’s eager appearance.
Tadak was also eager and coughed, "Not so fast."
"I mentioned earlier that I need to seek permission from the King."
"Even if you arrive in the Dwarf Realm, you’ll still need to wait a few days."
Han Xing thought for a moment.
Feeling that waiting a few days was not an issue.
So he continued, "Then let’s not waste time, let’s set off now.
Tadak didn’t expect this human to be so decisive.
But when he thought of the possibility of hundreds of thousands of Rhythm Black Iron in his possession.
If this deal could be made.
He would earn a great profit just from commission!
And if the Dwarf King was pleased, he might even gain some credit.
So Tadak immediately said, "Alright, then let’s set off now."
"To the Dwarf Realm."
With these words.
Both parties stood up simultaneously and walked toward the outside of the Royal Palace.
At this moment, Uman sat on the throne, bewildered.
What the heck?
They just left me behind?
Wasn’t I supposed to be the protagonist of this meeting?
At this time, Tadak’s voice sounded in his ear.
"Uman, my dear friend, I see you still have injuries. Stay in the Beastman Kingdom to recuperate for now."
"I’ll come to visit you in a while."
Upon hearing this, a smile appeared on Uman’s lips.
The unhappiness in his heart was instantly thrown to the skies,
In the boundless skies.
The Golden Angel Battleship flapped its pure white angelic wings, flying gracefully in the air.
Inside the ship’s cabin.
Han Xing and Tadak were alone together.
As for Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, and the other two.
They followed on the Sky Island behind the Golden Angel Battleship.
On top.
The divine power of the four covered them.
Even Tadak didn’t know what was on the Sky Island.
This was also a precautionary measure by Han Xing.
"Grandmaster Tadak, is this Golden Angel Battleship considered an ancient weapon?" Han Xing couldn’t help but ask.
Hearing this, Tadak shook his head, "Esteemed friend of the Human Race, the Golden Angel Battleship is a battleship independently developed by our race, and does not belong to ancient weapons."
"And its developer, you must have heard of, our realm’s Chief Scientist, Kaelon."
