The divine power of the four covered them.
Even Tadak didn’t know what was on the Sky Island.
This was also a precautionary measure by Han Xing.
"Grandmaster Tadak, is this Golden Angel Battleship considered an ancient weapon?" Han Xing couldn’t help but ask.
Hearing this, Tadak shook his head, "Esteemed friend of the Human Race, the Golden Angel Battleship is a battleship independently developed by our race, and does not belong to ancient weapons."
"And its developer, you must have heard of, our realm’s Chief Scientist, Kaelon."

chapters.title: Chapter 585 - 363: Three Kings Conference
paragraphs: Hearing this name, Han Xing nodded in sudden realization.
Unexpectedly, Kaelon, who was once bewitched by the beauty of an Elf race maiden in that palace, has grown to such heights.
"Grandmaster Tadak, what exactly is the difference between the so-called ancient weapons and the weapons you developed yourselves?" Han Xing continued to ask.
Tadak seemed reluctant to answer this question.
However, as Han Xing threw out 1000 pieces of Rhythm Black Iron.
Tadak’s eyes instantly lit up.
He coughed twice, pretending to be reserved.
"Many people before you have asked this question."
"Since you want to know so badly, I’ll explain it to you today."
After speaking, Tadak casually put the Rhythm Black Iron on the ground into his space ring.
Han Xing assumed a listening posture, pretending not to have seen Tadak’s actions.
"You should know that our Dwarf Race has control over a complete ancient ruins, right?"
Han Xing nodded, "I know, but I’m not clear about what’s inside."
Tadak continued, "In fact, I’m not very clear on what’s inside this ancient ruins either."
"All I know is that there are opportunities inside, capable of finding many extremely powerful weapons or blueprints not belonging to this era."
"And the blueprints brought out from there are all collectively referred to as ancient weapons by us."
Han Xing realized, so that’s the origin of the term ancient weapon.
Seeing Tadak’s easygoing demeanor, Han Xing asked again, "Is it true that the Dwarf Race recently found a Godslayer level weapon in the ancient ruins?"
Upon hearing this, Tadak’s expression changed again.
He said angrily, "That old fellow Uman, he’s telling you everything."
Han Xing awkwardly smiled.
He couldn’t exactly tell Tadak that your good buddy Uman has become my contracted beast, right?
However, when Han Xing once again threw down 2000 pieces of Rhythm Black Iron.
Tadak’s expression gradually improved and he no longer pursued the matter.
A moment later, he nodded, "The Godslayer level weapon is real."
"But what kind of weapon it is and what kind of power it has, I don’t know.
"Such confidential information is known only to a few in the entire Dwarf Race."
Han Xing showed a thoughtful expression.
It seems the ancient ruins controlled by the Dwarf Race is truly a land of opportunity.
They’ve found so many ancient weapons and blueprints inside, most of which are used by the Dwarf Race themselves.
The rest of the blueprints have flowed into the Holy Spirit Realm, bringing countless resources to the Dwarf Race.
This race has developed to this extent.
The ancient ruins, you could say, is crucial to it.
And now.
Even things beyond high-tier ancient weapons have appeared.
It’s hard to imagine how many secrets are still hidden inside.
Since a Godslayer level weapon has already appeared, could there be weapons even above Godslayer level inside?

Tadak seemed to see through Han Xing’s thoughts and said with a smile, "Kid, are you thinking that the ancient ruins are a treasure land, where high-tier ancient weapons and Godslayer level weapons can be picked up at will?"
Han Xing was struck dumb as it was indeed his thought.
He was even considering when he would have the chance to venture into the ancient ruins.
Before Han Xing could answer, Tadak continued to speak.
"No need to deny it."
"Everyone in the world thinks like you, believing that our Dwarf Race’s development into one of the three major strong races in the Holy Spirit Realm is based on these ancient ruins."
"But how could they know the sacrifices our race has made to explore these ruins?"
Han Xing queried in perplexity, "Sacrifices?"
Tadak slowly sighed.
The topic seemed to touch upon a certain sadness of his.
Seeing this, Han Xing once again threw 4000 pieces of Rhythm Black Iron onto the ground.
Tadak’s gaze at Han Xing became increasingly pleasing.
This kid really knows the game!
"Yes."
Tadak continued to elaborate, "The ancient ruins, while holding opportunities, also contain extremely terrifying dangers.
"Some forbidden areas inside can cause even Demigod level powerhouses to fall instantly."
"Moreover, there is a restriction that only allows powerhouses below Demigod level to enter..."
"This has led to our race sending out the most elite Legendary Powerhouses every few years to explore the ancient ruins."
"Up to now, we’ve sacrificed at least a hundred Legendary Powerhouses..."
"Among them, many were geniuses with the potential to break through to Demigod, even high-tier Demigod."
Speaking to this point, Tadak slowly sighed again.
And Han Xing, once again gained a clear understanding of these ancient ruins.
Indeed, where there are opportunities, there are dangers.
This is an unchanging truth in any world.
Han Xing nodded, "Thank you, Grandmaster Tadak, for clearing my doubts."
Tadak waved his hand.
By nature, he usually wouldn’t say so much under normal circumstances.
Some secrets are even forbidden to be told to people of other races.
But he couldn’t help it.
Han Xing gave too much...
After that, the two remained silent on their journey.
The Golden Angel Battleship continued its advance.
After seven or eight hours, Uman finally said slowly, "The Dwarf Realm, it’s quite a distance from the Beastman Realm."
"Previously, I used a special teleportation technique to arrive at the Beastman Kingdom so quickly."
"It will still take several days to get there."
Han Xing nodded, expressing understanding.
Three days later...
The Golden Angel Battleship had advanced several million kilometers.
Passing through vast barren areas.
Civilization finally appeared ahead.

chapters.title: Chapter 586 - 363: Three Kings Conference
paragraphs: In the distance.
Han Xing saw there were enormous Sky Islands.
Above them were towering structures, reaching into the clouds, filled with a magical aura.
Those Sky Islands were the population cities of the Dwarf Race.
At this moment.
Cheng Jianyong, Zhang Lianmeng, and the other two’s figures flickered.
Appearing beside Han Xing.
Then they gave a wink.
Indicating that their Sky Island was already set up.
Han Xing nodded.
Through the earlier conversation, they understood.
The Dwarf Race likely did not know yet.
The ones initiating the divine war in the Beastman Kingdom and successfully defeating the Divine Spirit were them.
So, Han Xing felt there was no need to reveal themselves so soon.
Thus, he placed the Sky Island outside the Dwarf Realm as one of his trump cards.
With Coal Ball guarding it and Han Xing having the Oracle Throne for long-distance teleportation,
even if an unexpected situation arose, they could teleport back immediately.
As the saying goes, the more you dance, the quicker you die.
If we can stay low-key, let’s stay low-key.
If not, then let’s blast our way through.
"Han Xing Warrior, ahead is the border city of my race."
"You and your friends will accompany me later for inspection," Tadak said, looking at Han Xing.
Han Xing nodded, without much surprise.
For such a grand race, natural entry was not permitted.
Other races entering had to undergo inspection.
Then.
The Golden Angel Battleship reached the Witch Race Border Sky Island.
This place resembled a port.
Numerous aircraft were docked around.
These aircraft had diverse appearances, each with its unique style.
They did not seem to reflect the Dwarf Race’s style.
In this border city, Han Xing also saw many powerful buildings.
A blend of futuristic technology and magical style.
Moreover, on this border Sky Island.
Han Xing sensed the presence of at least two Legendary Level powerhouses.
Han Xing became clearer about the power of the Dwarf Race.
At this moment.
When those routine inspection officers saw Tadak, respect was written all over their faces.
They saluted Tadak.
"Greetings, Master Tadak!"
All the Dwarf soldiers behind stood at attention and saluted together.
Tadak waved his hand.
Indicating for them to relax.
As the Beastman King said, apart from his Legendary Level strength, Tadak also held the title of Master Forger.
His status in the Dwarf Race was comparable to that of an average Demigod Level powerhouse.
Such treatment was not surprising.
At this time, the inspecting officer also noticed Han Xing and his friends behind Tadak.
"Master, who are these?" the officer couldn’t help asking.
Tadak casually replied, "A few friends from the Human Race. I brought them to discuss trade matters with the Dwarf Race."
"I see."
Upon hearing they were friends of Tadak, the officer’s gaze towards Han Xing and his group became more gentle.
Then, the routine check ensued.
The Dwarf officer held a special instrument, scanning Han Xing and his companions.
Through the detection, the officer was amazed to discover.
These five humans all possessed Legendary Level strength.
His eyes showed a strong shock.
Then, he saluted again, "Greetings, Legends."
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were somewhat surprised.
It was their first time entering another race without facing discrimination.
For a moment, the impression of the Dwarf Race improved.
As previously mentioned.
In the Holy Spirit Realm, Legendary Level was recognized as a powerhouse, regardless of which race.
Unlike the Beastman Race and Dragon Race, whose attitude was ’I’m the best in the world’ mindset.
The Dwarf Race’s civilization was more inclusive.
So, Han Xing and his companions receiving respect from these Dwarf officers was expected.
This also indicated the advanced state of the Dwarf Race.
At least, they lacked the arrogance prevalent in many other races in this world.
They did not discriminate against Han Xing’s Human Race identity.
This was quite commendable.
After the inspection was complete.
Tadak led Han Xing and his group into the Dwarf Realm.
Along the way.
They passed through more large cities.
The facilities remained advanced.
Besides Han Xing’s Golden Angel Battleship.
Han Xing also saw that in the nearby skies.
Different styled vehicles were floating.
Some vehicles resembled transparent water droplets, with no visibility inside.
Some vehicles were smooth mirrors.
Others were simply pitch-black palaces...
However, this was not what caught Han Xing’s particular attention.
What surprised Han Xing the most.
Was sensing Legendary Level presences on those vehicles.
And not just one.
Han Xing asked, "Master Tadak, these vehicles, they’re not creations of the Dwarf Race, are they?"
Tadak nodded, "Yes, those belong to other races."
"You see that droplet, it’s a powerhouse from the Water Island race."
"That mirror houses a powerhouse from the Clouds of the Sky."
"As for that palace, it’s from the Realm of Darkness."
"It’s said that their Divine Son has come this time."
Since becoming acquainted with Han Xing, this Dwarf elder became more talkative.
Han Xing was somewhat surprised, "All from different races, and there seem to be many Legendary Level powerhouses?"
Tadak slowly said, "That’s why I mentioned earlier that we might need to wait a few days."
"Recently, the Holy Spirit Realm has been in turmoil, with major events occurring frequently."
"With the Elf Race’s mediation, our race and the Giant Race have reached a temporary ceasefire agreement."
"As for the agreement’s content, further discussions are needed."
"This time, the Elf King and the Giant King have both come to our race."
"In short, the Three Kings Meeting."

chapters.title: Chapter 587 - 364: Gathering of the Strong, Scramble for Spots
paragraphs: "The Three Kings Meeting..."
Everyone murmured the name silently.
What puzzled Han Xing was.
Among the three kings, besides the Dwarf King,
The other two are the Elf King and the Giant King.
It makes sense for the powerhouses of these two races to come to the Dwarf Realm.
However, looking at these vehicles, it’s evident that there are strong beings from other races as well.
Why have they come to the Dwarf Realm?
Regarding this question, Tadak also shook his head, indicating he was not sure.
Han Xing didn’t ask further.
Then, they all arrived at the Dwarf Kingdom, within the Central Continent.
As the Central Continent,
Its size is naturally immense.
It is more than ten times larger than the central continent of the Beastman Kingdom.
Comparable to the size of a star, its end cannot be seen with the naked eye.
Even if an ordinary person spends their whole life without the aid of vehicles, they may be unable to explore the entirety of this continent.
On it, cities are connected to other cities.
In between, there are vast wilderness areas.
Yet despite this, the number of large and small cities has reached a terrifying figure.
Countless dwarves live and prosper on it.
Tadak’s voice came from behind.
"Dear human warriors, there are many cities on the Dwarf Continent."
"But the most important and prosperous is still our Central Royal Capital.
"This time, I will take you there directly."
"Only there can you meet His Majesty the King."
Han Xing and the others nodded and then followed Tadak as they flew over the continent.
On the Central Continent, they flew for quite a while.
They finally arrived at an exceedingly vast royal capital.
The upper-level magical-style buildings were everywhere, orderly and structured.
Furthermore, they looked immaculate, appearing very clean.
Tadak brought Han Xing to a few upscale inns, and then explained, "I will now report this matter to His Majesty the King.
"However, as I mentioned to you before, the King might be discussing important matters."
"It might take some time for him to respond to me."
"Once there is news, I will contact you immediately."
"In the meantime, you should stay here in the Dwarf Royal Capital."
Everyone nodded.
"By the way."
Tadak suddenly turned his head and continued, "The Dwarf Race is quite open, if you’re feeling bored, you can explore the royal capital."
"The common currency here is also the Spirit Core."
"Of course, if you have other precious items, they’ll be more welcomed."
"Like Rhythm Black Iron, Philosopher’s Stone, etc..."
After saying this,
Tadak turned and left.
After he left, everyone found rooms for themselves,
However, for three consecutive days.
Tadak didn’t send them any message.
The next day...
The five gathered together.
Cheng Jianyong, puzzled, said at this time, "Brother Xing, could that old dwarf have stood us up?"
"He hasn’t responded to us for so long?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Probably not."
"It is obvious that the Dwarf Race is desperate for Rhythm Black Iron."
"This time, I hinted that I have a few million Rhythm Black Iron in my possession."
"I think they wouldn’t abandon this deal."
After pausing, Han Xing continued: "Let’s wait and see."
Everyone nodded.
At this moment, Shen Yun frowned as he analyzed.
"Have you felt it?"
"Recently, the number of legendary-level auras gathering in the Dwarf Royal Capital is increasing."
"Moreover, these auras are quite special, they don’t seem like legendary dwarves."
Cheng Jianyong nodded, "I felt it too."
"Every day, there are many legendary auras flying over our heads.
"After three days, I feel there are at least a thousand legendary powerhouses gathered in the royal capital, including several demigods."
"I don’t know what’s happening."
Everyone felt utterly puzzled.
This many legendary powerhouses is indeed strange.
However, as newcomers in the Dwarf Race, they had no connections.
They didn’t know who to ask.
Seeing their worried appearances,
Han Xing suddenly smiled and said, "Isn’t it simple? Just find someone to ask, and we’ll know."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong hesitated, "Uh... Brother Xing, wouldn’t that be inappropriate?"
"This is the Dwarf Royal Capital. If a fight breaks out, wouldn’t they stop us?"
Han Xing gave him a sideways glance, "Who the hell said anything about fighting?"
"Do you not know what friendly communication means?"
Cheng Jianyong was moved, tentatively asking: "Brother Xing means, we’ll secretly tie them up!"
"Then interrogate them harshly?"
Hearing this, Han Xing’s face turned black again.
"Can’t you just ask openly and straightforwardly?"
"What’s going through your head?"
Cheng Jianyong embarrassedly scratched his head.
Then, the five of them stepped out of the inn.
On the streets, people came and went.
Most were dwarves dressed in casual attire.
Among them, some beastmen, giants, elemental creatures, and elves with pointed ears were mixed in.
Although now the Dwarf Royal Capital has gathered a variety of people from different major races,
they were seeing humans for the first time.
Each of them cast curious glances at Han Xing and his group.
Han Xing and the others were already accustomed to such gazes.
However, at this moment.
A two-headed ogre with blue skin seemed to have set its sights on Han Xing and the others.
The ogre’s bloated body had two heads whispering among themselves.
From time to time, they looked at Han Xing and the others, eyes filled with a hungry gaze.
Regarding this look, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but complain: "Damn it, does this ogre want to eat us?"

After he left, everyone found rooms for themselves,
However, for three consecutive days.
Tadak didn’t send them any message.
The next day...
The five gathered together.
Cheng Jianyong, puzzled, said at this time, "Brother Xing, could that old dwarf have stood us up?"
"He hasn’t responded to us for so long?"
Han Xing shook his head, "Probably not."
"It is obvious that the Dwarf Race is desperate for Rhythm Black Iron."
"This time, I hinted that I have a few million Rhythm Black Iron in my possession."
"I think they wouldn’t abandon this deal."
After pausing, Han Xing continued: "Let’s wait and see."
Everyone nodded.
At this moment, Shen Yun frowned as he analyzed.
"Have you felt it?"
"Recently, the number of legendary-level auras gathering in the Dwarf Royal Capital is increasing."
"Moreover, these auras are quite special, they don’t seem like legendary dwarves."
Cheng Jianyong nodded, "I felt it too."
"Every day, there are many legendary auras flying over our heads.
"After three days, I feel there are at least a thousand legendary powerhouses gathered in the royal capital, including several demigods."
"I don’t know what’s happening."
Everyone felt utterly puzzled.
This many legendary powerhouses is indeed strange.
However, as newcomers in the Dwarf Race, they had no connections.
They didn’t know who to ask.
Seeing their worried appearances,
Han Xing suddenly smiled and said, "Isn’t it simple?
Just find someone to ask, and we’ll know."
Hearing this, Cheng Jianyong hesitated, "Uh...
Brother Xing, wouldn’t that be inappropriate?"
"This is the Dwarf Royal Capital.
If a fight breaks out, wouldn’t they stop us?"
Han Xing gave him a sideways glance, "Who the hell said anything about fighting?"
"Do you not know what friendly communication means?"
Cheng Jianyong was moved, tentatively asking: "Brother Xing means, we’ll secretly tie them up!"
"Then interrogate them harshly?"
Hearing this, Han Xing’s face turned black again.
"Can’t you just ask openly and straightforwardly?"
"What’s going through your head?"
Cheng Jianyong embarrassedly scratched his head.
Then, the five of them stepped out of the inn.
On the streets, people came and went.
Most were dwarves dressed in casual attire.
Among them, some beastmen, giants, elemental creatures, and elves with pointed ears were mixed in.
Although now the Dwarf Royal Capital has gathered a variety of people from different major races,
they were seeing humans for the first time.
Each of them cast curious glances at Han Xing and his group.
Han Xing and the others were already accustomed to such gazes.
However, at this moment.
A two-headed ogre with blue skin seemed to have set its sights on Han Xing and the others.
The ogre’s bloated body had two heads whispering among themselves.
From time to time, they looked at Han Xing and the others, eyes filled with a hungry gaze.
Regarding this look, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but complain: "Damn it, does this ogre want to eat us?"

chapters.title: Chapter 588 - 364: Gathering of the Strong, Scramble for Spots_2
paragraphs: "A mere guy at most of the Fifth-Turn Leader Level, actually daring to have ideas on a Legend, is he out of his mind?"
"Do you want me to leak some aura to give them a scare?"
Cheng Jianyong asked, eyes filled with eagerness.
This time, before they set out, they had also taken the Divine Power Shielding Potion.
Therefore, those Alien Race powerhouses on the street couldn’t sense the strength of Han Xing and the others at all.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "No need, we are here to gather intelligence."
"It’s better to stay low for now, besides, in the Dwarf Royal Capital, this guy wouldn’t dare to make a move."
Everyone nodded in agreement.
Just then, a cry of surprise rose from the streets of the Central Royal Capital.
"There’s a rainbow in the sky..."
"What is that?"
Everyone was attracted by the scene in the sky.
Including Han Xing and the others, who also cast their gaze upwards.
In the distance, Han Xing saw waves of iridescent light appear in the sky.
The cluster of iridescent light quickly approached and flew toward the central district.
Gradually, everyone saw what was emitting the iridescent light.
It was a small spindle-shaped wooden boat.
Covered in vines and flowers, it looked like a floral crown floating in mid-air.
Although the small wooden boat seemed fragile.
Han Xing and the others could sense a Legendary aura from it.
But the most captivating part.
Were the several tall, breathtakingly beautiful women standing on it.
From their pointed ears, it was obvious.
This was a group of Elves.
At the same time.
Among the cluster of Elves, accompanied by the sound of a harp and a serene glow on her face, an Elf woman.
Slowly stepped forward.
She stood at the prow, gazing at the people below, like a sacred.
"The Elf Race Goddess, Elinora...
"So beautiful..."
At this moment.
Powerhouses from every Race couldn’t help but be captivated by Elinora’s unparalleled beauty.
And just then.
A formidable aura ascended in the sky once more.
A giant covered in muscles soared into the sky.
At five meters tall, he exuded an intimidating presence.
People around him felt a terrifying pressure.
Even the space was filled with countless cracks.
"Little Giant Spirit King!"
The crowd uttered the name of this giant.
In the sky, the giant bellowed, "Elinora, rushing hastily to the Central Royal Capital."
"Are you looking to use some tricks to seize this Grandmaster Forging quota again?"
The giant’s voice was unobscured.
People on the street, unaware, looked puzzled.
In the air, the exquisite Elf Goddess softly replied, "Little Giant Spirit King, you’ve misunderstood."
"I’m merely passing by."
"Besides, there’s only one quota this time, we’re all competing fairly, what tricks are you talking about?"
Little Giant Spirit King sneered, "Elinora, I can’t be bothered to expose you."
"Others may not know, but I’m very clear on what kind of person you are!"
As Little Giant Spirit King’s words fell, the street erupted into an uproar.
As the Elf Race Goddess, Elinora had countless fans and loyal supporters.
At this moment, those fervent fans looked at the giant’s back, their eyes filled with anger.
However, the giant completely ignored those stares.
As if, in his eyes, these people were like ants, completely unworthy of his attention.
At this time, a voice emerged again.
"Uriah, saying such slanderous words about the Goddess in public isn’t right, is it?"
"Do you have any evidence?"
Hearing this, the Little Giant Spirit King snorted coldly, "What evidence do I need?"
"My word is the evidence!
"Bright Divine Son, if you want to stand up for her, then come here and take two punches from me first."
The tall giant clenched his fists instantly, even the nearby space showed signs of cracking.
Murderous intent was palpable!
The crowd didn’t expect this giant to be so aggressive and domineering, ready to fight at any moment.
"Uriah, you’re as domineering as ever!"
As the words fell, a terrifying aura rose!
A dazzling golden light lit up half the sky.
In the moment this aura was felt, everyone knew the person’s identity.
Bright Divine Son of the Sea of Light, Neotos.
Yet, the Little Giant Spirit King remained undaunted.
He declared boldly, "So what if I’m domineering?"
"As I said, if you stand up for this woman, you’re my enemy, Uriah’s enemy."
"If you’re not convinced, come now and let’s have a life-and-death battle!"
The Little Giant Spirit King’s aggressive nature surprised the crowd once more.
Bright Divine Son pondered for a moment, then smiled and said, "I won’t compete with you here, that’s the act of brutes."
"If you really want to fight me, we can set a date later."
"For now, Grandmaster Balrog is waiting for us, I must go first."
With these words.
A streak of golden light shot through the sky, heading directly to the Royal Capital Center.
"The Grandmaster’s opportunity is mine, don’t even think about taking it!"
The giant suddenly erupted, chasing after at an incredible speed.
At the same time, their aura alarmed other Legendary Powerhouses in the main city.
Like a stone stirring a thousand waves.
Over a thousand terrifying auras burst forth.
These were all Legendary Powerhouses from various Races.
Among them, several auras were comparable to the giant and the Bright Divine Son.
At this moment, a dark aura burst forth as well.
The sky suddenly turned into a black ink-like state, a thick black aura began to spread.

chapters.title: Chapter 589 - 364: Gathering of the Strong, Scramble for Spots_3
paragraphs: The crowd instantly recited the name of this aura.
Realm of Darkness, Dark Divine Son!
From that mass of dark aura, there emerged a somber voice.
"Uriah, Neotos, don’t think you can deceive us with your act."
"The Grandmaster’s slot, you had better give up on taking it!"
At the same time, more powerful auras burst forth.
These strong figures moved in unison towards the same location.
However, listening to their conversation, Han Xing was filled with curiosity.
What is this single opportunity?
Who is this Grandmaster Balrog?
Damn it, can’t you guys finish your talk?
He urgently wished to catch all these so-called Divine Sons and Daughters and interrogate them.
What exactly is going on?
And at this moment.
Han Xing suddenly sensed a familiar aura.
In the sky, a green figure shot up to the heavens.
Its overwhelming life force caused the surrounding flowers, grass, and trees to grow wildly.
It was one of the three Tree Spirit Legends who had previously aided the Witch Race.
Han Xing had met him once.
The Elf Goddess, Elinora, in the sky also seemed to notice that aura.
She lowered her phoenix eyes and softly said, "Divine Son Wan Liu of the Tree Spirit Race, would you be willing to come to me, and let us proceed together to Grandmaster Balrog’s forge?"
Hearing this.
The eyes of strong figures from various races on the town streets below showed surprise.
Divine Son Wan Liu?
Who is it?
To be personally invited by the Elf Goddess!
How blissful is that?
Everyone was frantically searching for the lucky one favored by the goddess.
At this moment.
The tree spirit with thousands of branches who heard the invitation suddenly brightened his eyes.
He hastily transformed into a human form.
Turning into a graceful and charming young man.
"Divine Lady Elinora, thank you for your invitation."
"I would be delighted to accompany you."
After speaking, the tree spirit performed a standard gentleman’s bow and then slowly walked towards the Elf Goddess’s wooden ship.
Below, countless gazes focused on the tree spirit.
Filled with envy.
Wishing they could switch places with that tree spirit!
And just as the tree spirit was about to accept the invitation and go to Elinora.
He suddenly felt a transmission in his mind.
He instinctively froze in place.
Then his gaze searched the crowd.
And then he saw Han Xing and others among the crowd.
Especially when he saw Han Xing’s face, the shock in his eyes was almost impossible to hide.
"Witch Race... Saint Master?"
"How did they come here?"
At this moment, hesitation appeared on the tree spirit’s face.
On one hand, is the goddess’s earnest invitation.
On the other, this mysterious human.
After a moment.
This Tree Spirit Legend cupped his hands towards the Elf Saintess in the sky and said, "Sorry, Lady Elinora, some friends are looking for me."
"Perhaps another time, I will accompany you."
After saying that, he flew directly downwards.
However, his words made everyone glance at him with astonished eyes.
After all, it was an invitation from the goddess!
How could anyone refuse willingly?
The admirers of the saintess were even biting their teeth in frustration.
Even Elinora in the sky was quite surprised.
Because she had long heard of the Tree Spirit Race’s Divine Son’s admiration for her.
In her mind, she was certain the Tree Spirit Race’s Divine Son would not refuse.
She stared at Wan Liu’s back, seemingly wanting to know.
Who are the friends he mentioned?
Who can make him refuse her invitation?
However, when she saw Wan Liu flying towards.
A group of human beings, a trace of amazement appeared on her face.
"Human Race..."
The eyes of others also turned towards Han Xing and others.
These humans, even though they concealed their aura, it was apparent they had legendary-level strength.
Five legendary figures, indeed not common.
But they were not particularly stunning.
Han Xing and his group, all at level 55, only exuded a middle-tier legendary aura.
Compared to the Bright Divine Son, Little Giant Spirit King, and those top-tier legends, they were inferior by an unknown margin.
Moreover.
A few days ago, the news of Han Xing instigating a divine war only spread within those top-tier circles in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Not to mention these Divine Sons and Daughters.
Even their clan leaders weren’t qualified to know such matters.
Thus, Han Xing and his group weren’t recognized.
Seemingly aware that their actions were drawing attention.
Han Xing said to the Tree Spirit named Wan Liu, "Let’s go, we can talk somewhere else."
After speaking.
Han Xing and Wan Liu of the Tree Spirit Race left the place.
And on this central city’s street.
Without any excitement to watch, everyone gradually dispersed.
Elinora stood at the ship’s bow, watching the back of Han Xing and his group, and she too departed from that place.
In a secluded place.
The humanoid tree spirit asked in surprise, "Saint Master Han Xing, how did you come here?"
Han Xing said directly, "I came to have some matters with the Dwarf King."
Upon hearing this, Wan Liu was momentarily stunned.
Although Han Xing was now a leader of a race.
In his heart, compared to an existence like the Dwarf King, he still lacked qualification.
After all, the Dwarf Race was far more powerful than the Witch Race.
Seemingly noticing Wan Liu’s thoughts.
Han Xing did not offer much explanation.
Instead, he continued, "So, why are you here at the Dwarf Royal Capital as well?"
"Also, what’s the story with the Grandmaster slot those Divine Daughters and Sons talked about?"
Wan Liu was full of doubt, "Uh, Saint Master Han Xing, you don’t know?"
"No crap, if I knew, would I be asking you?" Han Xing gave him an eye roll.
Wan Liu awkwardly rubbed his forehead.
"Here’s the thing, recently, hasn’t the Dwarf Race been holding the Three Kings Meeting?"
Everyone nodded, this matter, they were aware of.

chapters.title: Chapter 590 - 365: Methods of a Grandmaster
paragraphs: "During this meeting, the leaders of the three major races finalized many future cooperation matters."
"One of which is opening the quota for entering the ancient ruins, inviting legendary powerhouses from other races in the Holy Spirit Realm to explore together."
Han Xing and the others were immediately taken by surprise.
It should be noted that the ancient ruins have made significant contributions to the rise of the Dwarf Race.
Recently, they even unearthed a Godslaying-level weapon.
Before this, the Dwarf Race regarded it as a forbidden area within their race.
Strictly prohibiting anyone from setting foot there.
Unexpectedly, this time, the Dwarf Race actually opened such an important place.
Wan Liu continued, "And within the ancient ruins, there are immense dangers, even demigods could fall."
"So this time, those who came to the Dwarf Race are talented powerhouses from various races."
"I heard it from the clan leader that this time our Tree Spirit Race obtained a quota."
"That’s why I hurried overnight to the Dwarf Realm."
"Didn’t expect to meet you all here."
Wan Liu finished speaking, and everyone nodded.
It seems the Dwarf Race is serious this time.
They truly want to share the exploration quota of the ruins and invite major races to explore together.
Although it’s unclear why.
If possible, Han Xing would also like to go in together.
To see what exactly lies within the so-called ancient ruins.
At this moment, Han Xing asked again.
"What about the Grandmaster quota the Divine Sons and Daughters mentioned earlier?"
Wan Liu replied, "It’s like this, Saint Master Han Xing."
"This time, one of the three Master Forgers of the Dwarf Race, Balrog, to celebrate the meeting of the Three Kings."
"Specifically promised to help visiting races forge an item of equipment."
"A Master of Forging?"
Han Xing was even more surprised.
Before this.
He heard from the Beastman King that the Master Forgers of the Dwarf Race can forge divine artifacts.
And now, it’s the Grandmaster himself taking action.
Regarding this level, Han Xing didn’t quite understand.
So he asked, "Is there anything special about the equipment forged by a Grandmaster?"
"Why would it cause such a scramble among those Divine Sons and Daughters?
"Could it be that the Grandmaster is able to forge Holy Artifacts?"
Wan Liu listened, somewhat awkwardly said, "Holy Artifacts... they’re unique, not something that can be forged by human power."
"What the Grandmaster forges is also a divine artifact..."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing rolled his eyes and said, "Still a divine artifact, eh? I thought there’d be something special."
"Does your Tree Spirit Race even lack one or two divine artifacts?"
Wan Liu hurriedly explained, "Not ordinary divine artifacts."
"Saint Master Han Xing should know, even among Divine Artifact Level equipment, there are differences in strength."
"The equipment forged by a Grandmaster not only has attributes far more powerful than those of the same level but also incorporates some special effects."
"We call it Divine Forged Equipment."
Divine Forged...
This was the first time Han Xing heard this term.
Wan Liu continued.
"Moreover, reaching this level of a Grandmaster, one can forge equipment without needing blueprints."
"You just need to provide the materials and state your forging requirements."
"The Grandmaster can use their experience to help you forge it."
Upon hearing this, everyone seemed to think of something.
It’s important to know that they had a high-level material in their possession.
The scale of the beast.
It’s said that this thing can forge divine-level equipment and buildings.
But so far, Han Xing and the others haven’t found the corresponding blueprint.
"So that’s it, that’s what’s most special about a Grandmaster?"
"No need for blueprints, just relying on experience to forge divine artifacts one after another."
"You only need to provide powerful enough materials."
Thinking this,
Han Xing excitedly said, "Wan Liu, lead us to take a look."
Wan Liu listened and nodded.
Directly leading Han Xing to the place where Grandmaster Balrog was located.
Royal Capital Center.
There stands a huge black building.
This is the largest forge in the Royal Capital.
Every day, there’s a traffic flow of over ten million and transaction volume of orders here.
Upon entering the hall.
Han Xing and the others immediately felt the bustling atmosphere here.
Numerous dwarven apprentices, disheveled and dusty, grasping materials and blueprints, busily moving around.
Under Wan Liu’s guidance.
They passed through the forging hall.
Then, arrived at a large forging room at the back.
This forge room is extremely spacious.
The ceiling is over a hundred meters high, covering tens of thousands of square meters.
In the very center of the forge room.
There is a huge furnace, burning with raging flames.
High-temperature heat waves hit their faces.
The temperature here is at least twenty to thirty degrees higher than outside.
At each corner of the forge room.
Han Xing saw those Divine Sons and Daughters from various major races already arrived here ahead of time.
However, compared to their arrogance outside.
Inside here, this group of Divine Sons and Daughters seemed exceptionally quiet.
Even the giant towering over ten meters and that ball of golden phantom maintained restraint at this moment.
Everyone’s gaze was fixed on the silhouette in front, waving a hammer.
At that moment.
The silhouette was bare-chested, muscles bulging all over.
Then raised the black hammer in his hand and fiercely smashed down!
"Ding!"
The sound of metal striking resonated.
Everyone felt a bout of ringing in their ears.
Some weaker legends even had a trace of blood seeping from the corners of their mouths on the spot.
They looked in shock at the silhouette waving the hammer, eyes filled with astonishment!
"Just from the impact sound, it injured my flesh body, how is it possible?"
At this moment, a legendary figure from the Dwarf Race sneered, "Grandmaster Balrog possesses high-tier legendary combat strength by himself."

sentences.text: "During this meeting, the leaders of the three major races finalized many future cooperation matters."
"One of which is opening the quota for entering the ancient ruins, inviting legendary powerhouses from other races in the Holy Spirit Realm to explore together."
Han Xing and the others were immediately taken by surprise.
It should be noted that the ancient ruins have made significant contributions to the rise of the Dwarf Race.
Recently, they even unearthed a Godslaying-level weapon.
Before this, the Dwarf Race regarded it as a forbidden area within their race.
Strictly prohibiting anyone from setting foot there.
Unexpectedly, this time, the Dwarf Race actually opened such an important place.
Wan Liu continued, "And within the ancient ruins, there are immense dangers, even demigods could fall."
"So this time, those who came to the Dwarf Race are talented powerhouses from various races."
"I heard it from the clan leader that this time our Tree Spirit Race obtained a quota."
"That’s why I hurried overnight to the Dwarf Realm."
"Didn’t expect to meet you all here."
Wan Liu finished speaking, and everyone nodded.
It seems the Dwarf Race is serious this time.
They truly want to share the exploration quota of the ruins and invite major races to explore together.
Although it’s unclear why.
If possible, Han Xing would also like to go in together.
To see what exactly lies within the so-called ancient ruins.
At this moment, Han Xing asked again.
"What about the Grandmaster quota the Divine Sons and Daughters mentioned earlier?"
Wan Liu replied, "It’s like this, Saint Master Han Xing."
"This time, one of the three Master Forgers of the Dwarf Race, Balrog, to celebrate the meeting of the Three Kings."
"Specifically promised to help visiting races forge an item of equipment."
"A Master of Forging?"
Han Xing was even more surprised.
Before this.
He heard from the Beastman King that the Master Forgers of the Dwarf Race can forge divine artifacts.
And now, it’s the Grandmaster himself taking action.
Regarding this level, Han Xing didn’t quite understand.
So he asked, "Is there anything special about the equipment forged by a Grandmaster?"
"Why would it cause such a scramble among those Divine Sons and Daughters?
"Could it be that the Grandmaster is able to forge Holy Artifacts?"
Wan Liu listened, somewhat awkwardly said, "Holy Artifacts... they’re unique, not something that can be forged by human power."
"What the Grandmaster forges is also a divine artifact..."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing rolled his eyes and said, "Still a divine artifact, eh?
I thought there’d be something special."
"Does your Tree Spirit Race even lack one or two divine artifacts?"
Wan Liu hurriedly explained, "Not ordinary divine artifacts."
"Saint Master Han Xing should know, even among Divine Artifact Level equipment, there are differences in strength."
"The equipment forged by a Grandmaster not only has attributes far more powerful than those of the same level but also incorporates some special effects."
"We call it Divine Forged Equipment."
Divine Forged...
This was the first time Han Xing heard this term.
Wan Liu continued.
"Moreover, reaching this level of a Grandmaster, one can forge equipment without needing blueprints."
"You just need to provide the materials and state your forging requirements."
"The Grandmaster can use their experience to help you forge it."
Upon hearing this, everyone seemed to think of something.
It’s important to know that they had a high-level material in their possession.
The scale of the beast.
It’s said that this thing can forge divine-level equipment and buildings.
But so far, Han Xing and the others haven’t found the corresponding blueprint.
"So that’s it, that’s what’s most special about a Grandmaster?"
"No need for blueprints, just relying on experience to forge divine artifacts one after another."
"You only need to provide powerful enough materials."
Thinking this,
Han Xing excitedly said, "Wan Liu, lead us to take a look."
Wan Liu listened and nodded.
Directly leading Han Xing to the place where Grandmaster Balrog was located.
Royal Capital Center.
There stands a huge black building.
This is the largest forge in the Royal Capital.
Every day, there’s a traffic flow of over ten million and transaction volume of orders here.
Upon entering the hall.
Han Xing and the others immediately felt the bustling atmosphere here.
Numerous dwarven apprentices, disheveled and dusty, grasping materials and blueprints, busily moving around.
Under Wan Liu’s guidance.
They passed through the forging hall.
Then, arrived at a large forging room at the back.
This forge room is extremely spacious.
The ceiling is over a hundred meters high, covering tens of thousands of square meters.
In the very center of the forge room.
There is a huge furnace, burning with raging flames.
High-temperature heat waves hit their faces.
The temperature here is at least twenty to thirty degrees higher than outside.
At each corner of the forge room.
Han Xing saw those Divine Sons and Daughters from various major races already arrived here ahead of time.
However, compared to their arrogance outside.
Inside here, this group of Divine Sons and Daughters seemed exceptionally quiet.
Even the giant towering over ten meters and that ball of golden phantom maintained restraint at this moment.

They looked in shock at the silhouette waving the hammer, eyes filled with astonishment!
"Just from the impact sound, it injured my flesh body, how is it possible?"
At this moment, a legendary figure from the Dwarf Race sneered, "Grandmaster Balrog possesses high-tier legendary combat strength by himself."

chapters.title: Chapter 591 - 365: Grandmaster’s Methods (Part 2)
paragraphs: "And in the field he’s adept at, he can exert demigod level strength."
"Don’t even think about damaging your flesh body, just getting you shaken to death is a very simple matter."
Upon hearing this, everyone showed a surprised expression in their eyes.
At this moment, the figure wielding the iron hammer said, "Those who can’t withstand my musical impact, leave immediately."
"Don’t try to be brave, if you listen for too long, there’s a risk of falling."
With these words.
Nearly half of the nearly hundred legendary powerhouses left the scene.
The remaining fifty or so legends seemed to still want to hold on.
However.
As the hammering sound of Grandmaster Balrog resounded again.
After a series of dozens of strikes.
A legendary powerhouse from the Ogre Race spat out a mouthful of fresh blood.
It almost crawled out of the enormous forge room.
The remaining legendary powerhouses followed suit and left.
Soon.
There were less than twenty people left on the scene.
They were the Divine Sons and Daughters of those major races, possessing both enviable talent and considerable strength.
With a quick glance, none were below middle-tier legend.
They exchanged glances and nodded in acknowledgement.
It was a recognition of each other’s strength.
And at this moment.
When they noticed there were still a few figures standing in another area, surprise appeared in their eyes.
Because those figures were from the Human Race.
According to their sensing, these humans had at most middle-tier legend strength.
The fact that they could persist until now was completely beyond everyone’s expectations.
At this moment.
Grandmaster Balrog, bare-chested, halted his striking movements.
He scanned the crowd, a hint of appreciation flashing in his eyes.
"Next, I will accelerate the rhythm of my strikes."
"Listen carefully and see if you have any insights."
"If you can’t endure it, remember to leave immediately."
Upon hearing this, the prodigies understood that this grandmaster was going to show some special techniques.
If their talent was good, they might even gain something!
At this moment.
The Divine Sons and Daughters on the scene concentrated and focused intensely.
The next moment.
Grandmaster Balrog took out a piece of red-hot metal from the forge.
Then he placed it on the forge table and began striking rapidly.
"Ding! Ding! Ding!"
The sound of metal clashing was endless.
However, they also noticed that this time the strike sounds were slightly different.
It became more rhythmic and carried a sense of tempo.
To Han Xing, this sound was like a strange melody being played.
Inspiring a sense of insight.
Many problems that were previously perplexing suddenly became clear.
At the same time.
The system panels of Han Xing and others kept flashing information.
[Because you listened to the grandmaster’s forging melody, gaining insight, Experience Value +1.3 billion, Spirit Attribute +10...]
[Because you listened to the grandmaster’s forging melody, gaining insight, Experience Value +1.1 billion, Spirit Attribute +5...]
[Because you...]
Looking at that long list, over a dozen system notifications.
At this moment, the five people on the scene exchanged glances, seeing strong shock in each other’s eyes.
Damn!
What is this?
Just listening to the forging sounds can increase experience and attributes, and increase so much at once?
From the time Grandmaster Balrog finished speaking till now, they had gained 2 billion experience value.
Comparable to the spoils of defeating a single legend.
This is too outrageous!
Is this so-called leveling up by iron forging?
A few minutes later.
Han Xing’s system notifications were already flooding.
At this moment.
A white light appeared over him.
[Your level has increased, current level: 56.]
Leveled up!
Han Xing clenched his fist, full of excitement.
In less than a minute, he increased his experience value by 9%, comparable to a week’s worth of monster hunting for everyone!
At this moment, Han Xing even considered grabbing this Master of Forging directly.
Forging for him twenty-four hours a day.
This leveling speed was much faster than them hunting monsters by themselves.
However, Han Xing could only think about it for now.
If he really captures this Dwarf Grandmaster, not only will the upcoming trade be ruined.
The Dwarf Race would probably list Han Xing as their number one wanted criminal.
At this moment.
The Dwarf Grandmaster also sensed the changes in Han Xing.
A look of appreciation appeared in his eyes, and he said.
"Let us congratulate this friend from the Human Race, it seems he has gained considerable insight."
"His talent is truly limitless!"
With these words.
The gaze of all Divine Sons and Daughters fixed on Han Xing.
Being praised by Grandmaster Balrog is certainly an honorable matter.
What’s more important is.
Han Xing has made progress, while they have not.
This indicates that their talents as Divine Sons and Daughters are inferior to that of this human.
For a moment, these prodigies on the scene resolved.
Determined to concentrate on listening to Grandmaster Balrog’s forging rhythm; this was a rare opportunity.
Seemingly perceiving their thoughts.
Balrog continued, "My forging rhythm’s best effect is only during the first listen, yielding the greatest harvest."
"Later on, it won’t have this effect anymore."
Everyone stopped speaking.
Instead, they quietly listened to the grandmaster’s striking melody.
Indeed, as Balrog said, the first listen had the best effect.
Han Xing noticed that the speed of the system notifications began to slow down.
Moreover, the experience value gained started to diminish.
A few minutes later.
Han Xing saw.
Grandmaster Balrog hammered the metal in his hand into a rectangular shape.
On it, faint waterwave patterns appeared.

chapters.title: Chapter 592 - 365: Grandmaster’s Methods (Part 3)
paragraphs: At this moment, Han Xing instantly understood something.
What he was now striking was Rhythm Black Iron!
It turns out that using Rhythm Black Iron to forge equipment has such a special effect.
No wonder the Dwarf Race is so eager for Rhythm Black Iron!
At the same time.
The grandmaster also stopped his actions.
He wiped the sweat off his forehead and in a hoarse voice said, "That’s it for today."
The crowd in the arena seemed to snap back to reality upon hearing these words.
They bowed respectfully one by one.
"Thank you, Grandmaster Balrog."
It was evident that these proud Divine Sons and Daughters expressed their gratitude sincerely.
After all, the grandmaster personally took action to help everyone gain insights.
This kind of opportunity is hard to come by.
The dwarf casually waved his hand.
"No need to be so formal, let’s start discussing serious matters now."
Upon these words, the attendees once again wore solemn expressions.
Balrog continued, "It’s still the same rules as before."
"You each bring out the materials you have, and then say what you need to craft."
"Decisions will be made based on the rarity and strength of the materials to determine who will get help in crafting."
The crowd nodded in agreement upon hearing this.
At the same time.
A creature with a furry body and a fox head suddenly threw down a piece of strange metal.
The metal was as large as a millstone and emitted brilliant blue divine power fluctuations.
The fox head introduced, "Blue Shadow Divine Gold, possessing divine power amplification effects, comes from within our Azure Blue Mountain Range."
"I would like to craft a mask."
Upon hearing this, others cast disdainful glances.
Though Blue Shadow Divine Gold is precious.
It is only on the same level as the Philosopher’s Stone in terms of materials.
Aside from some divine power amplification effects, it has no other function.
Specifically seeking the grandmaster for this does seem a bit unworthy.
However, Balrog showed no particular expression.
He simply nodded, "Next."
Then, another legendary powerhouse threw out a piece of pure white mithril.
"White Moon Mithril, an extremely rare mithril that occasionally appears from among ten thousand Secret Silver Ore Veins."
"I wish for the grandmaster to help me craft a spear."
The appearance of White Moon Mithril made everyone’s eyes light up.
At that moment.
Other Divine Sons started to act as well.
Various strange and precious metals were thrown out one after another.
Extreme Ice Divine Stone, Flame Gold, Star Steel, and other precious ores were presented one by one.
For a moment, the entire forge was filled with the aura of various divine metals.
Grandmaster Balrog nodded once again.
At the same time.
The Dark Divine Son from the Realm of Darkness.
Suddenly revealed his form.
The faces of other Divine Sons appeared surprised.
Since they entered, they had not sensed the presence of the Dark Divine Son.
Nobody knew when this guy came in.
Cheng Jianyong gave Shen Yun a look and said, "Another legendary powerhouse with Invisibility Stealth abilities."
"I wonder, compared to Little Coal Ball, who is stronger."
Shen Yun directly said, "Do you even need to ask? It’s definitely Coal Ball who’s stronger."
He said it with great confidence.
Although nobody knew where his confidence came from.
Han Xing and others also believed so.
At this time.
A pile of metals appeared before the Dark Divine Son, emitting starlight speckles.
The strong calamity aura cast a shadow over everyone’s heart.
The Dark Divine Son uttered in a somber voice.
"Calamity Divine Gold, I want the grandmaster to help forge a longsword."
This was a metal everyone recognized.
Yet it was the first time seeing so much of it.
A rough estimate showed at least a thousand pieces!
The other Divine Sons praised, "The Dark Divine Son is truly wealthy."
"Calamity Divine Gold, this precious material, was previously only used as an additive, a bit added to equipment or weapons."
"Purely using Calamity Divine Gold as the main material for crafting a weapon, it’s the first time to see it."
"Yes, indeed. I heard that over in the Realm of Darkness, there is an abundance of divine metals."
However, upon hearing these words, Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
What is he lacking the most now?
All kinds of Divine Stones and Divine Gold!
And Calamity Divine Gold is one of the important materials for crafting the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon.
Han Xing eyed the somber Dark Divine Son, his thoughts began to stir.
If there’s a chance, see whether he can capture this Dark Divine Son.
Extract some Calamity Divine Gold from him!
At this moment.
Grandmaster Balrog nodded again.
Such a large amount of Calamity Divine Gold truly warranted his intervention.
Just then.
A creature, like a mass of golden light without a specific humanoid form, suddenly threw out a huge horn.
This horn was over a hundred meters long, even possessing a Divine Spirit Level aura.
This person was none other than the Light Divine Son from the Sea of Light, Neotos.
Seeing this item appear.
The Divine Sons of other races exclaimed, "Neotos, is this by any chance the horn of a Divine Level creature?"
Even Grandmaster Balrog couldn’t help but cast his eyes toward him.
The horn of a Divine-Level creature.
Even he hadn’t interacted with such a precious material many times.
The Light Divine Son shook his head and said, "Not a true Divine-Level creature, but not far from it either."
"This horn was found deep in the Sea of Light by our Divine Ancestor ten thousand years ago, having very strong penetration effects."
"I wish to ask the grandmaster to help craft a spear."
Hearing these words, everyone was shocked.
Although the Light Divine Son admitted this was not a true Divine-Level creature horn.
Just from being ’not far off,’ it was enough to demonstrate its preciousness.
At this moment.
To have Grandmaster Balrog take action.
This Light Divine Son from the Bright Sea Region presented his most treasured possession.
Grandmaster Balrog scanned the crowd and the various precious materials on the ground.
He seemed to have made a decision.
"Then, for this crafting quota..."

chapters.title: Chapter 593 - 366: Forging the Divine Artifact Shield
paragraphs: "Now, the forging slot for this competition..."
Grandmaster Balrog seemed about to announce.
A voice suddenly rang out: "Wait a minute."
Everyone followed the voice to find the Little Giant Spirit King with a look of disdain.
The Little Giant Spirit King said, "Neotos, isn’t it just a horn?"
"Not even a real divine-level creature, what are you pretending for?"
With that said, he suddenly tossed out a piece of broken bone.
Its terrifying divine power fluctuations were several times more formidable than the horn of the Bright Divine Son!
It stifled the hearts of everyone present.
Another formidable treasure!
The Bright Divine Son’s face stiffened, turned his head away, and stopped speaking.
The Little Giant Spirit King, seeing he had surpassed his opponent, showed a contemptuous smile.
"Behemoth leg bone, Grandmaster Balrog, just forge me a Beast Bone Mallet."
"In the future, if I see a demoness causing trouble, I’ll knock them out with one hit!"
Upon hearing this, everyone’s expressions turned peculiar.
Because they all knew who the Little Giant Spirit King was referring to.
At this moment.
Many eyes on the scene turned to the Elf Goddess.
Wearing a flower crown on her head, the saintly-featured Elinora smiled softly.
She seemed completely unconcerned by the Little Giant Spirit King’s provocation.
Grandmaster Balrog glanced at Elinora.
He asked, "Elf Race’s Divine Maiden, do you have something you’d like me to forge?"
"If not, then I’ll announce the results."
The crowd was startled.
They knew that if Elinora didn’t have something of sufficient weight.
Then the forging slot would be between the Bright Divine Son and Little Giant Spirit King.
"Grandmaster Balrog..."
"Indeed, I do have something; please take a look."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s gaze converged on her.
They saw Elinora wave her hands.
A black piece of wood appeared before her.
There were no divine power fluctuations on it.
However, when everyone covered it with their divine power to probe, they felt a stabbing pain like needles.
A faint suspicion arose in the crowd’s minds.
"Divine Maiden, could this be..."
Elinora nodded, "Yes, a branch from the World Tree."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s eyes showed shock!
"Oh my, it’s actually this thing!"
"Isn’t the World Tree the Holy Tree of the Elf Race? How did the Divine Maiden bring such a thing out?"
Even the always composed Grandmaster showed a fervent look.
To know, the World Tree is recognized across the Holy Spirit Realm as the best Holy Tree under the heavens.
Such grade materials.
Even he had never handled them.
Elinora smiled bitterly after hearing this: "I didn’t take it myself."
"Everyone should have seen the darkness aura on it."
"This branch was forcibly cut off by a power from the Abyss Realm."
Upon hearing this, everyone’s pupils shrank again.
Realizing that the situation on the Elf Race’s side might not be too favorable.
Elinora added: "However, even though it’s just a broken branch."
"It has the effect of breaking through the Divine Power Domain of legendary or even demigod-level powerhouses."
"I would like Grandmaster Balrog’s help to forge an arrow."
Even just a branch could break through the Divine Power Domain of a demigod.
The crowd gained a clearer understanding of the World Tree’s might.
At this moment, upon hearing the Elf Goddess’s request, Balrog nodded slowly.
"An arrow won’t be a problem."
"In that case, the slot for this time will be..."
He was just about to announce.
"Wait a minute." Another male voice rang out.
Everyone turned their gaze toward it.
Feeling that this scene seemed familiar.
Previously, when the Little Giant Spirit King interrupted the Bright Sea Divine Son, a similar situation seemed to have occurred.
But now these few powerhouses have already taken out parts of divine-level creatures.
Even the Elf Goddess brought out a branch of the Holy Tree.
Could there still be another expert?
The crowd on the scene all cast their gaze.
Then, they saw who interrupted.
It seemed... it was those few from the Human Race?
Grandmaster Balrog, interrupted again, wasn’t annoyed but patiently asked, "This young friend from the Human Race."
"Do you have materials you’d like me to forge too?"
He remembered Han Xing, even silently paying attention to him in his heart.
Because just now, while he was forging Rhythm Black Iron, causing many of the Divine Sons and Daughters to have insights.
Only this Human Race member managed to break through before him.
Such heaven-defying comprehension, even Balrog had never seen before.
He had already concluded in his heart that Han Xing was a forging genius.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, Grandmaster Balrog, I do have some materials for you to forge."
Some?
Upon hearing that, disdain flickered in the eyes of many Divine Sons present.
Everyone understood that the rarer the material, the less available it was.
Though, they thought it made sense.
The Human Race itself is a very weak race.
With their knowledge, what treasures could they encounter normally?
Probably, they might even treasure a few Philosopher’s Stones as priceless.
Thinking of this, the Divine Sons showed understanding expressions.
Grandmaster Balrog showed no change in expression and said, "No problem, show it to me."
"Even if your material grade isn’t high enough, I will personally craft equipment for you."
"Though I wonder, is this young friend interested in the art of forging?"
All the Divine Sons heard it and simultaneously showed expressions of envy.

chapters.title: Chapter 594 - 366: Forging the Divine Artifact Shield (Part 2)
paragraphs: They all understood.
This young human seems to have caught the eye of Grandmaster Balrog!
He even seemed to be considering taking him as an apprentice.
Everyone felt immensely jealous in their hearts.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "Grandmaster Balrog, thank you for your kind offer."
"But I am quite busy and cannot spare the time for forging."
The divine sons and daughters present showed expressions of astonishment.
He actually rejected the invitation to be an apprentice to a grandmaster?
What is this guy thinking?
"I see..."
Balrog, upon hearing this, shook his head slightly with regret.
"But it doesn’t matter, my previous promise still holds."
"You may present your item."
Hearing this, Han Xing nodded.
Then, he directly threw a giant beast scale onto the ground.
Clang!
In an instant.
The entire forging hall was filled with the presence of the giant beast scale.
A terrifying aura of ferocity suddenly erupted!
Everyone felt as if they were being stared at by a prehistoric fierce beast, a shiver running down their spines.
Even the precious divine gold on the ground.
As soon as it came into contact with the scale, all fluctuations of divine power instantly subsided.
As if these materials encountered a nemesis, they were immediately suppressed.
Everyone stared dumbfounded at the gray scale.
Then, they gasped in astonishment.
"Hiss! Such an evil, powerful aura!"
"My God, what kind of creature did this scale come from?"
"So terrifying!"
The divine sons and daughters present were utterly stunned by the scale.
The cruel aura emitted from the giant beast scale.
Not only suppressed the horn of the Bright Sea Divine Son and the Behemoth Leg Bone of the Little Giant Spirit King.
Even the World Tree Broken Branch of the Elf Goddess turned into an ordinary piece of wood.
Although the World Tree is sacred and unparalleled.
Here, it’s just a damaged branch after all.
The beast, as a creature that almost destroyed an era.
A mere hint of its aura was enough to make everyone tremble with fear!
It’s unimaginable that someone would produce such an item to request the grandmaster to forge.
Upon seeing this giant beast scale.
Only when Elinora threw out that World Tree Broken Branch.
Did Grandmaster Balrog show slight surprise before.
Now his eyes widened directly.
"Young human friend, what is this thing?"
Everyone heard the shock in Balrog’s voice.
At this moment, Han Xing’s voice slowly came.
"A scale from a true divine level fierce beast."
"I wonder, Grandmaster Balrog, are you able to forge it?"
If someone else said this to Balrog.
With his proud nature, he would definitely walk away immediately.
How dare they question the grandmaster’s skill!
However, when these words came from this young man’s mouth.
Balrog did not immediately refute it.
Because, this scale, is truly high-level.
Even as a master of forging.
He had indeed never forged such high-level materials.
After a moment.
Balrog nodded and said, "I can give it a try."
With these words, everyone knew their hopes were dashed.
This opportunity to forge had already been seized by this human.
One by one, they lowered their heads in disappointment.
"Everyone, you may leave now."
Grandmaster Balrog issued the order to disperse the guests.
The divine sons looked at Han Xing with eyes filled with both envy and wariness.
Then they all left the place.
Before long.
Only a few remained on the scene.
Among them were the Bright Sea Divine Son, Little Giant Spirit King,
as well as the Elf Goddess, Elinora.
The look in their eyes was somewhat unwilling.
After all, this time they had brought out their most powerful and highest-level materials from their races.
Yet, they were overshadowed by an obscure human.
At this moment.
Grandmaster Balrog seemed to understand their thoughts and said, "You three, if you trust me, you can also leave your materials."
"After I have finished forging the scale for this young human friend, I will forge for you next."
Upon hearing this.
The Bright Sea Divine Son and others had hopeful expressions in their eyes again.
Balrog added, "However, this additional forging will consume extra effort from me, so I will charge an additional fee."
The Little Giant Spirit King was the first to speak, "No problem, whatever the grandmaster needs, just say the word!"
The Bright Sea Divine Son also nodded in agreement.
Then, they respectfully thanked him.
"Thank you, Grandmaster Balrog!"
After speaking, the Bright Sea Divine Son and the Little Giant Spirit King turned and left.
On the scene, only Grandmaster Balrog, Elinora, Han Xing, and others remained.
Including Wan Liu of the Tree Spirit Race, who was also there.
At this moment, Elinora slowly walked over to Han Xing and the others.
Even before getting close.
They felt a gentle breeze as if they were bathed in spring warmth.
Elinora smiled lightly, "Hello, my name is Elinora."
"Can I get to know some friends from the Human Race?"
Her gaze swept over everyone with a completely equal look.
As if she genuinely wanted to befriend Han Xing and the others.
Wan Liu behind them was already entranced.
Even Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong forget what they were about to say.
Elinora’s beauty was too stunning.
The last time they saw a beauty of this caliber was the woman wearing a hood.
At this moment.
Han Xing’s voice brought everyone back to reality from the illusion.
"My name is Han Xing, is there something you need?"
Elinora replied softly, "Not really."
"I just find friends from the Human Race to be very interesting."
"If the opportunity arises, I hope to invite you to visit our Elf Realm."

chapters.title: Chapter 595 - 366: Forging the Divine Artifact Shield (Part 3)
paragraphs: Originally, when Elinora said she wanted to meet them, Han Xing was ready to refuse outright.
However, upon hearing those words, his eyes suddenly lit up.
Because Han Xing did indeed want to visit the Elf Realm.
After all, he had an important item on hand.
Related to the Elven Holy Tree.
Ancient Spirit Wood.
It could be used to repair the World Tree.
Recently, Han Xing had collected quite a bit.
He wondered, what kind of reward the Elf Race would give him for helping to restore this legendary Holy Tree.
Han Xing was secretly looking forward to it.
Thinking of this, he nodded and said.
"Sure, when I have time, I’ll visit the Elf Realm."
"That’s great."
Elinora’s face broke into a gentle smile.
She was very happy that Han Xing agreed.
After finishing, she extended her fair right hand, seemingly wanting to shake hands with Han Xing.
Behind her, Wan Liu looked at the Elf Goddess’s skin like jade and her slender hand.
Almost unable to resist the urge, wanting to shake her hand in place of Han Xing.
At this moment.
Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang, behind him, sensed a hint of danger.
They simultaneously removed their cloaks.
Revealing two breathtakingly beautiful faces.
Seeing the beauty of the two women.
Elinora made a slight sound of surprise.
"This human friend, I didn’t expect not only has amazing talent."
"But also such beauties by his side."
"I must have seemed presumptuous."
After speaking, Elinora slightly bowed and apologized to Zhang Lianmeng and Su Xiaoyang.
Then she withdrew her hand.
Han Xing waved his hand, "Let’s talk about the Elf Realm next time."
"Right now, I need to discuss crafting equipment with Grandmaster Balrog."
Elinora nodded her delicate head, "Alright, I won’t disturb you any further."
"If you have time, the Elf Realm always welcomes our human friends.
After saying this, Elinora didn’t linger and left on the spot.
At this moment, Wan Liu gave Han Xing a look and softly said, "Saint Master Han Xing, I need to leave first."
"For the time being, I’ll be staying within the Dwarf Royal Capital. If there’s anything, you can come to find me anytime."
Han Xing nodded, "You can go."
Wan Liu nodded.
Then hurriedly left the forge room.
As to what he went to do, everyone knew in their hearts.
Surely, he went to find Elinora.
Thus, only they and Grandmaster Balrog were left in the room.
Balrog then asked, "Young human friends, tell me your needs."
"What do you want to craft with this scale?"
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing asked, "Can anything be crafted?"
Grandmaster Balrog hesitated for a moment before explaining, "In theory, yes."
"But you should know, given the properties of this material, it’s best used to craft armor and shields."
"For other parts, the effect might be greatly reduced."
Han Xing nodded, "Alright then, can I use this scale to craft a shield directly?"
Grandmaster Balrog was taken aback upon hearing this.
Then he confirmed again, "Are you sure you just want to craft a shield?"
Such a large divine-level material used solely for crafting one piece of equipment seemed a bit wasteful to Balrog.
If some special techniques were used to divide it, at least a dozen divine artifacts could be made.
However, he didn’t know.
A complete Giant Beast Scale was a hundred times larger than this.
It could be split into a hundred pieces of the same size as this Giant Beast Scale.
And Han Xing’s backpack still had thirty-two complete scales.
Which meant Han Xing could produce over three thousand Giant Beast Scales.
Therefore, Han Xing didn’t have to consider these issues.
He directly nodded, "Absolutely."
Grandmaster Balrog nodded, "Since that’s your request, it is doable."
"However, the crafting process might be a bit lengthy."
"It involves some spatial technology, possibly requiring a lot of Terrastone for stabilization."
Han Xing nodded, "No problem."
After saying this, he threw a Shimmering Terra Stone (extra large) onto the ground.
Looking at this five-meter-high Terrastone before him.
Grandmaster Balrog’s eyes widened again.
Feeling speechless inside.
Why is everything this human takes out always so extraordinary?
This was the first time he’d seen such a large Terrastone in his life.
It’s estimated to be equivalent to nearly five thousand pieces of Terrastone.
"Grandmaster, is this enough Terrastone?"
Balrog gulped and said, "It’s enough."
"But if you want it to achieve an even greater effect, I would need Calamity Divine Gold..."
Before he could finish speaking.
Han Xing threw out a head-sized piece of Calamity Divine Gold.
Clang!
After hitting the ground, it created a deep pit.
Balrog was utterly shocked.
Feeling today was like seeing ghosts.
Before Han Xing could speak.
Balrog directly said, "It’s enough."
Han Xing nodded, "Alright, Grandmaster Balrog."
"If you need anything else, just say the word, and I’ll find a way to gather it."
Balrog shook his head, then looked deeply at Han Xing, "For now, there’s no need. Come back in half a month to collect it."
Half a month...
Though a bit long, Han Xing could accept it.
So he nodded, "Alright."
After saying this, Han Xing and the others left the place.
A few minutes later.
Balrog, having calmed down, put all these precious materials on the ground into the Space Ring.
At this moment, a familiar voice called from the doorway.
"Teacher Balrog, Teacher Balrog, are you in?"
The voice seemed very anxious.
Balrog knew who this voice belonged to.
It was one of his personal apprentices, Tadak.
Also his most satisfactory apprentice.
Balrog replied, "I’m here, come in."

Feeling speechless inside.
Why is everything this human takes out always so extraordinary?
This was the first time he’d seen such a large Terrastone in his life.
It’s estimated to be equivalent to nearly five thousand pieces of Terrastone.
"Grandmaster, is this enough Terrastone?"
Balrog gulped and said, "It’s enough."
"But if you want it to achieve an even greater effect, I would need Calamity Divine Gold..."
Before he could finish speaking.
Han Xing threw out a head-sized piece of Calamity Divine Gold.
Clang!
After hitting the ground, it created a deep pit.
Balrog was utterly shocked.
Feeling today was like seeing ghosts.
Before Han Xing could speak.
Balrog directly said, "It’s enough."
Han Xing nodded, "Alright, Grandmaster Balrog."
"If you need anything else, just say the word, and I’ll find a way to gather it."
Balrog shook his head, then looked deeply at Han Xing, "For now, there’s no need.
Come back in half a month to collect it."
Half a month...
Though a bit long, Han Xing could accept it.
So he nodded, "Alright."
After saying this, Han Xing and the others left the place.
A few minutes later.
Balrog, having calmed down, put all these precious materials on the ground into the Space Ring.
At this moment, a familiar voice called from the doorway.
"Teacher Balrog, Teacher Balrog, are you in?"
The voice seemed very anxious.
Balrog knew who this voice belonged to.
It was one of his personal apprentices, Tadak.
Also his most satisfactory apprentice.
Balrog replied, "I’m here, come in."

chapters.title: Chapter 596 - 367: Catastrophe-level Weapon: Lightning, Rainstorm, Snowflake
paragraphs: Tadak listened, then promptly pushed the door open and entered.
He quickly said, "Master Balrog, do you know when His Majesty the King’s meeting will end?"
"I have something very important to discuss with him, but I haven’t been able to reach him for days."
"Could you help me relay a message to him?"
Balrog looked a bit displeased, "Tadak, have you forgotten what I taught you?"
"In the art of forging, one should be neither hasty nor impatient."
"Even if the sky falls, we must focus on what we are doing."
"Only in this way can we create the most powerful divine weapons."
Tadak seemed to realize something and quickly regained his composure.
He respectfully said, "Your teaching is right, Master."
"I, your disciple, will remember."
Then, Tadak silently tossed out 1,000 blocks of Rhythm Black Iron.
Balrog’s brow moved.
He acted as if he didn’t see it, waved his big hand, and took all the Rhythm Black Iron into his bag.
Then he nodded faintly, "His Majesty the King’s meeting has been going on for several days."
"It should be ending soon."
Tadak’s face lit up with joy and said, "Then could I trouble you, Master, to tell His Majesty,
"that when the meeting is over, if he could find some time, I have something to discuss with him."
Upon hearing this, Balrog looked a bit troubled and said, "Tadak, you must understand, His Majesty the King is very busy."
"Is there something..."
Before he could finish speaking.
Tadak once again threw 5,000 blocks of Rhythm Black Iron onto the ground.
Seeing such a large quantity.
Balrog’s eyes again showed surprise.
He silently collected this pile of Rhythm Black Iron, then asked, "Even though His Majesty the King is very busy."
"But we forge masters are the pillars of the Race."
"His Majesty the King is considerate of his subordinates, and no matter how busy, he will find some time."
Balrog paused and said, "Tadak, what do you want with His Majesty the King?"
Joy appeared on Tadak’s face.
If Han Xing were here, he surely couldn’t help but complain.
Balrog and Tadak, they’re indeed of the same ilk.
Blinded by money.
However, Tadak was long accustomed to his master’s nature.
So he said, "It’s like this, Master Balrog."
"This time, I’ve brought a huge deal for His Majesty the King!"
"The traders are willing to pay several million Rhythm Black Iron to buy our Catastrophe-level Weapon Blueprint!"
"What?!"
Balrog’s hands trembled instantly, even the hand holding the hammer became a bit unstable.
Even with Balrog’s vast experience.
Hearing such a massive number of Rhythm Black Iron, he couldn’t help but feel surprised.
And Tadak continued with excitement, "And it seems they have more than just a few million Rhythm Black Iron!"
"If we could make this deal, we could definitely get at least hundreds of thousands of Rhythm Black Iron from it!"
Hearing this, even Balrog’s breathing became a bit rapid.
Hundreds of thousands of Rhythm Black Iron, that’s equivalent to his quota for a year!
How much forging experience could it add?
It’s simply unimaginable!
Balrog couldn’t help but ask, "Tadak, to which Race does this trading partner of yours belong?"
"The Giant Race? Or the Flame Plateau?"
Tadak shook his head and said, "No, Master."
"They are from the Human Race."
Upon hearing it was the Human Race, Balrog’s heart trembled again.
He asked with some uncertainty, "Tadak, are these Human Race people at Legendary Level of strength?"
"And are they very generous?"
Tadak was stunned, "Master, have you met them?"
After hearing that, Balrog became even more certain.
The trading partners Tadak mentioned.
Were the same Human Race individuals who had just brought out the Giant Beast Scale!
The surprise in his eyes grew.
At this moment, Han Xing was unaware of the discussion between Tadak and Balrog.
They had already returned to their inn.
At this time, Shen Yun said, "Brother Xing, should we remain in the Dwarf Royal Capital for now?
Han Xing nodded.
They still had three things to do in the Dwarf Royal Capital.
One is to wait for the Grandmaster’s equipment to be crafted.
The second is to find the Dwarf King for the Catastrophe-level Weapon Blueprint transaction.
The third is that Han Xing was planning to see if he could secure a few slots for the Ancient Ruins.
Han Xing felt especially curious about this mysterious place.
Everyone returned to their rooms in silence, then waited quietly.
Early the next morning.
Everyone heard a broadcast message.
The Three Kings meeting had ended successfully.
The city broadcast played a long message.
Which included various agreements.
Such as reopening trade routes between the major Races of the Holy Spirit Realm and establishing trade caravans.
And that no major Races should go to war lightly, in case of conflicts.
They could report to the three great Races for mediation.
In addition, if any Race faced a crisis, they could seek help from the great Races, and so on.
All sorts of agreements...
A total of over three hundred agreements.
Took more than an hour to read through.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong looked at Han Xing with a strange expression and said, "After so many days, it’s finally over."
"Now, can we see the Dwarf King?"
Han Xing nodded, "It should be soon, we’ll wait for news from Tadak."
"I guess, he’s even more anxious than us."
Han Xing was right.
Tadak was indeed more anxious than them.
He had been waiting outside the Royal Palace, hoping to be the first to contact the Dwarf King.
After all, customers like Han Xing and the others.
Are rare to encounter in a hundred years.
Just like that, Han Xing and others stayed in the Dwarf Royal Capital for another three days.
On this day, Tadak rushed to find Han Xing, and excitedly said, "Good news, good news!"
