chapters.title: Chapter 597 - 367: Catastrophe-level Weapon: Lightning, Storm, and Snowflake.
paragraphs: "His Majesty the King has finally found the time today and has agreed to meet us this afternoon!"
Upon hearing this, a smile of joy appeared on Han Xing’s face.
After waiting for so many days, wasn’t it all for this moment?
Although, according to rank and status,
Han Xing and the Dwarf King are equals, both being leaders of their respective races.
However, Han Xing has not proactively revealed his identity.
In this unfamiliar country, who would recognize you?
So, regarding the fact that the Dwarf King made them wait for so many days,
Han Xing had no objections.
He quickly packed his things, then the five of them walked out of the inn’s main entrance together.
Led by Tadak,
they entered the largest building in the Royal Capital, the Dwarf Imperial Palace.
The place was heavily guarded, with various refinedly equipped dwarf soldiers patrolling back and forth.
While inside the palace, Han Xing sensed the presence of more than a dozen legendary level powerful auras.
At this moment, Tadak turned around and said, "His Majesty the King is already waiting for us at the Wind Crow Tower."
Han Xing nodded.
He gestured for Tadak to continue leading the way.
They walked through various corridors and small courtyards.
After several twists and turns,
they finally arrived at a tower-like building within the Royal Palace.
This was the Wind Crow Tower mentioned by Tadak.
Inside, Han Xing sensed an extremely formidable and refined aura.
It felt as if it had been hammered billions of times, indescribably tempered through millions of hardships!
It exuded an intimidating sense of terror!
"So strong!" Shen Yun exclaimed first in admiration.
The others felt the same way.
Without a doubt, the demigod level entity inside was the Dwarf King.
Compared to other demigods, the Dwarf King was truly powerful.
Han Xing felt that he was even more formidable than the Ancient Tree with Entwined Roots.
Only slightly weaker than Golden Dragon Hawthorne Glaser!
Bear in mind, the Golden Dragon is a true divine level dragon, merely withholding its might.
But the Dwarf King possesses at least the battle prowess of a demigod’s limit.
The other party also sensed the arrival of Han Xing and his companions.
A robust voice came from inside.
"Come in."
With those words,
Han Xing pushed open the door.
Everyone felt an intense, oppressive gaze instantly fall upon them.
Han Xing lifted his head.
Inside was a spacious reception hall.
In the center of the hall was a huge spruce table.
A dwarf with a goatee and resolute features raised his head.
At this moment, the divine power of the Dwarf King suddenly burst forth.
"Boom!"
A sudden wild wind rose within the entire hall!
No one knew what was happening.
They only saw the Dwarf King’s body enveloped by a golden light which quickly covered the entire Dwarf Imperial Palace.
The overwhelming aura of the king was awe-inspiring!
In the next moment,
Han Xing also suddenly unleashed his own aura.
Contending with the golden light emanating from the Dwarf King!
On this day,
the entire Dwarf Royal City was enveloped by two overwhelmingly terrifying royal auras.
Whether one was a legend or a demigod, faced with the pressure of these two royal auras, many couldn’t help but kneel.
Moments later,
the auras gradually dissipated.
Inside the palace,
Grandmaster Tadak was leaning against the door, his legs involuntarily trembling.
He falteringly said, "Y-Your Majesty! What happened?"
The Dwarf King exhaled a breath of hot air through his nose, causing his goatee to flutter.
Then, he flashed an exaggerated smile, "It’s nothing, I’m just getting acquainted with this friend from the Human Race."
After speaking, the Dwarf King cast his gaze toward Han Xing.
"I didn’t expect the business partner Tadak mentioned to actually be the current Master of the Human Race and also the Witch Race Saint Master."
Through the recent aura clash, the Dwarf King had already guessed Han Xing’s identity.
Yet, Tadak, standing nearby, was shocked beyond words.
"Y-Your Majesty, did you say he’s the Master of the Human Race, and also the Witch Race Saint Master?"
"Is he the one who defeated the Shadow Legion and repelled the Shadow Monarch?"
Han Xing now held some initial fame in the Holy Spirit Realm.
The most widely circulated tale was Han Xing’s victory against the Shadow Legion in that battle.
Regarding the subsequent confrontation with the Path of the Giant Dragon,
and nearly vanquishing the God of Tricks, the level of combat was too high for them to know about it.
His Dwarf Majesty nodded and calmly said, "Grandmaster Tadak, don’t be nervous."
"No matter what identities these friends hold,"
"they are all our business partners, aren’t they?"
Though his words were directed at Tadak,
his gaze was fixed on Han Xing.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing smiled as well.
"His Majesty the King is right, we are here simply for trade."
"We won’t cause any trouble in your Dwarf Kingdom."
"See, we’ve stayed so many days without a single incident happening?"
The Dwarf King nodded.
"Have a seat."
After he spoke, Tadak exhaled a slight, relieved breath.
Then, Han Xing and his five companions, along with Tadak, each found a seat.
The Dwarf King began the conversation, "I heard from Grandmaster Tadak that you wish to purchase our catastrophe-level weapons?"
Han Xing nodded.
"Finished products or blueprints?"
"Blueprints."
Their exchange was simple and swift.
Upon hearing this, the Dwarf King sank into a contemplative expression.
"Indeed, our race has developed catastrophe-level weapons."
"According to your information, our race might possess seven or eight kinds of catastrophe-level weapons."
"But in fact, the only ones we can truly deploy are Silent Annihilation Lightning, Fury Heart Storm, and Withered Snowflakes."
"As for the more powerful ones like Ghost Wind, Scorching Celestial Fire, and Space Collapse, we haven’t fully mastered them yet."

chapters.title: Chapter 598 - 367: Catastrophe-level Weapon: Lightning, Storm, and Snowflake
paragraphs: "After all, you should know, those catastrophes in the Void Turbulence are too terrifying."
"The deeper you go, the more chaotic the Power of Rules contained in those terrifying catastrophes."
"In a short period, there’s simply no way to simulate it."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing nodded.
Three kinds of Catastrophe-level Weapons are not bad either.
Then, Han Xing said, "Can you let me check out the design blueprints of these three Catastrophe Weapons first?"
"Check them out?" The Dwarf King seemed a bit puzzled.
"What can you make out of them?"
At this moment, Han Xing also realized something.
The natives of this world are different from their Blue Star survivors.
Without an Attribute Panel, they naturally couldn’t see the attributes of the blueprints.
So, Han Xing explained.
"Just let me take a look at them first."
For Han Xing’s strange request, the Dwarf King appeared a bit confused.
But he still nodded, "Alright."
With those words, the Dwarf King waved his hand.
On the table before them, three earth-yellow blueprints appeared.
Han Xing’s eyes scanned over them, and the attributes of these three blueprints appeared in sequence.

[Calamity Defense Tower: Silent Annihilation Lightning]: Can summon a Silent Annihilation Lightning with destructive power, causing terrifying damage to all enemies within a diameter of one kilometer, and putting the attacked enemies into a super paralysis state of 0.1 second to 5 seconds.
[Farthest Strike Distance]: 200,000 kilometers
[Attack Power]: 1,000,000.
[Defense Value]: 250,000.
[Construction Materials]: Philosopher’s Stone*10,000, Thunder Divine Stone*10,000, Shadow Divine Stone*10,000, Calamity Divine Gold*50.

[Calamity Defense Tower: Fury Heart Storm]: Can summon a Fury Heart Storm with negative effects, causing storm strike damage to all enemies within 10,000 kilometers, and comes with defense value reduction effects and life limit reduction effects.
[Attack Range]: Diameter of 10,000 kilometers.
[Attack Power]: 300,000.
[Defense Value]: 300,000.
[Special Effect]: Continuously reducing enemy’s defense value and Divine Power Value (up to 50%), permanently reducing enemy’s life limit.
[Construction Materials]: Philosopher’s Stone*10,000, Waveless Metal*10,000, Shimmering Terra Stone*10,000, Calamity Divine Gold*50.

[Calamity Defense Tower: Withered Snowflakes]: Can summon Withered Snowflakes with body corrosion effect, causing Withered Snowflakes strike damage within 10,000 kilometers, and causing all enemies to be slowed down, continuously corroding their Divine Bodies.
[Attack Range]: Diameter of 10,000 kilometers.
[Attack Power]: 400,000.
[Defense Value]: 200,000.

[Attack Effect]: Units stained by Withered Snowflakes will suffer 400,000 points of erosion damage, reducing mobility by 20%~100%, and can continuously corrode their bodies, (Note: When paired with Fury Heart Storm, it will have unexpected effects.)
[Construction Materials]: Philosopher’s Stone*10,000, Extreme Ice Divine Stone*10,000, Shadow Divine Stone*10,000, Calamity Divine Gold*50.
After looking through the attributes of these three blueprints.
Han Xing’s eyes revealed a look of shock.
Undoubtedly.
These three blueprints are on the same level as the [Spiritual Godslaying Cannon], if not stronger Defense Towers.
Especially the [Silent Annihilation Lightning], which has an attack power of 1,000,000, twice that of the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon!
However, the Godslaying Cannon is a columnar attack, equivalent to all enemies in a line receiving the damage.
While the Silent Annihilation Lightning is a long-distance pinpoint blast.
This is more suitable for countering those individually powerful enemies.
Moreover, after the improvement of two Sun Crown Steles.
The [Silent Annihilation Lightning] will have an attack power of at least 3,000,000, with an ultra-long range strike capability of 600,000 kilometers.
Additionally, the attack range will also double.
It’s imaginable that after building the Tower of Annihilation Lightning.
The threat Han Xing poses to Divine-level Creatures will increase exponentially!
Including the other two blueprints, the same applies.
It can be said, this kind of level Defense Tower.
Only in Han Xing’s hands can it unleash its greatest power.
At this moment, Han Xing was completely moved.
He couldn’t help but ask, "Your Majesty the King, how are you planning to price these three blueprints?
The Dwarf King heard this and slowly said, "You’ve seen the attributes above."
"Under a single Defense Tower state, Silent Annihilation Lightning is the strongest."
"While Withered Snowflakes and Fury Heart Storm combined yield unexpected effects."
After pausing, the Dwarf King said, "On my side, I’ll initially price Silent Annihilation Lightning at 3,000,000 pieces of Rhythm Black Iron."
"The other two Defense Towers at 2,500,000 pieces of Rhythm Black Iron each."
"What do you think?"
Upon hearing this number, Han Xing let out a slight sigh of relief.
With his stockpile of materials, he can completely purchase all three blueprints.
However, what Han Xing is considering now is something else.
That is, regarding the quotas for the Ancient Ruins.
He is pondering how to broach the subject with the Dwarf King to ask for several quotas.
Seeing Han Xing not responding.
The Dwarf King thought Han Xing was pondering, after all, several million pieces of Rhythm Black Iron is still a huge number.
"If you don’t have enough Rhythm Black Iron on you, you can also use other Divine Stones to replace them."
"Philosopher’s Stone, Terra Stone, and so on, can all be exchanged for Rhythm Black Iron at a ratio."
"I suggest you first purchase the Silent Annihilation Lightning."
However, Han Xing shook his head and said, "No need, Your Majesty."
"I want all three of these blueprints."
Upon hearing this, the Dwarf King raised an eyebrow.
He puzzledly asked, "You mean, all of them?"
He seemed to be confirming something.
After all, combining the three blueprints is 8,000,000 pieces of Rhythm Black Iron.
Even with the reserves of the Dwarf Race’s treasury, it is barely this number.
Han Xing nodded, "Yes."
Upon hearing this statement.
Beside him, Tadak could no longer sit still and suddenly stood up in shock from his stool!

Additionally, the attack range will also double.

The threat Han Xing poses to Divine-level Creatures will increase exponentially!

Only in Han Xing’s hands can it unleash its greatest power.

chapters.title: Chapter 599 - 368: Divine Artifact, Giant Beast Shield
paragraphs: Grandmaster Tadak jumped up from his chair in amazement.
Although he knew Han Xing had a lot of Rhythm Black Iron.
But he never expected it to be so terrifying!
Eight million Rhythm Black Iron, just taken out whenever needed.
That’s way too much!
Furthermore, according to the rules of the Dwarf Race.
Whoever introduces the trade can take a 5% commission.
That is, if the trade is successful.
Tadak would instantly receive a commission of 400,000 Rhythm Black Iron!
With so much Rhythm Black Iron.
Relying on his understanding.
Tadak even has the confidence to reach the Grandmaster realm within ten years!
At this moment, as he looked at Han Xing, beyond excitement.
There was gratitude.
He is indeed my benefactor!
Even the Dwarf King took a deep look at Han Xing.
He could tell.
Han Xing wasn’t deceiving him.
He really could take out that much Rhythm Black Iron!
The Dwarf King nodded and said: "My friends from the Human Race, how forthright."
"Let’s proceed with the trade now."
Han Xing then said: "Your Majesty, please wait a moment."
"Is there anything else?" The Dwarf King frowned, seemingly thinking Han Xing wanted to back out.
However.
At this time, Han Xing suddenly stood up.
He directly waved his big hand.
In front of everyone, the vast hall was instantly filled with a sea of Rhythm Black Iron.
Even with the composure of the Dwarf King, seeing such a massive amount of Rhythm Black Iron.
He couldn’t help but feel incredibly shocked.
Moreover, in his perception.
The amount of Rhythm Black Iron here is absolutely more than eight million!
Han Xing directly said: "Here is ten million Rhythm Black Iron."
"I wish to buy three Catastrophe-level Weapon Blueprints while requesting a few slots to enter the Ancient Ruins from His Majesty."
At this time.
The Dwarf King’s eyes showed a sudden realization.
He too understood the reason why this human in front of him could take out so much Rhythm Black Iron in one go.
The Dwarf King slowly said.
"For this Ancient Ruins, there are only 100 slots, all already designated."
"However, if it’s the request of the Master of the Human Race, we will try to accommodate."
He glanced at the group behind Han Xing, "This time, I will give you five slots, is that enough?"
Han Xing nodded, "That’s enough!"
The Dwarf King also showed a satisfied smile.
"Then, Master of the Human Race."
"This transaction has succeeded."
After leaving the Dwarf Royal Palace.
Han Xing returned to the inn.
Then, he directly clicked to learn the newly obtained three blueprints.
[Successfully learned Calamity Defense Tower: Silent Annihilation Lightning...]
[Successfully learned...]
After doing these, Han Xing slowly let out a breath.
This time, the main goal of coming to the Dwarf Realm has been completed.
It can be said, even if they gain nothing more from now on.
With just these three blueprints, Han Xing’s strength will increase significantly!
Next time.
Facing Divine Spirit-level creatures like the God of Tricks.
Han Xing wouldn’t need to struggle so much.
Directly bombard them with Silent Annihilation Lightning to paralyze.
Then let the Spiritual Godslaying Cannon focus fire.
Not requiring Han Xing to make a move at all.
Will be able to directly destroy the opponent.
It’s likely, even the Dwarf King couldn’t imagine.
The Calamity-level Defense Tower they developed was originally for dealing with demigods in technology.
Yet in Han Xing’s hands, it directly possessed Godslaying power!
At this time, Cheng Jianyong said: "Brother Xing, should we continue waiting in the Dwarf Kingdom?"
Han Xing nodded.
"Yes, wait, there are still twenty days until the Ancient Ruins fully open."
"During this period, we have nothing much to do, perfect time for a break."
Upon hearing this, everyone nodded.
In the days to come, the group stayed in the Royal Capital.
Truly having nothing to do.
Usually, they would stroll around the Royal Capital.
Experiencing the customs and culture of the Dwarf Race.
The Dwarf Race’s brewing skills are the best, and this is universally acknowledged in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Especially Cheng Jianyong.
In recent days, he was a frequent visitor at various taverns in the Royal Capital.
He tasted all kinds of fine wines from the Dwarf Race.
In a flash, over ten days had passed.
On this day, Han Xing received word.
The shield made by Grandmaster Balrog has been completed!
They can go retrieve it now.
Upon hearing this, Han Xing took Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong directly to Balrog’s forge.
In the exclusive forging room of Grandmaster Balrog, the group met the familiar small figure.
At this moment.
Balrog still had his upper body exposed, holding a hammer in his hand.
He slowly turned around and said, "Here you are."
The group nodded.
At this time, Shen Yun couldn’t help but ask eagerly: "Grandmaster Balrog, I heard the shield is ready, where is it?"
Seeing his impatient look, Balrog chuckled softly.
Not minding at all.
Then, he directly waved his hands.
On the ground, a gray rectangular shield appeared.
Its appearance was relatively ordinary.
Looking like a gray wall.
However, the group could feel extremely powerful Divine Power emanating from this shield.
It even faintly exuded a menacing aura that suppressed their Divine Power.
Balrog surveyed the shield, showing a satisfied expression.
"This is the most satisfying work I’ve crafted in recent years."
"Take a look yourself."
As soon as he finished speaking.
Shen Yun eagerly rushed over and picked it up.
Meanwhile.
The shield’s attributes appeared in the team’s chat channel.
[Giant Beast Shield (Red) lv55, Quality: Divine Artifact, Armor: 20324~22573, Constitution +10000, Movement Speed -10%, Strength Attribute -10%.]
[Attached Effect]: Divine-level Damage Reduction (reduces physical damage taken by 50%), Divine Magic Resistance (reduces magic damage taken by 50%),

chapters.title: Chapter 600 - 368: Divine Artifact, Giant Beast Shield (Part 2)
paragraphs: [Fierce Beast’s Might]: Legendary Effect, when attacked, there is a 50% chance to unleash the fierce beast’s aura, forcing nearby enemies back 500 meters. (Ineffective against Divine Spirit level creatures.)
[Fury of the Ferocious Beast]: Epic Effect, reduces all enemy damage by 50%, lasting for 60 seconds (ineffective against Divine Spirit level creatures)

[Beast of Calamity]: Divine-level Effect, after accumulating 100 hits, will release Breath of Calamity, forcing all enemies into a state of fear, reducing defense by 10%~50%, and lowering action ability by 50%~80% (can affect Divine Spirit level creatures).
After seeing the attributes of this shield.
Han Xing took a sharp breath.
Including everyone else, they were all deeply shocked.
"Over twenty thousand armor, ten thousand Constitution, how damn terrifying!" Cheng Jianyong exclaimed first.
You should know, in the treasury of the Beastman Kingdom, Han Xing and the others had seen several powerful shields.
Among them, the Epic Quality Level 60 shields had an Armor Value of just over 5000.
And the Divine Artifact Quality Level 60 shields just barely surpassed ten thousand Armor.
And now, this Giant Beast Shield, although only Level 55.
Directly has over twenty thousand armor!
More than double theirs!
Coupled with those terrifying attributes.
Shen Yun possessing this shield.
Can even go head-to-head with a Demigod Giant Dragon!
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly thought.
When he killed Nelos, he also received a first-kill reward.
[Apocalypse Rune Blueprint (Red)]: Increases All Attributes by 200~250 points, can add an additional 5% attribute to enchanted equipment.
This rune, the 200 points in All Attributes needs no mention, is already extremely formidable.
It has a special effect that can increase equipment attributes by 5%.
That is to say, with the Apocalypse Rune.
This shield’s attributes can be enhanced further!
Shen Yun immediately excitedly lifted it up.
Like the aura of a sleeping fierce beast, instantly erupted from within Shen Yun!
"Very strong!"
Shen Yun genuinely praised: "I feel my defense has increased more than twofold!
He satisfactorily put the shield away.
Everyone smiled contentedly.
A stronger teammate means greater help to the team.
At this time, Han Xing suddenly said: "Grandmaster Balrog."
Hearing the voice, Balrog looked at Han Xing and asked: "What else might this young human friend need?"
Han Xing nodded, "Are you still taking forging commissions?"
"I have a few more pieces of these Giant Beast Scales, and I’d like your help in crafting some armor sets."
Although Balrog had mentioned before.
That crafting shields from these Giant Beast Scales yields the best results.
But its formidable defense means that even crafting other parts, the attributes wouldn’t fall short.
Now that Shen Yun already has the Giant Beast Shield, defense has greatly increased.
Han Xing wants to go to the extreme.
A set of Giant Beast Equipment will surely cause Shen Yun’s defense to skyrocket again!
However, upon hearing this, Balrog’s hands trembled instantly.
There’s more?
He looked at Han Xing speechlessly and said: "The scales of such a terrifying creature, crafting even one item wears me out."
"I’ve been working overtime non-stop for the past half a month, couldn’t even eat properly, just to finish the shield."
"And you want me to craft several armor sets."
"If you want to kill me outright, just say so."
Balrog’s tone could be heard as very fatigued.
Han Xing chuckled awkwardly: "One set is fine."
"We can pay the commission fee."
Balrog shook his head and said: "It’s not about the commission fee."
"But, I truly don’t have..."
Before he could finish speaking.
A pile of ten thousand pieces of Rhythm Black Iron suddenly appeared on the ground.
Looking at the heap of metal, Balrog glanced back at Han Xing.
He couldn’t help but gulp.
Han Xing then said: "Grandmaster Balrog, how about this."
"Help me craft one set of Giant Beast Equipment, and I’ll supply all the materials."
"Moreover, I’ll pay you 100,000 Rhythm Black Iron for each successful piece crafted."
One hundred thousand!
Hearing this number, Balrog’s hands trembled once more.
Although he knew these humans possessed a large amount of Rhythm Black Iron.
He didn’t expect them to be so generous.
Throwing around amounts like a hundred thousand Rhythm Black Iron.
At this moment, Balrog admitted, he was truly tempted.
After hesitating for a moment, he nodded and said: "Since that’s the case, I’ll risk half my life to help craft you a set."
Hearing this, a look of joy appeared on Han Xing’s face.
At this point, Balrog added once again.
"But only limited to the armor, bottoms, helmet, and shoes."
"Also, this time, the crafting period will be very long, taking three to four months is normal."
Han Xing calculated in his mind and thought this timeframe was acceptable.
Then, Han Xing directly threw down four Giant Beast Scales and a heap of materials.
Additionally, he also added 500,000 pieces of Rhythm Black Iron.
Although Balrog only agreed to craft four parts, Han Xing still gave him an extra 100,000 for the crafting fee.
Balrog looked at Han Xing deeply once again, a satisfied expression on his face.
Han Xing said: "Grandmaster Balrog, then we won’t disturb you any longer."
"When you’re done crafting, just notify us to come and collect it."
"Also, if you could, slightly increase the use level of these four pieces of equipment."
Balrog seemed not to understand Han Xing’s words, and asked: "Level?"
Han Xing realized that these natives didn’t have the concept of levels.
So he said: "I mean the kind that reaches the High-tier Legendary Power level."
